title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly trained to generate structured outputs like points and bounding boxes that downstream interfaces, agents, and robots can act on, yet safety alignment of this output channel has not been systematically analyzed. We study visual grounding safety by repurposing three safety benchmarks spanning direct harm (VLSU), social bias (BBQ-V), and situational safety (Asimov-2.0) into 15,401 matched pairs of harmful requests that differ only in the requested output: a free-text answer (VQA) or a grounding (point or bounding box). Across five VLMs, models that refuse a harmful request posed as a question often comply when the same request asks for a grounding: averaged over models, grounding refusal trails VQA refusal by 31-59 percentage points, depending on the domain, and safety system prompts do not close this gap. We propose a fine-tuning approach that combines grounding-form refusals with capability grounding data and self-distilled benign data to counter over-refusal. For Qwen3-VL-8B and VisionReasoner-7B, it improves grounding refusal by 77-95 percentage points on VLSU and BBQ-V and by 64-85 points on the held-out Asimov-2.0 domain, while also improving VQA refusal, preserving grounding capability, and keeping over-refusal limited. Representation analysis shows that fine-tuning moves harmful requests toward each model's refusal direction, most strongly for grounding, while leaving benign requests near the harmless reference.

AI.tldr: 论文首次系统研究视觉定位输出通道的安全对齐：将三个安全基准改造成15,401对仅输出形式不同的有害请求配对，发现定位拒绝率显著低于VQA拒绝率，并提出微调方法显著提升定位拒绝同时保持能力与限制过度拒绝。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地生成点、边界框等结构化输出供下游接口、智能体和机器人执行，但该输出通道的安全对齐尚未被系统分析。以往安全评估主要针对自由文本回答，然而同样的有害请求若以"定位"形式提出，可能绕过模型的安全防护，形成新的风险面。
AI.method: 将三个覆盖直接伤害（VLSU）、社会偏见（BBQ-V）和情境安全（Asimov-2.0）的安全基准改造成15,401对匹配的有害请求，配对中仅请求的输出形式不同：自由文本回答（VQA）或定位（点/边界框）。在五个VLM上对比拒绝率。随后提出一种微调方法，融合定位形式的拒绝数据、能力定位数据与自蒸馏良性数据以对抗过度拒绝，并进行表征分析。
AI.result: 五个模型中，对以问题形式提出的有害请求常会拒绝，但同一请求若要求定位则往往配合执行：平均而言，定位拒绝率比VQA拒绝率低31-59个百分点（依领域不同），安全系统提示无法弥合这一差距。所提微调方法在Qwen3-VL-8B和VisionReasoner-7B上，使VLSU和BBQ-V的定位拒绝率提升77-95个百分点，在留出的Asimov-2.0领域提升64-85个百分点，同时改善VQA拒绝、保持定位能力并限制过度拒绝。表征分析显示微调将有害请求推向各模型的拒绝方向（定位最显著），良性请求则保持在无害参考附近。
AI.conclusion: 定位输出通道存在系统性安全对齐缺口，安全系统提示不足以解决；结合拒绝数据、能力数据与自蒸馏良性数据的微调可大幅提升定位拒绝率、跨领域泛化并保持定位能力与合理拒绝行为，表征层面的变化为这一改进提供了机制性解释。

title: StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 StageVLN 训练框架，在不改变推理路径、不增加推理期几何编码器的前提下，通过训练期的特权空间与轨迹引导塑造导航表征，在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLN 策略受益于大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）提供的强语义先验，但标准的动作监督并未显式促使中间表征保留场景几何、相对朝向或全局回合进度等结构信息。在推理阶段引入深度估计器、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型虽能提供此类结构，却会带来额外算力、内存开销与架构依赖，影响部署。
AI.method: StageVLN 是一种训练框架：利用特权空间与轨迹引导来塑造导航表征，同时保持原始推理通路不变。具体地，由冻结的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层级空间引导；并以相对朝向目标与专家路线进度目标提供互补的轨迹—状态监督。所有辅助组件仅在训练时使用，部署时移除，推理阶段无需额外几何编码器。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE validation-unseen 上，以 4B 参数骨干实现 56.3% SR 与 51.4% SPL，且推理时不含额外几何编码器；在 RxR-CE 上，在不使用额外导航训练数据、推理时不含几何编码器的情况下达到 54.3% SR。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期的特权几何与轨迹监督对导航表征进行结构化塑造，可在不增加推理开销与架构依赖的前提下显著提升 VLN 性能，为借助几何基础模型增强导航策略提供了一条部署友好的路径。

title: Bayesian Data Augmentation for DNN Retraining with Binomial Outcomes in Vision-Based UAV Landing
summary: In GPS-denied or cluttered urban environments, vision-based landing is essential for reliable UAV missions. Real-world landing sites are often unstructured and highly variable, requiring strong generalization by the perception system. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) trained with synthetic data augmentation offer a scalable solution for learning landing-site features across diverse vehicle and environmental states. However, computationally expensive DNN retraining, along with challenging performance validation via test flights, limits exhaustive model fine-tuning and necessitates an optimized retraining pipeline. In this work, we deploy a Bayesian data augmentation framework integrated with a photorealistic simulator featuring high-fidelity vehicle dynamics to iteratively retrain the helipad detector DNN, maximizing landing performance as the objective function. We validate our framework with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, demonstrating improved landing performance and tighter confidence intervals on predicted landing outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将贝叶斯数据增强框架与高保真光真实感仿真器结合，以着陆性能为目标函数迭代重训直升机停机坪检测DNN，在仿真实验中提升了着陆性能并收窄了预测置信区间。
AI.motivation: GPS拒止或杂乱城市环境下，视觉着陆对无人机任务可靠性至关重要。真实着陆场地非结构化且高度多变，要求感知系统具备强泛化能力。合成数据增强训练的DNN虽可扩展，但重训计算代价高、试飞验证困难，限制了穷举式微调，因此需要优化的重训流程。
AI.method: 部署贝叶斯数据增强框架，并与具备高保真车辆动力学的光真实感仿真器集成，以着陆性能作为目标函数，迭代重训直升机停机坪检测DNN。
AI.result: 在光真实感仿真器中，针对不同环境条件与车辆状态开展实验，证明着陆性能得到改善，且预测着陆结果的置信区间更窄。
AI.conclusion: 面向视觉着陆的停机坪检测DNN可借助贝叶斯数据增强与高保真仿真的闭环迭代重训得到优化，兼顾性能提升与预测不确定性收敛，为受限条件下的模型微调提供了可行方案。

title: Automatic Speech Recognition for Low-Resource Sinhala: A Critical Review of Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
comment: 29 pages, 1 table. Submitted to Computer Speech & Language
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) for low-resource languages remains a major challenge. Sinhala, the primary language of Sri Lanka with about 16 million speakers, illustrates the difficulty: agglutinative morphology, a 54-phoneme inventory, subject-object-verb (SOV) syntax and scarce annotated speech data limit both conventional and modern ASR systems. This paper presents the first critical review of Sinhala ASR research, tracing its development from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) through deep neural networks to self-supervised pre-trained models such as wav2vec 2.0, XLS-R, Whisper and Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS). We compare existing Sinhala systems with related low-resource ASR work on Tamil, Malayalam and Hindi in terms of architecture, training data, word error rate (WER) and robustness to real-world acoustic conditions, and we assess self-supervised and transfer learning as responses to scarce labeled data. We show that most reported WERs are not directly comparable because they differ in corpus, data split and scoring, and that the only controlled comparison in the literature attributes an 18.1% relative WER reduction to corpus correction alone. We also discuss context-aware ASR that draws on phonological, syntactic and semantic knowledge. We identify six research gaps: (1) the lack of large annotated corpora covering multiple dialects and acoustic conditions; (2) weak contextual modeling of Sinhala morphosyntax; (3) high WER in real-world conditions; (4) the absence of standardized benchmarks; (5) the lack of parameter-efficient fine-tuning studies; and (6) the absence of annotated code-switched Sinhala-English speech resources. We outline a research agenda to address these gaps, intended as a roadmap for researchers working on Sinhala and other morphologically rich languages.

AI.tldr: 首篇僧伽罗语ASR综述：梳理HMM到自监督模型的发展，指出WER不可比、仅一项受控实验归因18.1%相对WER下降，并提出六大研究空白与路线图。
AI.motivation: 僧伽罗语（约1600万使用者）ASR长期面临低资源困境：黏着形态、54音素音系、SOV语序及标注语音稀缺，同时压制传统与现代ASR系统；而该语言此前缺乏系统性综述，亟需厘清研究脉络、可比性与真实场景鲁棒性。
AI.method: 综述性研究：按HMM→深度神经网络→自监督预训练（wav2vec 2.0、XLS-R、Whisper、MMS）的时间线梳理僧伽罗语ASR；并与泰米尔语、马拉雅拉姆语、印地语等相关低资源工作，在架构、训练数据、WER、真实声学条件鲁棒性四个维度进行对比；同时评估自监督与迁移学习作为标注数据稀缺的应对手段，并讨论融合音系、句法、语义知识的上下文感知ASR。
AI.result: 多数已报道WER因语料、数据划分与评分方式不同而不可直接比较；文献中唯一受控对比显示，仅语料修正一项即带来18.1%的相对WER下降。据此识别六大研究空白：缺少覆盖多方言与多声学条件的大规模标注语料；僧伽罗语形态句法的上下文建模薄弱；真实条件下WER偏高；缺乏标准化基准；缺少参数高效微调研究；缺少标注的僧伽罗语-英语语码转换语音资源。
AI.conclusion: 提出针对上述空白的僧伽罗语ASR研究议程，作为面向僧伽罗语及其他形态丰富语言研究者的路线图，强调语料建设、上下文建模、标准化评测、参数高效微调与语码转换资源为优先方向。

title: Knowing the Rules, Applying the Rules: Evaluating Language Models on Traditional Chinese Bazi
comment: 16 pages, including references and appendices. Project page: https://monsterpppp.github.io/bazi-qa-benchmark/
summary: Knowing domain rules does not guarantee applying them to a case. We study this distinction in traditional Chinese Bazi through 3,000 Chinese multiple-choice questions spanning 14 Theory and 11 Case categories. Six endpoint systems are evaluated, with primary results reported on a 2,492-item model-informed refinement. Theory accuracy exceeds Case accuracy for every system, and gaps of 16.60-29.56 percentage points remain when invalid responses are excluded. The contrast is more specific than a general case-reasoning deficit. Across six systems, Twelve Stages and Nayin reach mean accuracies of 89.10% and 88.62%, while Shensha Basics reaches 75.96%. Within Case, Luck Pillars averages 84.62%, but Career and Family Relations average only 36.98% and 38.19%. Overall rankings also conceal different category strengths. On the original 3,000 items, paired DeepSeek native/disabled comparisons associate native configurations with Theory gains of 6.53 and 12.20 points for Flash and Pro, respectively; Case changes are -3.67 and +1.27 points. These are provider-configuration associations, not isolated causal effects of reasoning. The results motivate task-specific evaluation of cultural-domain applications rather than reliance on aggregate knowledge scores. The benchmark measures agreement with a model-generated, model-verified answer key, not real-world predictive validity. Final-set results are post-selection descriptions, and incomplete provenance and expert validation constrain their interpretation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过3000道中文选择题（14个Theory类、11个Case类）考察八字领域"知规则"与"用规则"的差异，发现所有系统的Theory准确率均高于Case，差距为16.60–29.56个百分点，且分类别表现差异显著，主张对文化领域应用进行任务特定评估。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于区分"掌握领域规则"与"将规则应用于具体案例"这两种能力：已知规则并不保证能正确套用到个案，作者希望以传统中国八字为文化领域场景，检验模型是否存在这种"知识—应用"落差，并判断该落差是否具有任务特异性而非一般性的案例推理缺陷。
AI.method: 构建3000道中文选择题基准，覆盖14个Theory类别与11个Case类别；评估六个端点系统，主结果基于2492题的模型辅助精炼集（model-informed refinement）报告；通过配对比较DeepSeek原生/禁用配置（Flash与Pro）在原始3000题上的表现，分析配置与成绩的关联。
AI.result: 所有系统的Theory准确率均高于Case，排除无效回答后差距仍达16.60–29.56个百分点；六个系统中Twelve Stages与Nayin平均准确率为89.10%与88.62%，Shensha Basics为75.96%；Case内部Luck Pillars平均84.62%，而Career与Family Relations仅36.98%与38.19%；整体排名掩盖了各类别强弱差异。原始3000题上，DeepSeek原生配置相对禁用配置在Theory上分别提升6.53（Flash）与12.20（Pro）个百分点，Case变化为-3.67与+1.27个百分点，属提供方配置关联而非孤立因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对文化领域应用开展任务特定评估，而非依赖聚合知识分数；该基准衡量的是与模型生成、模型验证答案键的一致性，并非真实世界预测效度；最终集结果为筛选后描述，且溯源不完整与缺乏专家验证限制了结论的可解释性。

title: Spend Bytes on Breadth: Precision-Count Trade-offs for Decode-Time KV Compression in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Reasoning models write most of their KV cache while decoding long chains of thought (CoT), so the cache has to be compressed online under a fixed memory budget. Decode-time methods mostly decide which tokens to evict. We ask how a fixed byte budget should be split between the number of cached tokens and their precision. BreadthKV spends the bytes on more tokens at low precision, combining quantization with eviction, and picks the bit-width for each model and budget with a 60-problem end-to-end calibration, since offline attention error does not predict it reliably. On three reasoning models and four math and science benchmarks, it scores above eviction alone in 17 of 18 settings and produces shorter outputs. Much of what eviction loses comes from derailed runs, which keep reasoning until the length cap without reaching an answer. On Qwen3-8B at our tightest budget, eviction sends 91% of AIME samples to the cap and BreadthKV 40%. Under the same protocol, BreadthKV is statistically indistinguishable from a joint rate-distortion allocator (RDKV) that uses 27% more KV memory-time, and it outperforms our re-implementation of ThinKV.

AI.tldr: 提出 BreadthKV，一种在固定字节预算下将 KV cache 预算偏向更多 token、低精度存储的在线压缩方法，结合量化与驱逐，并通过端到端校准选择位宽。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在解码长链思维（CoT）时会产生大量 KV cache，必须在固定内存预算下在线压缩。现有解码期方法多关注驱逐哪些 token，但未回答固定字节预算应如何在 token 数量与精度之间分配。
AI.method: BreadthKV 将字节预算用于低精度缓存更多 token，融合量化与驱逐；由于离线注意力误差无法可靠预测位宽效果，采用 60 题端到端校准为每个模型和预算选择位宽。
AI.result: 在 3 个推理模型和 4 个数学与科学基准、18 个设置中，BreadthKV 有 17 个优于单独驱逐，并产生更短输出。Qwen3-8B 最紧预算下，驱逐使 91% AIME 样本触及长度上限，BreadthKV 仅 40%。相同协议下与使用多 27% KV 内存时间的联合率失真分配器 RDKV 统计上不可区分，并优于 ThinKV 复现。
AI.conclusion: 固定 KV 字节预算应更多分配给 token 数量而非精度；结合量化与驱逐的 BreadthKV 能减少“脱轨”长生成，在效率与效果上均优于单驱逐方法。

title: GIVE-KWS: Gated Injection of Visual Evidence for Noise-Robust Query-by-Example Keyword Spotting
summary: Visual speech promises noise-robust keyword spotting, yet a visual stream is not necessarily used. On a tri-modal query-by-example keyword spotting (QbyE-KWS) benchmark, we find that a system with a task-trained visual encoder comes within 2 percentage points of a text-and-audio system in equal error rate (EER) at -10 dB, and link this gap to the encoder's lack of phonemic information. We present GIVE-KWS, whose fusion stage, GIVE (Gated Injection of Visual Evidence), conditions query audio on lip motion through gated cross-attention. We show that visual robustness depends on two interacting conditions: a phoneme-bearing visual representation, and fusion that injects visual evidence rather than rescaling audio features. Under a phoneme-bearing encoder, injection yields an effective SNR gain of 4.0-9.3 dB over masking at -10 dB, whereas under a phoneme-poor one it nearly vanishes. Relative to the benchmark system, GIVE-KWS reduces unseen-keyword EER by 72.9% at -10 dB and 62.8% on average.

AI.tldr: 提出GIVE-KWS，通过门控注入视觉证据的跨注意力融合，在音视频文本三模态QbyE-KWS上大幅提升噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语音有潜力实现抗噪关键词识别，但视觉流并不必然被有效利用。作者在tri-modal query-by-example KWS基准上发现，任务训练的视觉编码器在-10 dB下EER仅比文本-音频系统差2个百分点，并将这一差距归因于编码器缺乏音素信息。
AI.method: 提出GIVE-KWS，其融合阶段GIVE（Gated Injection of Visual Evidence）通过门控跨注意力，用唇动信息对查询音频进行条件化。核心观点：视觉鲁棒性依赖两个相互作用的条件——承载音素的视觉表征，以及以“注入视觉证据”而非“缩放音频特征”的方式进行融合。
AI.result: 在承载音素的编码器下，注入式融合在-10 dB相比掩蔽式（masking）获得4.0–9.3 dB的有效SNR增益；而在音素贫乏的编码器下该增益几乎消失。相比基准系统，GIVE-KWS在-10 dB将未见关键词EER降低72.9%，平均降低62.8%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉鲁棒性并非自动获得，需同时满足“音素承载的视觉表征”与“注入式融合”两个条件；GIVE-KWS据此显著优于基准系统。

title: SEAL: Mixture-Closed Additive Reconstruction and Refinement-Aware Expert Routing for Efficient Speech Separation
summary: Compact time-frequency separators that mask the mixture and refine through a shared cell face two limits. First, a bounded multiplicative mask only scales a mixture bin, so where overlapping components cancel, the estimate stays small. Second, a shared cell applies the same weights to every time-frequency token at every step, so enlarging it adds compute everywhere. We present SEAL (Sparse Expert routing with Additive Latent reconstruction) to address both. For reconstruction, a zero-sum additive residual bounded by the local mixture amplitude lets estimates be nonzero where components cancel yet still sum to the mixture. For routing, a query built from acoustic and inter-step evidence sends each token to one of six residual experts, and a norm cap keeps the step cue from overriding clear acoustic evidence. On EchoSet, SEAL (small) surpasses TIGER (small) by 0.31 dB SI-SDRi with 28% fewer parameters and 2.9 times fewer MACs, and SEAL (large) is within 0.07 dB SI-SDRi of TIGER (large) at 3.1 times fewer MACs.

AI.tldr: SEAL用零和加性残差重建与稀疏专家路由，突破了有界乘性掩码在相消处无法恢复、共享单元等权重全量计算的局限，在更少参数与MACs下超越TIGER。
AI.motivation: 紧凑时频分离器（掩码混合+共享单元迭代精修）存在两个限制：一是乘性掩码仅有界缩放混合频点，当重叠分量相消时估计值仍被压小；二是共享单元对每步每个时频token施加相同权重，扩大单元会带来全局算力增长。
AI.method: 提出SEAL（Sparse Expert routing with Additive Latent reconstruction）。重建方面，采用受局部混合幅度约束的零和加性残差，使估计在分量相消处仍可非零且其和仍等于混合。路由方面，由声学证据与步间证据构造查询，将每个token路由到6个残差专家之一，并用范数上限防止步线索压过明确的声学证据。
AI.result: 在EchoSet上，SEAL(small)较TIGER(small)提升0.31 dB SI-SDRi，参数少28%，MACs少2.9倍；SEAL(large)与TIGER(large)相差在0.07 dB SI-SDRi以内，MACs少3.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 加性零和残差重建与稀疏专家路由相结合，可在显著降低参数与计算量的同时保持或超越现有分离性能。

title: Voltic: Distinguishing Volatility from Stochasticity in Recurrent Memory
summary: Recurrent sequence models must decide how strongly to overwrite their memory at each token. Read as Bayesian filtering, this write is the gain of a Kalman update, set by uncertainty from two sources that pull it in opposite directions: volatility, how quickly the underlying associations change, and stochasticity, how noisy each observation of them is. First, we show that the update of gated delta-rule memories is the form this filter takes under isotropic uncertainty. Next, we introduce Voltic, a recurrent memory that keeps the covariance anisotropic and makes both noise variances input-dependent, so the write is vector-valued and carries uncertainty accumulated over the sequence. A dense covariance would have to be propagated token by token, ruling out the parallel training these models depend on. We therefore give two assumed-density approximations, diagonal and quasi-diagonal, both of which leave the memory update in delta-rule form and reuse its chunked kernels. On controlled recall tasks in which associations change and observations are corrupted, Voltic leads all baselines. On the task combining volatility and stochasticity, its margin over the strongest baseline is larger at both extrapolation sizes than at the training sizes. In 45M-parameter language models it leads an eight-task reasoning average and achieves higher retrieval accuracy beyond the training context length than gated baselines, at throughput close to those baselines. Deriving the write from an uncertainty recursion therefore makes memory more responsive to change.

AI.tldr: 本文将循环序列模型的门控写入门读作贝叶斯滤波中的卡尔曼增益，指出其由波动性（关联变化速度）与随机性（观测噪声）两类不确定性共同决定。作者提出 Voltic，保持协方差各向异性并使两种噪声方差依赖输入，从而写入门为向量且携带序列累积的不确定性；为避免稠密协方差逐 token 传播破坏并行训练，提出对角与准对角两种假设密度近似，仍保持 delta-rule 形式的更新并复用分块核。实验表明 Voltic 在受控回忆任务、45M 参数语言模型推理平均与长上下文检索上均优于门控基线，且吞吐接近。
AI.motivation: 循环序列模型需要逐 token 决定以多强程度覆写记忆，现有门控机制缺少对写入门来源的规范性解释。作者以贝叶斯滤波为视角，认为该写入门本质上是卡尔曼增益，受波动性与随机性两类相反方向的不确定性支配；现有 gated delta-rule 记忆仅在各向同性不确定性下对应这一滤波器，无法表达各向异性与输入相关噪声，限制了记忆对关联变化的响应能力。
AI.method: 首先证明 gated delta-rule 记忆的更新是各向同性不确定性下该滤波器的特例形式。随后提出 Voltic：保持协方差各向异性，令波动性与随机性两种噪声方差均依赖输入，使写入门成为向量并携带沿序列累积的不确定性。由于稠密协方差需逐 token 传播、无法支持依赖的并行训练，提出对角与准对角两种假设密度近似，二者均使记忆更新保持 delta-rule 形式，从而复用已有分块（chunked）核实现并行训练。
AI.result: 在关联变化且观测被破坏的受控回忆任务中，Voltic 领先所有基线；在同时包含波动性与随机性的任务上，其相对最强基线的优势在外推尺寸处比训练尺寸处更大。在 45M 参数语言模型上，Voltic 在八项任务推理平均上领先，并在超出训练上下文长度的检索准确率上高于门控基线，同时吞吐接近这些基线。
AI.conclusion: 从不确定性递推推导写入门，使记忆对变化更具响应性；Voltic 通过对角/准对角假设密度近似在保持 delta-rule 与并行训练兼容性的同时引入各向异性、输入相关的不确定性，在受控任务与语言模型任务上取得一致增益。

title: Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking
comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)
summary: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出DFM-KD关系型知识蒸馏框架，通过蒸馏样本间特征差异而非逐点特征值，提升transformer跟踪器的精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知中的视觉目标跟踪受严格时延与功耗限制，而transformer跟踪器虽精度领先，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署于资源受限的实时平台，因此需要高效的压缩/蒸馏方法。
AI.method: DFM-KD（Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation）：面向transformer视觉跟踪的关系型蒸馏框架。区别于传统特征蒸馏（最小化师生特征间的逐点差异如MSE），该方法以样本间特征差异为载体传递知识，显式对齐特征空间的关系结构，即蒸馏教师在跨样本外观变化与一致性建模上的方式，而非强制绝对激活值相似，使学生捕获批内视觉变化的结构动态。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DFM-KD在跟踪精度与成功率上均持续优于常规特征级蒸馏方法；蒸馏后模型特征鲁棒性增强、跟踪性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以关系型（样本间差异）知识蒸馏替代逐点特征蒸馏，是提升transformer跟踪器轻量化部署性能的有效途径。

title: From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model
summary: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

AI.tldr: SCION 提出在单一模型中联合进行生成与自监督表征学习，实现无需标签或预训练模型的自条件生成，在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得显著优于对比方法的 FID。
AI.motivation: 现有强图像生成模型依赖类标签、冻结预训练编码器或单独训练的自动编码器，导致生成依赖监督或预训练。作者希望在一个模型中同时完成生成与自监督表征学习，从而摆脱标签与预训练模型的依赖。核心难点在于两类目标不匹配：对比学习需要干净增强视图并偏向粗糙不变语义，而流匹配需要含噪图像并须保留对比学习所丢弃的细粒度细节与空间布局。
AI.method: SCION 的核心是单个像素空间编码器，以流时间步和嵌入为条件。表征学习时，条件嵌入为所有图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器的 [CLS] token 产出语义表征并用对比损失训练。生成训练时，条件嵌入为图像自身的 [CLS] 表征，patch token 经解码器预测图像。为在推理时无需参考图像采样，联合学习嵌入上的先验。通过梯度范数平衡与 stop-gradient 机制实现单次运行的联合优化。模型完全自监督、自包含，无需标签或预训练模型。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，使用 JiT-B 配方且无表征引导时，SCION 达到 8.92 FID，超过类无条件 iREPA（对齐预训练 DINOv2，46.44）和以 DINOv2 为条件的 RCG（14.27）。使用 JiT-L 时，SCION 在无引导下达到 5.89 FID，在有表征引导下达到 3.47，优于采用 ADM 配方的 RCG（6.24）。
AI.conclusion: SCION 证明了生成与自监督表征学习可在单一模型中有效联合训练，实现无需标签或预训练的自条件生成。其通过条件嵌入设计与梯度处理机制解决了目标不匹配问题，并在 ImageNet 上以更少外部依赖取得领先的 FID 表现。

title: Rotated, but How Far? Diagnosing and Improving Object-Rotation Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can detect that an object has rotated across views, but cannot reliably tell by how much. We introduce OR-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark for object-rotation reasoning with eight tasks covering rotation detection, rotation magnitude estimation, and multi-view rotation reasoning. Across 12 VLMs, the gap is stark: the strongest models approach 100% accuracy on detection, yet even coarse magnitude estimation is near chance. When asked for exact angles, models place 91.8--100% of their predictions on just $0^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $180^\circ$, a failure we term canonical-angle collapse. This collapse persists even without visual input. Representation probing shows that missing information is only part of the explanation. Although rotation information becomes less recoverable at finer granularity, substantial coarse-grained information remains, and a simple linear probe outperforms the models' generated answers. This suggests that VLMs underuse rotation information they already encode. We therefore propose RotationCue, a lightweight decoder that recovers coarse rotation information from the VLM's own frozen representations and feeds it back to the model as intermediate textual context. Across three VLMs, RotationCue improves every model--task combination on OR-Bench, raising macro-average accuracy by 7.9--12.6 points while preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OR-Bench 细粒度物体旋转推理基准，揭示 VLM 的"典型角度坍缩"现象，并通过 RotationCue 轻量解码器将模型自身编码的旋转信息回注为文本上下文，显著提升旋转推理性能。
AI.motivation: VLM 虽能判断物体在多视角间发生了旋转，却无法可靠给出旋转幅度；作者希望系统刻画这一能力缺陷的性质、成因，并加以改进。
AI.method: 构建 OR-Bench 基准，含八个任务，覆盖旋转检测、旋转幅度估计与多视角旋转推理；评测 12 个 VLM；通过表征探测分析信息可恢复性；提出 RotationCue——从 VLM 冻结表征中恢复粗粒度旋转信息，并以中间文本上下文形式回馈模型。
AI.result: 最强模型旋转检测接近 100% 准确率，但粗粒度幅度估计接近随机；精确角度预测中 91.8%–100% 落在 0°、90°、180°三个典型角度（即 canonical-angle collapse），且无视觉输入时依然存在。表征探测显示粗粒度旋转信息仍可恢复，简单线性探针优于模型生成答案。RotationCue 在三个 VLM 上使所有模型–任务组合均获提升，宏平均准确率提高 7.9–12.6 个点，同时保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: VLM 旋转推理缺陷不仅是信息缺失，更在于对已编码旋转信息的"使用不足"；将内部表征中的粗粒度旋转线索显式回注，可有效缓解角度坍缩，且不损害通用能力。

title: T-JEPA: A Temporal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Learning Better Remote Sensing Representations
summary: Earth observation (EO) data provide rich temporal supervision, yet existing remote sensing foundation models mainly exploit sequential observations through imposing predefined pairwise relations or aggregating holistic reconstruction context. We seek to further exploit the sparse and nonuniform temporal sampling inherent in EO sequences as supervisory signals. To this end, we propose T-JEPA, a temporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns time-gap-conditioned latent transitions. A shared single-frame encoder processes each observation, while a temporal predictor estimates the complete target latent field from a masked source latent representation and the actual elapsed time. Across multiple temporal intervals, these predictive constraints organize observed states into structured latent trajectories. Asymmetric metadata injection mitigates shortcut learning, and direct supervision across multiple temporal scales proves more effective than recursively rolling out intermediate states. In parallel, masked pixel reconstruction provides complementary supervision for preserving spatial details. Under matched pre-training data and throughput, T-JEPA achieves leading transfer performance on both static and temporal tasks. Analyses further reveal that T-JEPA learns representations with time-gap-dependent transition predictability and coherent latent dynamics, while maintaining strong cross-period consistency, representation diversity, and semantic discriminability.

AI.tldr: 提出T-JEPA，一种时间联合嵌入预测架构，利用地球观测序列中稀疏非均匀的时间采样作为监督信号，学习时间间隔条件化的潜在状态转移。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型对时序观测的利用方式有限：要么施加预定义的成对关系，要么聚合整体重建上下文，均未充分利用EO序列中稀疏且非均匀采样的特性作为监督信号。
AI.method: T-JEPA采用共享单帧编码器处理每个观测；时间预测器在给定掩码源潜在表示与真实经过时间的情况下，估计完整的目标潜在场。跨多个时间区间施加预测约束，将观测状态组织为结构化潜在轨迹。采用非对称元数据注入缓解捷径学习；提出直接多时间尺度监督优于递归展开中间状态；并行引入掩码像素重建，以保留空间细节作为互补监督。
AI.result: 在匹配预训练数据与吞吐量的条件下，T-JEPA在静态任务与时间任务上均取得领先的迁移性能。分析表明其表征具有时间间隔依赖的转移可预测性、连贯的潜在动态，并保持较强的跨周期一致性、表征多样性与语义可判别性。
AI.conclusion: 将时间间隔作为显式条件融入联合嵌入预测，可有效利用EO稀疏非均匀时序作为自监督信号，并同时提升静态与时间任务的迁移表现。

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

AI.tldr: 提出免训练混合线性注意力框架HLA-WM，通过几何引导检索与分块递归线性状态重组，缓解Gated DeltaNet长程遗忘问题，在长视频世界模型中提升场景一致性并大幅降低历史状态内存。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频世界模型需持久记忆以维持场景一致性。Softmax注意力靠不断增长的KV缓存保留全部历史，但内存开销大；循环线性注意力（如Gated DeltaNet）以固定尺寸状态压缩历史，内存成本低，却存在严重的长程遗忘：远处但相关的场景信息会被后续状态更新逐渐衰减。
AI.method: HLA-WM为免训练混合线性注意力框架，结合粗粒度几何引导检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算。利用GDN的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块转移摘要（chunk-wise transition summaries），借助相机几何检索与场景相关的历史块，并将其重组为查询特定的循环状态。
AI.result: 在60秒SANA-WM-Bench上，无需额外训练即改善基座自回归生成器全部六项重访一致性与相机控制指标，包括PSNR提升0.74 dB、旋转误差降低28.5%；经下游精炼后仍保持提升。在MBench-A上跨547个样本、四个子集及所有推理模式，三项重访一致性指标均一致改善。60秒上下文下，历史状态内存较完整KV缓存减少12倍，推理吞吐最多仅下降1.6%。
AI.conclusion: 可选择寻址的循环记忆能提升长程场景召回，同时保留GDN的效率优势，验证了混合线性注意力在长时程视频世界模型中的有效性。

title: Robust Local Optimization Done Right
summary: RANSAC scoring and local optimization (LO) impose different robustness requirements, motivating the separation of hypothesis selection from refinement. We systematically isolate the effects of robust-loss shape, incorrectly specified inlier scales, and optimization strategy on essential matrix, fundamental matrix, and homography estimation. A profile-marginal score marginalizes the nuisance inlier scale and selects an inlier partition, from which we estimate the scale that sets the LO loss width; this makes LO robust to an inlier scale specified too large, whereas one specified too small degrades selection itself. Refinement needs gradient from correspondences the seed currently rejects: optimizers that reweight from current residuals stay pinned to their seed, whereas methods with broad basins recover strongly perturbed seeds yet degrade accurate score-selected hypotheses, so basin size alone is insufficient to assess RANSAC LO. Joint half-quadratic optimization balances the two and is the most consistent strategy across model classes. An optimizer matched to the profile-marginal score, which never decreases it, does not reach the best accuracy, challenging the prescription that scoring and refinement objectives should match. Composed from these findings, our RANSAC reduces the median essential-matrix pose error of a state-of-the-art RANSAC on PhotoTourism from 2.23 degrees to 1.58 degrees with a correctly specified inlier scale and from 38 degrees to 6.2 degrees when it is grossly misspecified (128x too large).

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了RANSAC中假设选择与局部优化(LO)的鲁棒性差异，分析了鲁棒损失形状、内点尺度错误设定及优化策略对本质矩阵、基础矩阵和单应估计的影响，提出了基于profile-marginal得分的RANSAC框架。
AI.motivation: RANSAC的评分(scoring)与局部优化(LO)具有不同的鲁棒性需求，这促使我们将假设选择与精化(refinement)分离。然而，鲁棒损失形状、内点尺度错误设定以及优化策略如何分别影响不同模型类别的估计尚缺乏系统性认识，且普遍认为评分与精化目标应匹配的假设需要验证。
AI.method: 提出profile-marginal得分，对冗余的内点尺度进行边缘化并选择内点划分，据此估计设定LO损失宽度的尺度。系统性地分离了三个因素的作用：鲁棒损失形状、错误设定的内点尺度、优化策略，并在本质矩阵、基础矩阵和单应估计上进行评估。引入联合半二次(joint half-quadratic)优化，并设计了一个与profile-marginal得分匹配的优化器。
AI.result: profile-marginal得分使LO对过大的内点尺度具有鲁棒性，但过小的尺度会损害选择本身。精化需要来自种子当前拒绝的对应点的梯度：从当前残差重加权的优化器会固守其种子，而宽盆地方法能恢复强扰动的种子却会降低准确评分选择假设的质量，因此仅凭盆地大小不足以评估RANSAC LO。联合半二次优化平衡了两者，跨模型类别最一致。与profile-marginal得分匹配的优化器虽从不降低该得分，却未达到最佳精度。最终RANSAC将PhotoTourism上SOTA的median本质矩阵位姿误差从2.23°降至1.58°(尺度正确时)，从38°降至6.2°(尺度严重错误，128倍过大时)。
AI.conclusion: 评分与精化的鲁棒性需求不同，应将其分离；profile-marginal得分与联合半二次优化相结合能在不同模型类别上取得一致且更优的表现，挑战了"评分与精化目标应匹配"的传统观点。

title: A new design of a fall detection system integrating landmark identification and deep learning techniques
summary: This article introduces an innovative system that integrates landmark identification with deep learning to enhance fall detection accuracy and reliability. By utilizing advanced computer vision techniques, such as Media Pipe for spatial recognition, the system effectively differentiates between routine movements and actual falls. The integration of landmarks with a deep learning prediction algorithm minimizes false alarms, ensuring timely responses to genuine falls. Comprehensive experimentation underscores the system's versatility across various scenarios, emphasizing its potential to improve safety and independence for older adults. The training process demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy, stabilizing by the 40th cycle, while error rates decline significantly during the initial cycles. Real-time experiments, involving both male and female participants aged 8 to 50, recorded a remarkable 95% detection rate of falls, demonstrating the system's effectiveness and promising future applications in elder care and smart health monitoring environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将关键点(landmark)识别与深度学习相融合的跌倒检测系统，利用MediaPipe进行空间识别以区分日常动作与真实跌倒，从而降低误报。实验显示模型准确率在第40轮训练后趋于稳定，实时测试中8至50岁男女被试的跌倒检测率达95%。
AI.motivation: 提升跌倒检测的准确性与可靠性，减少误报，以便对真实跌倒做出及时响应，并增强老年人的安全与独立生活能力，服务于养老照护与智能健康监测场景。
AI.method: 采用计算机视觉技术，特别是MediaPipe进行空间(关键点)识别；将关键点信息与深度学习预测算法相结合，构建跌倒检测系统，在多场景下开展训练与实时实验。
AI.result: 训练过程中准确率稳步上升并在第40个训练周期趋于稳定，误差率在初期周期显著下降；实时实验中，8至50岁男女参与者取得95%的跌倒检测率。
AI.conclusion: 关键点识别与深度学习结合可有效区分常规动作与跌倒，提升检测性能并抑制误报，在老年照护和智能健康监测等领域具有良好应用前景。

title: Vision-enabled detection of safety helmet compliance in construction zones
summary: In the rapidly evolving field of construction management, worker safety remains a top priority. This paper introduces an innovative vision-based system for real-time detection of helmet compliance, specifically designed for construction sites, utilizing advanced computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms within the YOLO (you only look once) framework. Our system leverages high-resolution video feeds from strategically positioned cameras to monitor adherence to safety regulations regarding helmet usage. By employing deep learning methodologies, the system effectively identifies individuals not wearing helmets, thereby significantly mitigating the risk of head injuries among workers. Our training and validation results revealed an impressive precision exceeding 97% at mAP@0.5 for both helmeted and non-helmeted individuals. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate exceptional detection accuracy, demonstrating the system's resilience under varying lighting conditions and diverse worker movements. The consistent decrease in loss and improvement in metrics throughout training validates the effectiveness of the YOLOv8 model in enhancing recognition performance. The implications of this research extend beyond mere regulatory compliance, opening avenues for innovative applications in occupational safety management. This study highlights the critical role of technology in protecting lives and lays the groundwork for future advancements in smart construction environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于YOLOv8的视觉实时安全帽佩戴检测系统，用于施工场地监管，mAP@0.5超过97%，验证了模型在不同光照与工人动作下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 施工管理中工人安全是首要任务，安全帽佩戴的实时合规监管需求迫切，需要借助计算机视觉与深度学习提升检测效率与覆盖范围，降低头部受伤风险。
AI.method: 采用YOLO框架（YOLOv8）结合深度学习算法，利用战略性布置摄像头采集的高分辨率视频流，构建面向施工场地的实时安全帽合规检测系统，识别未佩戴安全帽人员并设置佩戴/未佩戴两类目标。
AI.result: 训练与验证结果显示，佩戴与未佩戴安全帽两类目标的mAP@0.5精度均超过97%；在不同光照条件和多样工人动作下保持优异检测精度；训练过程中损失持续下降、指标持续提升。
AI.conclusion: YOLOv8模型在提升识别性能方面有效，研究意义超越合规监管，为职业安全管理创新应用与智能建造环境发展奠定基础。

title: A Three-Dimensional Reverse-Projection Method for Sparse Point Cloud Completion and Its Application to High-Speed Train Nose Reconstruction
summary: Holes in LiDAR scans of environments with glass windows remain an unresolved problem in three-dimensional reconstruction. This study presents a pipeline for point cloud acquisition, filtering, completion, and surface reconstruction to address sparse sampling and missing window regions in scans of a high-speed train nose. FAST-LIVO2 provides the initial point cloud through multisensor odometry and mapping, and moving least squares (MLS) smooths the observations. We then introduce three-axis projection-based subdivision and interpolation with reverse hole boundary identification, referred to as three-axis reverse completion. The method interpolates missing regions from observations around each hole. Greedy projection triangulation, Poisson surface reconstruction, and a Marching Cubes-based pipeline generate meshes from the completed point cloud. Experiments on a proportionally scaled display model of a high-speed train nose show that the proposed method fills missing point cloud regions around the glass windows. Under the evaluation setting used in this study, greedy projection triangulation yields lower geometric distance errors than the other two reconstruction pipelines. The pipeline supports non-contact digital modeling of train nose geometry and provides a practical approach to reconstructing objects with glass windows.

AI.tldr: 提出一体化点云获取-滤波-补全-曲面重建流程，解决高铁车头玻璃窗区域点云空洞问题，并用三种重建方法对比验证。
AI.motivation: 含玻璃窗环境的LiDAR扫描存在空洞，导致高速列车车头等对象的扫描出现稀疏采样与缺失区域，三维重建不完整，且玻璃窗区域难以直接观测。
AI.method: 采用FAST-LIVO2多传感器里程计与建图获取初始点云，先以移动最小二乘（MLS）平滑观测；随后提出基于三轴投影的细分与插值，并结合反向空洞边界识别（三轴反向补全）对每个空洞周边观测进行插值填补；最后分别用贪婪投影三角化、泊松曲面重建及基于Marching Cubes的流程生成网格。
AI.result: 在按比例缩放的某型高速列车车头展示模型实验中，所提方法成功填补玻璃窗周围的缺失点云区域；在本文评价设定下，贪婪投影三角化相较其他两种重建流程具有更低的几何距离误差。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可支持车头几何的非接触式数字化建模，为含玻璃窗物体的点云重建提供了一种可行途径。

title: Controllable Road Marking Generation
summary: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings. We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可控道路标线生成"任务，从可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线和文本描述合成中心区域标线布局，并构建条件BEV生成流水线，在Argoverse 2与Waymo上大幅超越适配的SOTA掩码细化基线。
AI.motivation: 道路与车道标线对车辆导航和多智能体协同至关重要，但大规模标线制作仍依赖人工流程，限制了定量分析与场景测试，因此需要可自动生成且可控的标线布局方法。
AI.method: 任务设定为从可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线与文本描述生成缺失的中心区域标线，输出车道分隔线、道路分隔线与人行横道三通道；基准采用确定性的、由元数据导出的提示。方法为条件BEV流水线：(i) 文本条件潜空间rectified-flow DiT，配合拓扑感知辅助损失；(ii) 高斯模糊训练目标以稳定薄而稀疏标线的学习；(iii) 免训练后处理SGR，通过提取折线、拟合三次贝塞尔曲线并以各向异性超高斯基元重渲染，恢复清晰的分隔线几何。
AI.result: 在4,597个Argoverse 2测试瓦片上获得Buffered F1 80.8与clDice 50.2，而适配的SOTA掩码细化基线仅为38.8与24.6；在Waymo数据集上取得88.0 Buffered F1与66.2 clDice。组件消融显示拓扑感知监督与SGR带来互补的连通性增益；文本编辑实验表明更强引导提升编辑成功率，但也增加对非目标结构的改动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为仿真可用的标线变化生成、自动化地图补全和早期基础设施设计探索迈出了一步。

title: AdaSpark: Adaptive DSpark with Online Learning for Tree Verification and N-gram Fill
summary: Block drafters such as DSpark propose ranked candidates for several positions in one forward pass, and a tree verifier checks them in one pass of the target. The number of rows to verify trades the tokens a wider tree is expected to accept against the time a wider verify takes. Most schedulers that choose this number take the verify time from a table or model measured before serving, corrected online by at most one scale factor, and take acceptance from the drafter's confidence estimates or from a map fitted offline. AdaSpark learns both quantities while it serves, with no profile, calibration or sweep in advance. It learns which verify widths are worth offering and fits each one's verify time as a function of context. It fits each candidate's acceptance probability to the target's verify outcomes, with the drafter's confidence head as one input, and orders and sizes the tree by that fit instead of by the head. The same model prices n-gram continuations of the request's own text, so drafted and text-derived candidates compete for rows in one best-first order. The width is chosen by pricing time at the long-run decode rate. On single- and multi-turn conversations from six public datasets, on three dense targets and one mixture-of-experts target, AdaSpark decodes 1.5-3.1x faster than llama.cpp's DSpark with the same drafters. Our imparo engine with AdaSpark is 1.17-1.52x faster than imparo running with a three-token chain (the default llama.cpp setting); this gain comes from the scheduler alone. Without a width sweep, AdaSpark is never more than 0.3% slower than the best pinned tree width on any dense target or context band. On the mixture-of-experts target it ties the best pinned width, and the other pinned widths from 4 to 16 rows are 5-14% slower.

AI.tldr: AdaSpark：一种在线学习验证宽度与接受概率的投机解码调度器，无需预先剖析、校准或扫描，在多个数据集与目标模型上实现1.5–3.1倍加速。
AI.motivation: 块起草（如DSpark）一次前向提出多个候选并由树验证器一次验证，验证行数的选择需在更宽树带来的接受token数与验证耗时之间权衡。现有调度器多依赖服务前测得的查表/模型（在线仅作单一缩放因子校正），接受率来自起草器置信度或离线拟合映射，缺乏在线自适应能力。
AI.method: AdaSpark在服务过程中在线学习两个量：一是各验证宽度的验证时间随上下文变化的拟合函数，并判断哪些宽度值得提供；二是将每个候选的接受概率拟合到目标模型的验证结果上，以起草器置信度头作为一个输入特征，并据此（而非直接用置信度头）对树进行排序与定尺寸。同一模型对请求自身文本的n-gram续写定价，使起草候选与文本派生候选在同一best-first顺序中竞争行数。宽度通过按长期解码速率对时间定价来选择。
AI.result: 在六个公共数据集的单轮与多轮对话上，针对三个密集目标与一个专家混合目标：AdaSpark比llama.cpp的DSpark（相同起草器）解码快1.5–3.1倍；使用AdaSpark的imparo引擎比采用三token链（llama.cpp默认）的imparo快1.17–1.52倍，且该增益仅来自调度器。无需宽度扫描时，AdaSpark在任何密集目标或上下文区间上比最佳固定树宽度最多慢0.3%。在专家混合目标上并列最佳固定宽度，其余4至16行的固定宽度慢5–14%。
AI.conclusion: AdaSpark以零预剖析、零校准、零扫描的在线学习方式，同时优化验证宽度调度与候选接受建模，并统一起草与文本派生候选的竞争排序，在密集与MoE目标上均取得显著且稳健的加速效果。

title: InteractionBench: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Streaming Video Systems
summary: A video assistant must speak when its instruction warrants a response and stay silent otherwise. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates this decision for the complete system of model, memory, and response controller. InteractionBench covers query responses, event triggers, and ongoing updates in 1,060 interactions over 812 videos, with 69 negative streams and 53 suites that pair counted events with look-alike near misses. It scores content accuracy, timing accuracy, and silence compliance on the video clock. Timely speech costs silence across systems. Polled Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 77.8 timing accuracy but 10.9 silence compliance. A native real-time interaction system reaches 29.2 silence compliance at 66.8 timing accuracy, yet emits on 89.9% of negative streams. No open-weight system clears a third of the near-miss suites. Fewer replies help only when chosen, as random deletion merely trades timing for silence. Offline scores miss these failures and mispredict online behavior. Adding restraint is costly, as the native system's controller adds little by itself and agentic systems add it only at about 30 s per poll.Project page: https://www.enxinsong.com/projects/interactionbench/ Code: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/InteractionBench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InteractionBench/InteractionBench

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 InteractionBench 基准，用于评估视频助手系统在"该说时说、不该说时保持沉默"上的决策能力，涵盖查询响应、事件触发和持续更新三类交互。
AI.motivation: 现有评测多关注离线内容准确率，无法衡量视频助手在正确时机发言与保持沉默的完整系统能力，也预测不了在线行为。
AI.method: 构建含 1,060 次交互、812 段视频的基准，设 69 个负例流与 53 个"计数事件+近似干扰"套件，按视频时钟评测内容准确率、时机准确率与沉默合规率。
AI.result: 轮询式 Qwen3-VL-8B 时机准确率 77.8% 但沉默合规仅 10.9%；原生实时系统沉默合规 29.2%、时机准确率 66.8%，却在 89.9% 负例流上误发言；无开源权重系统通过三分之一近似干扰套件。
AI.conclusion: 及时发言以牺牲沉默为代价，随机删减回复无法两全，离线分数无法预测在线表现，增加克制能力代价高昂，呼吁在完整系统层面重新评测视频助手。

title: Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces
summary: Agent skills that record procedural instructions are increasingly mined from execution traces rather than curated by hand. Skill-mining pipelines often use known task outcomes or feedback to guide skill construction. In production, reliable information on whether a run has succeeded may be unavailable. We study how the sampling of execution traces, access to success or failure information, and the form of the mined skills affect downstream task performance. Holding the mining pipeline fixed, we compare six combinations of mining evidence and skill forms. Mining evidence has three levels: successful trajectories only, successes and failures with their outcome labels, or the same mix with labels withheld. Skill form has two types: an ordered workflow plan, or a declarative ontology of entities, states, and policies. We evaluate the mined skills on two enterprise benchmarks, ThinkingBox-Bench and APEX-Agents. Analysis of task-level paired differences shows that the benefits of different configurations of mining evidence and skill forms depend on the enterprise domain. On ThinkingBox-Bench, paired differences show that workflows score better than ontology by 1.7 pp, Goldilocks beats success-only evidence type by 2.4 pp and Goldilocks blind simulating skills learnt without outcomes is worse by 3.1 pp. APEX-Agents shows a moderate preference for ontologies and no clear preference between evidence regimes. Within each domain, task structure related constraints drive uneven performance with mined skills. These findings motivate tailoring meta-skills to the demands of the target tasks rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.

AI.tldr: 该研究固定技能挖掘流程，比较三种挖掘证据与两种技能形式的六种组合，发现在企业基准上最优配置因领域而异，不存在通用方案。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能正日益从执行轨迹中自动挖掘，而非人工编写。现有挖掘流程多依赖已知任务结果或反馈来指导技能构建，但在生产环境中，任务是否成功的可靠信息往往不可得。因此需要研究轨迹采样方式、成功/失败信息的可获取性以及技能形式如何影响下游任务表现。
AI.method: 在固定挖掘流程的前提下，对两个因素做交叉对比，共六种组合：（1）挖掘证据三水平——仅成功轨迹、成功与失败并带结果标签、相同混合但隐去标签；（2）技能形式两类——有序工作流计划（workflow plan）或由实体、状态与策略构成的声明式本体（declarative ontology）。在 ThinkingBox-Bench 与 APEX-Agents 两个企业基准上评估，并采用任务级配对差异分析。
AI.result: ThinkingBox-Bench 上，工作流比本体高 1.7 个百分点；带标签的"黄金中道"证据比仅成功证据高 2.4 个百分点；隐去标签的盲挖技能则低 3.1 个百分点。APEX-Agents 上则对本体有中等偏好，且不同证据机制之间无明确优劣。领域内任务结构相关约束导致技能表现不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 挖掘证据与技能形式的收益依赖于具体企业领域，不存在一刀切的最优配置。应依据目标任务的需求定制元技能（meta-skills），而非采用统一方案。

title: MedicalHarness: A Controlled Evaluation of LLMs and Agent Harnesses on Medical Tasks
summary: LLM agents are increasingly built for medical work and scored on clinical benchmarks. Each such score, however, comes from a model running inside an agent harness, the system that controls the loop between the model and its environment. An agent's score is therefore a property of a model--harness pair. For medical agents, how much outcomes change with the harness has rarely been measured. Measuring this change, and explaining it, raises two challenges. First, a harness comparison must change nothing but the harness and be repeated across models and kinds of task. Second, comparing whole harnesses leaves their mechanisms bundled together, so it cannot show when an individual mechanism helps. To address these challenges, we present MedicalHarness, a controlled study of models and agent harnesses on medical tasks. We first build MedicalHarnessBench to evaluate agents on $107$ tasks across four domains that each test a different harness capability. Using this benchmark, we run five open-weight models under five agent harnesses, changing only the harness within a comparison, and analyze both outcomes and execution traces. To study individual mechanisms, we build MH-Lab, a controlled harness that switches off context management, planning or tool exposure one at a time within a shared execution loop. We find that the harness and its interaction with the model account for about a quarter of the outcome variance, and that no single harness is best across models and tasks. Code and data are available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MedicalHarness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MedicalHarness，一项针对医疗任务中模型与智能体框架（harness）的受控研究，发现框架及其与模型的交互约解释结果方差的四分之一，且不存在在所有模型与任务上均最优的单一框架。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在医疗工作中越来越多被使用并在临床基准上评分，但每个分数实际来自运行于智能体框架内的模型，因此分数属于"模型-框架"配对。对医疗智能体而言，框架变化会导致多少结果变化此前很少被测量，且该测量面临两大挑战：框架比较须仅改变框架并在多模型、多任务上重复；整框架比较无法分离各机制的作用。
AI.method: 作者构建MedicalHarnessBench，涵盖4个领域共107个任务，每个领域测试不同的框架能力；在5个开源权重模型与5个智能体框架下运行，比较时仅改变框架，并分析结果与执行轨迹。此外构建MH-Lab受控框架，在共享执行循环中逐个关闭上下文管理、规划或工具暴露，以研究单一机制的作用。
AI.result: 框架及其与模型的交互约解释结果方差的四分之一；没有任何单一框架在所有模型和任务上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 医疗智能体的评分应视为"模型-框架"配对的属性，框架设计对结果有实质影响且存在模型-任务依赖性；需通过受控基准与机制级分析来刻画框架贡献。代码与数据已公开。

title: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Importance-Guided Unified Compression and Editing Framework for AI-Generated Videos
summary: AI-generated videos are rapidly increasing in volume, duration, and resolution, creating growing demands for efficient storage and transmission. Unlike natural videos captured from the physical world, AI-generated videos are samples from a learned generative distribution, where semantic structures are critical to content consistency, while many local textures and stochastic details can be plausibly regenerated. This distinction suggests that compression should preserve semantically important spatiotemporal information rather than reconstruct every pixel of a particular generative sample. Beyond reconstruction, AI-generated videos also create a practical need for prompt-based editing, where users expect to modify generated content while preserving its original spatiotemporal semantics. Motivated by these observations, we propose a unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos that incorporates a frozen video generator as a reusable generative prior. Within this framework, we design three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques that respectively address what to transmit, how much to transmit, and how to use the transmitted side information. First, an innovation selection method projects the latent discrepancy using spatiotemporal semantic importance, so that the selected innovations prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method estimates the nonuniform semantic demands of latent frames and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, a unified reconstruction and editing method continuously adjusts the influence of the transmitted side information, enabling the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for faithful reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for structure-preserving prompt-driven editing.

AI.tldr: 提出面向AI生成视频的统一压缩与编辑框架，以冻结视频生成器为可复用生成先验，设计三种时空语义重要性引导技术，分别解决传什么、传多少、如何用传输的边信息三个问题。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频在体量、时长和分辨率上迅速增长，带来存储与传输压力。与自然视频不同，AI生成视频是学习到的生成分布的采样，语义结构决定内容一致性，而局部纹理和随机细节可被合理再生，因此压缩应保留语义上重要的时空信息而非逐像素重建。此外，用户还有基于提示词的编辑需求，要求在修改内容的同时保持原有时空语义。这两点共同促成了压缩与编辑统一框架的提出。
AI.method: 框架以冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三项时空语义重要性引导技术：（1）创新选择方法，用时空语义重要性投影隐空间差异，使选中的创新优先保留语义不变量而非可替换的生成变化；（2）帧自适应比特分配方法，估计隐空间帧的非均匀语义需求，为需要更强语义保留的帧分配更多创新；（3）统一重建与编辑方法，连续调节所传输边信息的影响强度，使同一压缩表示既能为忠实重建提供强引导，也能作为结构保持的提示驱动编辑的灵活语义锚点。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅陈述所提方法的机制设计：通过语义重要性引导的创新选择、帧自适应比特分配以及可调边信息影响强度，实现压缩表示在忠实重建与结构保持的提示驱动编辑两种用途间的统一支持。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将AI生成视频的压缩与编辑统一到一个以冻结生成器为先验的框架中，利用生成分布的语义特性替代逐像素保真目标，并借助同一压缩表示同时服务重建与编辑，为AI生成视频的高效存储、传输与可编辑性提供了新思路。

title: CLARA: Can AI Assess Developmental Appropriateness in Children's Stories?
summary: Assessing the developmental suitability of children's narratives is important for educational recommendation and developmental literacy research, yet such assessment typically relies on subjective and difficult-to-scale human judgment. This raises an important question: Can AI systems approximate human developmental judgments of children's stories? To study this problem, we introduce CLARA, a cognitively grounded framework for developmental narrative understanding through structured annotation across cognitive (COG), language (LAN), and social-emotional (SEL) dimensions, together with a bilingual benchmark resource containing 1107 Chinese--English children's stories with normalized silver developmental references and structured developmental annotations. We evaluate CLARA through benchmark comparison, component analysis, translated bilingual consistency analysis, and blinded human evaluation with educators. Experimental results show that structured developmental annotation achieves substantially stronger alignment with developmental references and human judgments than readability-based methods and direct prompting baselines. Overall, our findings suggest that AI systems can approximate certain aspects of human developmental judgment when guided by structured developmental annotation, while also highlighting the importance of interpretability and human oversight in educational NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLARA框架与中英双语儿童故事基准（1107篇），通过认知、语言、社会情感三维结构化标注评估叙事发展适宜性，实验表明结构化标注比可读性方法和直接提示更接近人类发展判断。
AI.motivation: 儿童叙事发展适宜性评估对教育推荐与发展素养研究很重要，但通常依赖主观且难以规模化的人类判断。核心问题是：AI系统能否近似人类对儿童故事的发展性判断。
AI.method: 提出CLARA——基于认知的发展性叙事理解框架，在认知（COG）、语言（LAN）、社会情感（SEL）三个维度进行结构化标注；构建包含1107篇中英双语儿童故事、含归一化银标发展参照与结构化发展标注的双语基准资源；评估方式包括基准比较、组件分析、翻译双语一致性分析和与教育工作者合作的盲测人类评估。
AI.result: 结构化发展标注与发展参照及人类判断的一致性显著优于基于可读性的方法和直接提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 在结构化发展标注引导下，AI系统可在某些方面近似人类发展性判断；同时教育NLP中可解释性与人类监督仍然重要。

title: FairRSFM: A Biome-Aware Benchmark and Debiasing Framework for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
summary: Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) are commonly evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide systematic performance disparities across ecological regions. We introduce FairRSFM, a biome-aware benchmark for evaluating ecological group robustness in RSFMs. FairRSFM maps georeferenced samples from 14 terrestrial biome classes into six ecologically meaningful macro-groups and evaluates models under a unified frozen-backbone evaluation protocol. The benchmark covers four downstream datasets: m-EuroSAT, m-BigEarthNet, m-SA-Crop-Type, and MMEarth20K with Dynamic World label maps. Using Prithvi-EO-2.0, SatMAE, and DOFA across three random seeds, we show that aggregate performance consistently masks biome-dependent disparities across architectures and tasks. For example, Prithvi-EO-2.0 reaches 90.98% overall macro-F1 on m-EuroSAT but a mean worst-group score of only 83.72%, while m-SA-Crop-Type drops from 27.30% overall mIoU to 18.47% in the Xeric and Mineralogical group. We further evaluate Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing (BOLP), Dynamic Biome Reweighting (DBR), and GroupDRO as complementary mitigation baselines. Their effectiveness is model- and task-dependent; for example, BOLP improves Prithvi-EO-2.0 worst-group F1@opt on m-BigEarthNet from 46.12% to 50.27% without updating the RSFM backbone. FairRSFM provides a reusable protocol for diagnosing and mitigating ecological robustness gaps in remote sensing foundation models. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/aminurhossain/FairRSFM.

AI.tldr: FairRSFM是一个生物群系感知的基准，用于评估遥感基础模型（RSFM）在生态群组上的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型常用聚合指标评估，会掩盖跨生态区域的系统性性能差异。
AI.method: 将14个陆地生物群系类别映射为6个生态宏组，在冻结核评估协议下，覆盖m-EuroSAT、m-BigEarthNet、m-SA-Crop-Type和MMEarth20K四个数据集，使用Prithvi-EO-2.0、SatMAE、DOFA三个模型和三个随机种子，并评估BOLP、DBR、GroupDRO三种缓解基线。
AI.result: 聚合性能一致掩盖了生物群系相关差异。例如Prithvi-EO-2.0在m-EuroSAT总体macro-F1达90.98%，但平均最差组仅83.72%；m-SA-Crop-Type从总体mIoU 27.30%降至Xeric and Mineralogical组的18.47%。BOLP在不更新主干的情况下将Prithvi-EO-2.0在m-BigEarthNet的最差组F1@opt从46.12%提升到50.27%。
AI.conclusion: FairRSFM提供了可复用协议，用于诊断和缓解遥感基础模型中的生态鲁棒性差距，代码和数据集已开源。

title: Adaptive Utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation via Conditioned Gating
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) achieves parameter-efficient fine-tuning by constraining model updates to a low-rank subspace and has been widely used in practice. However, LoRA typically employs a shared low-rank update across tokens, which limits its ability to fully exploit the adaptation subspace for tokens from different sequences. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation (U-LoRA), which employs conditioned gating to explicitly learn effective token-level utilization of the limited low-rank adaptation subspace. Specifically, U-LoRA generates utilization coefficients along low-rank directions for each token and jointly coordinates and constrains them using sequence-level contextual information, thereby inducing more consistent adaptive patterns within a sentence. To further enhance training stability, we introduce a bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) historical prior that calibrates utilization signals across optimization steps, suppressing noise caused by batch-to-batch fluctuations. The effectiveness of our method arises from a better utilization of the existing low-rank subspace via input-conditioned strategies, rather than from expanding the subspace. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate that U-LoRA achieves competitive performance under comparable parameter budgets when with strong LoRA baselines and recent variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出U-LoRA，通过条件门控为每个token自适应生成低秩方向利用系数，并用序列级上下文协同约束，结合偏差校正的EMA历史先验提升训练稳定性，在不扩展低秩子空间的前提下更充分地利用现有子空间，在数学推理与自然语言理解任务上取得具竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: LoRA通过在低秩子空间约束模型更新实现参数高效微调，但通常对所有token共享同一个低秩更新，难以充分利用适应子空间来应对来自不同序列的不同token，限制了其表达能力与适配效果。
AI.method: 提出U-LoRA：1) 采用条件门控，为每个token沿低秩方向生成利用系数，显式学习token级的子空间利用方式；2) 利用序列级上下文信息对这些系数进行联合协调与约束，使同一句子内形成更一致的自适应模式；3) 引入偏差校正的指数移动平均（EMA）历史先验，跨优化步校准利用信号，抑制批次间波动带来的噪声。
AI.result: 在数学推理与自然语言理解基准上，U-LoRA在参数量预算相当的情况下，与强LoRA基线及近期变体相比取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 方法有效性来源于通过输入条件化策略对现有低秩子空间进行更好利用，而非扩展子空间本身；表明token级自适应利用与序列级协调是提升LoRA适配效率的有效途径。

title: Gauss-Map Variation for Image Denoising: Geometric Analysis and an Anderson--Accelerated Majorization--Minimization Method
summary: We propose a Gauss-map variation (GMV) model for image denoising that measures the spatial variation of the tangent-plane projectors of the scaled image graph. We establish an equivalent representation of the regularizer in terms of the corresponding Gauss map and, using differential geometric tools including tubular coordinates and the Frenet frame, analyze its behavior across general $C^2$ and piecewise $C^2$ boundaries. The resulting estimates provide edge- and corner-contrast preservation properties. To solve the proposed model, we introduce a bilinear decomposition involving a unit normal field and a scalar magnitude field and develop an Anderson-accelerated majorization--minimization algorithm. The normal field subproblem admits an explicit pointwise majorization--minimization update, which is combined with an Anderson acceleration. For both $L^1$ and $L^2$ data fidelity terms, we establish sufficient decrease and boundedness of the iterates and prove that the generated sequence converges to a critical point of the penalized model. Numerical experiments on synthetic and natural images demonstrate the boundary preserving capability of the proposed model and its competitive performance in removing Gaussian and impulsive noise.

AI.tldr: 提出基于缩放图像图切平面投影器空间变化的Gauss映射变分（GMV）去噪模型，用微分几何工具分析其边界保持性质，并设计Anderson加速的majorization-minimization算法求解。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪中如何在学习/变分模型中有效保持边界与角点等几何结构，是提升去噪质量的关键问题，需构造能刻画空间变化并保持边缘、角点对比度的正则项。
AI.method: 1) 定义GMV正则项，度量缩放图像图切平面投影器的空间变化；2) 给出正则项在Gauss映射下的等价表示，并利用管状坐标与Frenet标架等微分几何工具，分析其在一般C^2及分段C^2边界处的行为；3) 通过法向单位场与标量幅值场的双线性分解求解模型；4) 设计Anderson加速的majorization-minimization算法，法向子问题有显式逐点MM更新；5) 对L^1和L^2数据保真项证明迭代的充分下降性、有界性及收敛到临界点。
AI.result: 理论估计显示该正则项具有边缘和角点对比度保持性质；算法在L^1与L^2保真下具有充分下降、有界性并收敛到惩罚模型临界点。合成与自然图像实验表明模型具备边界保持能力，在去除高斯噪声和脉冲噪声方面具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GMV模型将微分几何视角引入图像去噪，在理论上有边界保持保证、算法上收敛性可证，实验上在高斯与脉冲噪声去除中表现有竞争力，为结构保持型变分去噪提供了新途径。

title: Plan Canvas: Fixed Reasoning Regions for Continuous Language Flows
summary: Continuous language flows generate text by denoising all positions of a target canvas together. The natural way to add reasoning to such a model is to write a trace ahead of the answer, but the trace length changes from question to question. The answer start is therefore unknown during denoising, and the model has to decide the trace length, the place of every trace token, and the answer at the same time. We propose Plan Canvas to fix the boundary between the trace and the answer. A plan region of fixed capacity holds a compact trace, supervised padding fills its unused positions, and the answer starts at a fixed position. The fixed regions also allow separate denoising clocks for the plan and for the answer. With the trace text, backbone, and canvas length of the free-trace baseline held fixed, Plan Canvas improves accuracy on ProsQA and on Deep ProsQA, a graph benchmark with longer proofs. On Deep ProsQA, accuracy rises from 73.0\% to 87.0\%, the share of questions answered with a valid path rises from 30.8\% to 59.1\%, and the gain is largest on the longest proofs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan Canvas，通过固定“计划区”与“答案区”边界，解决连续语言流扩散模型中推理轨迹长度不定导致的答案起点未知问题，在 ProsQA 与 Deep ProsQA 上提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 连续语言流模型通过同时去噪整个目标画布生成文本，若要在答案前写入推理轨迹，由于不同问题的轨迹长度不同，去噪时答案起始位置未知，模型需同时决定轨迹长度、每个轨迹 token 的位置以及答案，这增加了建模难度。
AI.method: Plan Canvas 固定轨迹与答案的边界：设置容量固定的计划区存放紧凑轨迹，用监督填充填补未使用位置，答案从固定位置开始；固定分区还允许为计划区和答案区设置独立的去噪时钟。实验保持轨迹文本、骨干模型和画布长度与自由轨迹基线一致。
AI.result: 在 ProsQA 上准确率提升；在更长的图推理基准 Deep ProsQA 上，准确率从 73.0% 升至 87.0%，生成有效路径的问题占比从 30.8% 升至 59.1%，且在最长证明上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 固定计划与答案边界的 Plan Canvas 能在不改变轨迹文本、骨干和画布长度的前提下，显著改善连续语言流模型的推理准确率与有效路径生成率，尤其在长证明场景收益最大。

title: Level-of-Token Diffusion
summary: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion, a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout (Level-of-Token layout) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality-efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout's token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/.

AI.tldr: LoT Diffusion 提出显式的多分辨率 token 布局，实现图像与视频生成的自适应高效计算。
AI.motivation: 现有图像与视频扩散模型对所有区域分配等量计算，即使场景中不同区域的细节需求差异很大。细节的空间分布通常在生成前就已知，这为降低计算量提供了依据，但现有方法未利用这一先验。
AI.method: 提出 Level-of-Token（LoT）Diffusion 框架，将细节先验转化为显式的多分辨率 token 布局：token 表示为不同大小与形状的矩形 patch，在需要细节处分配更细 token，其余区域使用更粗 token。通过 patch 级非对称 flow 参数化和多分辨率 token 嵌入，将预训练扩散 transformer 适配到 LoT 布局，在仅处理缩减 token 序列的同时，保持每个去噪步的全分辨率 flow 预测。
AI.result: 在图像与视频生成任务中，LoT 提供了良好的质量-效率权衡，加速幅度由布局的 token 预算决定。布局来源包括语义 mask、边界框、纹理方差、景深线索以及智能体规划。
AI.conclusion: LoT Diffusion 可在保留预训练生成先验的前提下实现布局自适应生成，为扩散模型的自适应高效计算提供了可行方案。

title: Nash Equilibrium Text: A Game-Theoretic Decoding Framework for Text Generation
summary: Text revision has become an integral component of large language models. This paper formulates revision such that it admits a Nash equilibrium: Token positions are players, vocabulary items are actions, and each player's utility is the language model's log conditional probability. We motivate the revision by showing that Nash equilibria can have exponentially higher likelihood than autoregressive outputs as the sequence length grows. We further propose Nash decoding, an algorithm that reaches an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium in $O(1/\varepsilon)$ time given access to the joint probability of tokens conditioned on a prompt. In practice, we run Nash decoding using conditional probability estimates from large language models and evaluate the resulting equilibria on question-answering benchmarks. On CLAPNQ, PubMedQA, and CoQA, Nash equilibria obtained from masked language models achieve higher F1 and ROUGE scores than autoregressive models up to $18\times$ larger, without any fine-tuning or retraining, at the cost of additional test-time computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将文本修订建模为博弈，把token位置视为玩家、词表项视为动作、语言模型的对数条件概率视为效用，证明Nash均衡的似然可随序列长度增长指数级高于自回归输出，并提出Nash decoding算法在O(1/ε)时间内达到ε-Nash均衡，在多个问答基准上以掩码语言模型取得优于大至18倍自回归模型的F1和ROUGE分数。
AI.motivation: 文本修订已成为大语言模型的重要组成部分。作者希望为修订提供博弈论式的形式化，说明为何修订（而非单纯自回归生成）能带来更高可能性的输出，并解决自回归解码在序列增长时似然受限的问题。
AI.method: 将修订形式化为Nash均衡问题：token位置为玩家，词表项为动作，每个玩家的效用是语言模型的对数条件概率。理论上证明Nash均衡的似然随序列长度增长可指数级高于自回归输出。提出Nash decoding算法，在可获得以prompt为条件的token联合概率时，于O(1/ε)时间内达到ε-Nash均衡。实践中使用大语言模型的条件概率估计运行Nash decoding。
AI.result: 在CLAPNQ、PubMedQA和CoQA上，由掩码语言模型得到的Nash均衡相比大至18倍的自回归模型获得更高的F1和ROUGE分数，且无需任何微调或重训练，代价是额外的测试时计算。
AI.conclusion: 通过博弈论视角形式化文本修订并引入Nash decoding，可在测试时以额外计算换取更高质量的文本输出，掩码语言模型产生的均衡结果优于更大规模的自回归模型，表明修订式解码是提升大语言模型生成质量的有效途径。

title: Selecting Long-Horizon Trajectories for Reliable and Efficient Terminal-Agent Training
summary: Terminal agents are commonly trained by imitating long teacher trajectories, yet how much of each trajectory to supervise remains unexplored. We study the \emph{supervision horizon}, the number of trajectory tokens retained for training, and show that it is a key design axis for reliability and cost. Reliability improves with longer horizons but saturates: on Terminal-Bench, a 12K-token horizon solves more tasks than 16K ($29\pm0.7$ vs.\ $26\pm0.8$) while requiring 30\% less training time. The horizon also shapes agent behavior: short horizons cause premature termination, intermediate horizons yield productive error recovery, and long horizons induce over-persistence. We analyze this saturation through a bias--complexity bound, in which longer supervision reduces temporal supervision bias but increases finite-sample estimation error from more heterogeneous late-stage histories. Guided by this analysis, we propose \emph{selective long-horizon refinement}, which first trains on short prefixes and then refines only on continuations that are most likely under the warm-start model. It consistently outperforms full long-horizon training. At 16K, it raises successful attempts from $110\pm2.7$ to $126\pm2.1$ and tasks solved in at least six of eight attempts from $9\pm0.7$ to $14\pm0.6$; with half of the long-horizon data, it still reaches $122\pm2.4$ while cutting training time by 23\%. The gains transfer across benchmarks, from $64\pm2.6$ to $73\pm2.1$ on Terminal-Bench v2.0 and from $137\pm2.7$ to $155\pm2.2$ on OpenThoughts-TBLite. For long-horizon supervision, selecting the right trajectories matters more than training on all of them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究终端智能体模仿学习中的"监督视界"（保留用于训练的轨迹token数），发现可靠性随视界增长但会饱和，并据此提出"选择性长视界精炼"方法，在更少训练成本下持续优于全长视界训练。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体通常通过模仿长教师轨迹进行训练，但每条轨迹应被监督多少尚未被探索。作者将监督视界视为可靠性与成本的关键设计轴，揭示其与智能体行为（提前终止、错误恢复、过度坚持）之间的关系，并希望在不牺牲可靠性的前提下降低训练成本。
AI.method: 1) 定义并系统研究监督视界（保留的轨迹token数）；2) 通过偏差-复杂度界分析饱和现象：更长监督降低时间监督偏差，但因晚期历史更异质而增加有限样本估计误差；3) 提出选择性长视界精炼：先在短前缀上训练，再仅在最可能符合热启动模型的延续上精炼。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench上，12K token视界解决任务数多于16K（29±0.7 vs. 26±0.8），且训练时间减少30%。16K设置下，选择性精炼将成功尝试从110±2.7提升至126±2.1，至少六次成功（共八次）的任务从9±0.7提升至14±0.6；仅用一半长视界数据仍达122±2.4，训练时间减少23%。跨基准泛化：Terminal-Bench v2.0从64±2.6到73±2.1，OpenThoughts-TBLite从137±2.7到155±2.2。
AI.conclusion: 监督视界是可靠性与成本的关键设计轴，可靠性随视界增长但会饱和。对长视界监督而言，选择正确的轨迹比使用全部轨迹更重要，选择性长视界精炼可一致性地提升性能并降低成本，且效果可跨基准迁移。

title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
summary: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.

AI.tldr: 基于414行Kaggle衍生数据构建的旁遮普作物产量预测原型（集成模型R²=0.991）存在严重数据泄漏：该表实际仅46个独立观测，因按年温度连接导致作物-年份被复制9次。按整年留出后XGBoost的R²从0.994骤降至-0.20。去重后以及在FAOSTAT长表（1990–2024，70个观测）上，按作物的线性趋势（LOO RMSE=0.29吨/公顷）优于所有未使用年份信息的模型（0.84–1.06）。农药与温度变化均无法解释趋势残差；叶片健康分类器虽在去重后的PlantVillage上达99.87%准确率，但因无叶片图像与产量记录配对，其健康得分在产量模型中是构造的且无增益。作者将原型与这些负面发现一并报告。
AI.motivation: 产量预测对生产者决策（投入、储藏、进口）有实用价值，但小规模农业表格在换季时报告的精度往往失效。作者意图检验此类模型宣称精度的可靠性，并揭示数据泄漏、重复观测与不可配对特征等问题，同时提醒区分"空间变异"与"时间趋势"以及不可信的农药/温度解释。
AI.method: 1) 用Random Forest、XGBoost、SVR与Ridge堆叠集成，结合MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器，部署为带SHAP解释的Web应用。2) 对Kaggle衍生合并表（414行）作随机80/20划分，并与按年份留出（whole-year holdout）对比。3) 审计独立观测数：发现每年九条温度记录导致作物-年份被复制9次，实际仅46个独立观测。4) 在去重数据与FAOSTAT长表（1990–2024，70个观测）上比较按作物线性趋势与各机器学习模型（含/不含年份特征）。5) 检验农药使用与国家温度变化对趋势残差的解释力，比较Kaggle与FAOSTAT的农药序列（多为插补且两版本不一致）。6) 用独立地区级小麦面板（36个地区×13季）分解空间与时间变异。7) 对叶片分类器在去除近重复后的PlantVillage上评估，并检验叶片图像与产量记录的配对性。
AI.result:
- 随机80/20划分下集成模型R²=0.991；但该表仅46个独立观测（作物-年份被复制9次）。
- 按整年留出时，XGBoost在同一数据上R²由0.994降至-0.20。
- 去重及FAOSTAT长表上，按作物线性趋势（LOO RMSE=0.29吨/公顷）优于所有未提供年份的模型（0.84–1.06）。
- 农药使用与国家温度变化均无法解释趋势残差；Kaggle表中的农药收益在FAOSTAT上消失，后者农药序列多为插补且两版本不一致。
- 地区级小麦面板显示旁遮普大部分变异为空间性，地区均值加共同趋势即可匹敌所学模型。
- 叶片分类器在去重后PlantVillage上准确率99.87%，对336张未见病叶召回率96.4%；但无叶片图像与产量记录配对，健康得分系构造且对产量模型无增益。
AI.conclusion: 作者以原型加负面发现的方式警示：小表上的高R²可能源于重复观测导致的数据泄漏，随机划分会高估泛化能力，需采用按年份留出等时间外推评估；线性趋势在长序列上难以被机器学习超越，且农药与温度并非趋势驱动因素。叶片健康分类器虽分类性能高，但缺乏与产量记录的配对，其作为产量特征无效。整体提示应重视数据去重、独立观测计数、时间外推验证与特征配对性。

title: Dual-Rate Force-Image Control with Model-Based Orientation Limits for Robotic Ultrasound
summary: Robotic ultrasound couples a high-rate contact-force loop with slower, delayed image feedback, so image-guided ultrasound probe rotation can perturb contact force before the resulting image response is observed. We derive a closed-form orientation-rate limit that bounds the modeled rotation-induced estimated-force excursion over a finite horizon while accounting for disturbance rejection by the fast force loop. The limit depends on local contact stiffness, force-loop gains, a conservative rotation-to-force gain bound, the excursion budget, and the prediction horizon. We implement this model in a dual-rate controller with timestamp-based delay reconstruction and joint-torque-based force estimation, and evaluate it on a curved gelatin phantom using paired controller comparisons and component ablations. Relative to unconstrained image guidance, the proposed rate-limited controller reduced first-second root-mean-square (RMS) estimated-force error by 0.40 N while increasing cue-convergence time by 0.94 s. A fixed rate cap near the analytically predicted ceiling produced no resolvable difference in force error and converged 0.32 s faster, indicating that the principal practical value of the model is the rate-design rule rather than online prediction. Delay reconstruction had no resolvable effect at the tested latency. A single-subject popliteal scan demonstrated feasibility, although the image cue was noise-limited on heterogeneous tissue.

AI.tldr: 该研究推导了一个闭式旋转角速率上限，用于约束机器人超声在图像引导下的接触力超调，并在双速率控制器中实现与验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人超声中高速力控回路与慢速、带延迟的图像反馈耦合，图像引导下的探头旋转会在图像响应被观察到之前扰动力，需明确旋转速率的约束以保证接触力安全。
AI.method: 推导考虑快速力环扰动抑制、在有限时域内约束建模旋转所致估计力偏移的闭式角速率上限；该上限依赖局部接触刚度、力环增益、保守的旋转-力增益界、偏移预算与预测时域。在带时间戳延迟重建与关节力矩力估计的双速率控制器中实现，并在曲面明胶体模上做配对控制器对比与组件消融。
AI.result: 相比无约束图像引导，限速控制器将首秒RMS估计力误差降低0.40 N，但线索收敛时间增加0.94 s；接近解析预测上限的固定速率上限在力误差上无可分辨差异，且收敛快0.32 s。延迟重建在测试延迟下无可分辨影响。单受试腘动脉扫描验证了可行性，但异质组织上图像线索受噪声限制。
AI.conclusion: 该模型的主要实用价值在于提供速率设计规则而非在线预测；简单的固定速率上限即可实现与完整模型相当的性能。

title: HLA: Expressive Hybrid Linear Attention via Chunk-Wise Dynamic Mixing
summary: Linear attention enables efficient long-context autoregressive decoding by compressing history into recurrent states, but this compression can make selective access to sparse and distant information difficult. Existing chunk-based extensions increase memory capacity, yet learned chunk-mixing coefficients may remain fixed with respect to input content and therefore cannot adapt historical access to each query. We introduce \emph{Hybrid Linear Attention} (HLA), a query-dependent chunk-level attention mechanism for Gated DeltaNet (GDN). HLA represents each completed chunk as an exact affine state transition and computes content-dependent routing gates from compact, self-attentively pooled representatives. Each gate interpolates the corresponding historical transition with the identity map, controlling both the chunk's additive memory and its transformation of earlier states. Effective-support regularization further encourages concentrated routing for sparse inference. We evaluate HLA under both pretrained adaptation and from-scratch training. Across Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B, HLA consistently improves over native GDN and fixed chunk mixing, with gains of up to 5.57 percentage points on LongBench-V2 and 3.97 points on RULER. In a controlled from-scratch 1.3B setting trained for 100B tokens with a 4K context, HLA also improves RULER performance from 4K to 32K, with gains increasing from 0.83 points at 4K to 4.22 points at 32K. These results demonstrate that query-dependent composition of recurrent memory improves long-context modeling and remains effective beyond the training context while using compact per-chunk affine summaries. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Hybrid Linear Attention (HLA)，一种面向 Gated DeltaNet 的查询相关分块级注意力机制，通过内容相关的路由门控对已完成分块做仿射状态插值，显著提升长上下文建模能力。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力将历史压缩为递归状态，虽能高效进行长上下文自回归解码，但难以对稀疏且遥远的信息进行选择性访问。现有基于分块的方法虽增加了记忆容量，但其分块混合系数是学习得到且对输入内容固定，无法针对每个查询自适应地调整历史访问。
AI.method: HLA 将每个已完成分块表示为精确的仿射状态转移，并基于紧凑的自注意力池化代表向量计算内容相关的路由门控；每个门控将对应历史转移与恒等映射插值，从而同时控制该分块的加性记忆及对早期状态的变换。此外引入有效支撑正则化，促使路由集中以支持稀疏推理。
AI.result: 在预训练适配与从头训练两种设定下评估。Qwen3.5 0.8B 至 9B 模型上，HLA 稳定优于原生 GDN 和固定分块混合，LongBench-V2 最高提升 5.57 个百分点，RULER 提升 3.97 点。从头训练 1.3B（100B token、4K 上下文）设定下，HLA 在 4K 至 32K 的 RULER 上均有提升，增益从 4K 的 0.83 点增至 32K 的 4.22 点。
AI.conclusion: 查询相关的递归记忆组合方式能改善长上下文建模，且在使用紧凑的逐分块仿射摘要前提下，其效果可泛化至训练上下文之外。

title: Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating complex digital workflows across diverse applications. However, training highly capable and generalizable agents fundamentally relies on massive, high-fidelity visual-action trajectories, which are notoriously difficult to acquire. While human demonstrations are unscalable, existing GUI world models rely on text descriptions or HTML rendering, discarding crucial pixel-level visual details like icons and layout styles. To address this issue, we introduce Infinite-Dreamer, a simulation-free data synthesis method powered by a pixel-level Image Editing World Model. By conceptualizing GUI transitions as image editing tasks, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to describe action-induced UI changes as structured delta-text. We then fine-tune an image editing backbone to controllably synthesize realistic screenshot transitions. We utilize this model to generate both single-frame visual robustness data and multi-step imaginary trajectories. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we fine-tune the Qwen3-VL baseline solely on the synthesized data to obtain Infinite-Actor, and evaluate it on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated benchmarks. Infinite-Actor consistently outperforms the Qwen3-VL baselines across scales: Infinite-Actor-8B improves AndroidWorld Pass@1 by +4.45 and nearly doubles the MobileWorld Pass@3 success rate, while Infinite-Actor-2B improves Pass@1 by +9.05. Code is available at https://github.com/swaydy-n/Infinite-Dreamer.

AI.tldr: 提出 Infinite-Dreamer，一种基于像素级图像编辑世界模型的免仿真数据合成方法，将 GUI 状态转移建模为图像编辑任务，用 VLM 把动作引发的 UI 变化描述为结构化 delta-text，再微调图像编辑主干以可控合成逼真截图转变，进而生成单帧鲁棒性数据与多步想象轨迹；仅用合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 Infinite-Actor，在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld、AndroidControl-Curated 上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体的训练依赖大规模、高保真的视觉-动作轨迹，但此类数据获取困难：人工演示难以规模化，而现有 GUI 世界模型依赖文本描述或 HTML 渲染，丢失了图标、布局样式等关键像素级视觉细节。
AI.method: 将 GUI 状态转移视为图像编辑任务，利用 VLM 将动作引起的 UI 变化表述为结构化 delta-text；据此微调图像编辑主干模型，实现可控的真实截图转变合成；再用该模型生成单帧视觉鲁棒性数据与多步想象轨迹，仅以合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 基线得到 Infinite-Actor。
