AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld、AndroidControl-Curated 上评测：Infinite-Actor-8B 使 AndroidWorld Pass@1 提升 +4.45，MobileWorld Pass@3 成功率近乎翻倍；Infinite-Actor-2B 的 Pass@1 提升 +9.05，各规模均持续优于 Qwen3-VL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 像素级图像编辑世界模型可作为一种可扩展的免仿真数据合成范式，为 GUI 智能体提供高保真视觉-动作轨迹，显著提升其能力与泛化性。代码已开源。

title: Weave Mamba Fusion: Global Cross-Scale Interaction for Lightweight Face Detection
summary: Feature pyramid methods, from FPN to BiFPN, have achieved strong performance in face detection by fusing multi-scale features. However, detecting faces under unconstrained conditions, such as small scale, occlusion, and extreme pose, remains difficult, as it requires global cross-scale dependencies that local fusion cannot model. State space models such as Mamba provide global context with linear complexity by scanning features as a sequence, and therefore offer a promising direction for this problem. Nevertheless, such a scan needs the two pyramid scales combined into a single feature map, and the way they are combined determines whether cross-scale structure is preserved. Summation collapses the two scales before the scan, so the scan has no cross-scale structure to exploit, while concatenation keeps both scales but at far higher cost. To address this, we propose \textbf{Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)}, which interleaves two adjacent pyramid scales column by column so that each step of a horizontal bidirectional SS2D scan moves from one scale to the other. With partial-channel processing and parameter-free de-weaving, WMF enables efficient cross-scale interaction while preserving feature structure. Integrating WMF into every fusion node yields \textbf{WeaveBiFPN}, the neck of our \textbf{WeaveFace} detector. On WIDER FACE, WeaveFace achieves 91.41\% mean AP with only 0.34M parameters and 1.16 GFLOPs, outperforming prior detectors under 0.5M parameters. Its largest gains are on the Hard subset, where it reaches 87.14\% AP. The code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/dohun-mat/WeaveMambaFusion}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)与WeaveBiFPN，通过列交错两相邻金字塔尺度实现高效跨尺度融合，构建WeaveFace人脸检测器，在WIDER FACE上以0.34M参数、1.16 GFLOPs达到91.41% mAP。
AI.motivation: 特征金字塔方法（FPN、BiFPN）依赖局部融合，无法建模非受限条件下（小尺度、遮挡、极端姿态）人脸检测所需的全局跨尺度依赖。状态空间模型（如Mamba）以线性复杂度提供全局上下文，但需将两金字塔尺度合并为单一特征图：求和会在扫描前坍缩两尺度，使扫描无跨尺度结构可利用；拼接虽保留双尺度但代价过高。
AI.method: 提出Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)：将两个相邻金字塔尺度按列交错（column by column），使水平双向SS2D扫描的每一步在两个尺度间交替移动，从而在保留跨尺度结构的同时实现高效交互；结合部分通道处理（partial-channel processing）与无参数de-weaving降低成本。将WMF嵌入每个融合节点得到WeaveBiFPN，作为WeaveFace检测器的neck。
AI.result: 在WIDER FACE上，WeaveFace以仅0.34M参数和1.16 GFLOPs取得91.41%平均AP，优于参数量低于0.5M的已有检测器；在Hard子集上增益最大，达到87.14% AP。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过列交错扫描的跨尺度状态空间融合，可在极低参数量与计算量下有效建模全局跨尺度依赖，显著提升非受限人脸检测性能，尤其在困难样本上表现突出。

title: Certification of Real Images through Calibrated Content Authentication
summary: Generative models can synthesize high-quality inauthentic multimedia content that is already being misused at scale. We evaluate twenty deepfake detectors against ten generators released in the last four years and find accuracy decreasing over time, from near-perfect 99.5% to 76%. Adversarial perturbations further reduce every baseline detector to below 2% accuracy, effectively inverting the detector's assigned label. We argue that this unreliability reflects a fundamental ambiguity: generators can reproduce authentic content exactly (e.g., through memorization), so content alone cannot reveal the true provenance label. For this reason, content produced by a generator must admit a faithful reconstruction by that same generator, and finding such a reconstruction makes synthetic provenance plausible and authenticity plausibly deniable. We therefore propose and evaluate a detection paradigm that outputs a calibrated prediction of whether authenticity is plausibly deniable: a faithful reconstruction by any known generator establishes plausible deniability, while calibration bounds how often content from known generators fails to be reproduced. Our evaluation shows that (i) our detector can be calibrated so that at most 1% of generated content is wrongly certified, an operating point at which most baseline detectors reach near-zero recall, including the strongest with 93% accuracy; (ii) calibrating a stricter security threshold on attacked samples preserves this bound against adaptive adversaries within the evaluated bounded-perturbation attack space, whose perturbations break every baseline, but does not cover arbitrary adversarial transformations; and (iii) post-hoc verifiability is eroding, as 1,116 of 3,000 Reddit images resist reproduction by a 2022 generator, but only 55 to 79 resist reproduction by 2024 generators.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出深度伪造检测器随时间愈发不可靠，且对抗扰动可使其失效；作者主张"内容本身无法确定来源标签"，提出并评估一种输出"真实性可否被合理解释为不可归责（plausible deniability）"的校准检测范式。
AI.motivation: 生成模型可合成高质量虚假多媒体并被大规模滥用，但现有检测方法正逐渐失效。作者认为这种不可靠源于根本性的歧义：生成器可以精确复现真实内容（如通过记忆），因此单凭内容无法揭示真实来源标签，需要重新定义检测目标。
AI.method: 评估20个深度伪造检测器对近四年发布的10种生成器的表现；测试对抗扰动的影响。进而提出新检测范式：输出关于"真实性是否可被合理解释为不可归责"的校准预测——若任一已知生成器能对该内容实现忠实重构，则建立合理不可归责性（plausible deniability）；通过校准限制已知生成器内容无法被复现的比例。
AI.result: （i）检测器准确率随生成器迭代从99.5%降至76%；对抗扰动使所有基线检测器降至2%以下，实质翻转标签。（ii）新检测器可校准至至多1%生成内容被错误认证，此时多数基线检测器召回率接近零（含准确率93%的最强基线）；（iii）在评估的有界扰动攻击空间内，对受攻击样本采用更严格的安全阈值校准可维持该界限，但不覆盖任意对抗变换；（iv）事后可验证性正在衰退：3000张Reddit图像中，2022年生成器无法复现1116张，而2024年生成器仅55–79张无法复现。
AI.conclusion: 内容本身无法可靠判定来源，检测应从"真伪分类"转向"可校准的合理不可归责性预测"。该范式在高安全要求下仍能保持低误认证率并对抗有界扰动攻击，但对抗任意变换仍无保证；同时生成能力的提升正使真实内容的事后可验证性持续下降。

title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
summary: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"嫁接(grafting)"方法，通过在早期donor checkpoint上学习更新并迁移到后训练模型，实现off-policy合并在持续学习中帕累托优于SFT与OPSD。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中，对新数据做SFT易导致泛化差与灾难性遗忘，学界普遍认为on-policy训练是持续学习的必要条件。但实际场景中蕴含新知识/能力的数据往往是off-policy的；而将off-policy转为on-policy信号的方法（如OPSD）会引发推理崩溃，亟需新的解决路径。
AI.method: 提出 grafting 配方，改变更新的学习位置与应用方式：(1) 在更早的 donor checkpoint（理想情况下甚至早于预训练结束）上学习更新，再将权重更新应用于后训练模型；(2) 对权重更新进行缩放，等价于一种模型合并；(3) 当新数据分布远离后训练模型时，可选地掩码最敏感的更新方向。
AI.result: 在多种持续学习设定下——(1) 从专家轨迹蒸馏、(2) 用STaR与Pedagogical RL自改进、(3) 在预训练截止后注入知识——grafting 在新任务与旧任务性能上均帕累托优于SFT和OPSD，同时避免了昂贵的on-policy采样。
AI.conclusion: off-policy 合并在持续学习中优于 OPSD，工作挑战了"on-policy训练是RL训练模型持续学习必要条件"这一传统认知。

title: Learning to Learn a Language
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, Code: https://github.com/cbl/prior-fitted-language-model, weights: https://huggingface.co/lennartcb/pflm1
summary: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM)：一个仅用合成、非语言先验数据预训练的 300M 参数字节级 Transformer，在冻结权重下通过上下文前缀推断"语言"并预测后续。它在六种语言 Wikipedia 上把 bits-per-byte 从 8 降至 0.9–2.4（一百万字节上下文），并完成计数、近似加法、预测确定性序列及跨域压缩等任务，核心结论是"模型没有学会某种语言，而是学会了如何学习语言"。
AI.motivation: 研究语言的"学习机制"是否可以与具体自然语言解耦：检验一个从未接触真实语言的模型，能否仅凭上下文推断出训练中从未重复出现的语言结构，从而把"语言能力"还原为一种由先验分布赋予的元学习能力。
AI.method: 采用 300M 参数字节级 Transformer，仅在合成非语言先验样本上预训练；每条训练序列由从模型分布中重新采样的递归结构因果模型（recurrent structural causal model）生成，训练中从不出现重复语言。推理时权重冻结，模型仅依据真实文本前缀做上下文内推断并预测后续。所设计先验样本在统计上具备自然文本特征：Zipf 频率、缓慢的熵率收敛、长程依赖。
AI.result: 在六种语言的 Wikipedia 上，bits per byte 从均匀分布的 8 降至 0.9–2.4（上下文达一百万字节）。在数字输入下可学会计数、比较大小和近似加法；可预测 Rudin-Shapiro 序列与素数指示序列等确定性序列；并在包括源代码、语音在内的六个非文本领域实现低于 gzip 和 PPMd 的压缩效果。
AI.conclusion: PFLM 并未习得任何具体自然语言，而是习得了一种"在上下文中学习新语言"的元能力：只要数据具有可推断的潜在结构，模型即可从先验中迁移这种学习方式。这为语言建模、压缩与跨域序列预测提供了一种将有监督先验与上下文推断分离的范式。

title: fMRI-TAMCL: Text-Anchored Supervised Multimodal Contrastive Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Classification
summary: Resting-state fMRI is important in the classification of brain disorders, but highly multimodal and exhibits strong multisite heterogeneity. Existing methods fuse images, BOLD-based functional connectivity, and phenotypic data modalities. Unlike other medical imaging datasets, rs-fMRI datasets rarely include a text modality, so they are generated from phenotypic data or BOLD activations. These text generation methods rely on fixed assumptions for subjects, sites, devices, and protocols, leading to poor generalization across datasets. We propose fMRI-TAMCL, a text-anchored multimodal contrastive learning framework that integrates fMRI images, sparse FC, and generated subject-specific text. Its Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation module generates BOLD activation text, while Feature-Value Serialization module generates phenotypic text. All three modalities are encoded as clustered graphs, projected onto a shared unit hypersphere space, aligned using pairwise, text-anchored supervised contrastive learning, and fused with attention. fMRI-TAMCL proves its generalization capability across five datasets outperforming 29 baselines with 78.6%-86.4% accuracy in downstream classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 fMRI-TAMCL，一种文本锚定的多模态对比学习框架，融合 rs-fMRI 图像、稀疏功能连接与生成式个体文本，在五个数据集上以 78.6%–86.4% 准确率超越 29 个基线，展现跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 静息态 fMRI 在脑疾病分类中很重要，但具有高度多模态性和强烈的多站点异质性。现有方法融合图像、基于 BOLD 的功能连接与表型数据，而这些 rs-fMRI 数据集通常缺少文本模态，所生成文本依赖对受试者、站点、设备与协议的固定假设，导致跨数据集泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出 fMRI-TAMCL 文本锚定多模态对比学习框架，整合 fMRI 图像、稀疏 FC 和生成的受试者特定文本。其中 Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation 模块生成 BOLD 激活文本，Feature-Value Serialization 模块生成表型文本。三种模态均被编码为聚类图，投影到共享的单位超球面空间，通过成对的、以文本为锚的监督对比学习进行对齐，并采用注意力机制融合。
AI.result: fMRI-TAMCL 在五个数据集上验证了泛化能力，优于 29 个基线方法，下游分类准确率达到 78.6%–86.4%。
AI.conclusion: 以文本为锚、融合 fMRI 图像与稀疏 FC 的多模态对比学习框架能有效缓解 rs-fMRI 的站点异质性与文本生成假设固化问题，实现跨数据集泛化并提升脑疾病分类性能。

title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 macro2mind，通过预测市场的价格轨迹学习行为推理，用 GRPO 训练语言模型，将行为推理显式化为预测步骤，在 SWM-Bench 上取得最优方向准确率与相关性，并零样本迁移至四个用户模拟基准。
AI.motivation: 现有用于模拟个体对新情境反应的 LLM，其行为推理要么继承自预训练，要么来自个体级标注；后者行为多样性有限，且对推理过程本身缺乏监督。作者希望从具有大规模人群响应记录的预测市场中学习行为推理。
AI.method: 提出 macro2mind，使用市场信号对语言模型进行 GRPO 训练。核心是社会行为分解，把行为推理变成预测的显式步骤：推断代表性市场参与者群体、预测各群体如何解读新闻并更新信念、推理其相互作用，并将响应聚合为价格。训练采用事后遗憾课程（hindsight-regret curriculum）与难度感知采样，聚焦于事后识别出的群体能显著改善预测的转换，并优先选择当前策略仍可学习的样本。
AI.result: 在 SWM-Bench 上，macro2mind 在 Polymarket 上取得当时最优的方向准确率与相关性。基于市场数据训练后，零样本迁移到四个用户模拟基准（Humanual、OvertonBench、PRISM、CAD），在零样本方法中具有竞争力。作为数据生成器，将下游模拟器在未见用户上的准确率提升 15.5 个百分点，比其骨干模型生成的数据高出 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 预测市场的价格轨迹可作为行为推理的有效监督信号；通过将行为推理显式分解并结合遗憾课程训练，模型学到的推理无需额外训练即可迁移至用户模拟任务，且可作为高质量数据生成器提升下游模拟器性能。

title: Spatial Supervision Without Attribution Optimization: Improving Post-Hoc Class Activation Maps via Box-Guided Evidence Routing
comment: 24 pages, 12 figures. Appendix included in the main PDF (pages 10-24)
summary: Post-hoc class activation maps (CAMs) are a standard tool for inspecting the evidence behind an image classifier's predictions, yet nothing in ordinary training encourages these maps to be spatially appropriate. We study whether inexpensive spatial supervision can improve a classifier's own predicted-class Grad-CAM without ever optimizing an attribution map. Box-Guided Evidence Routing (BGER) trains a lightweight gate on the final feature map under box or mask supervision and routes classification through the gated features, while Grad-CAM is computed separately at the pre-gate representation, so the evaluated map never enters the training objective. With a BCE routing loss, BGER raises MaxBoxAccV2 from $0.584$ to $0.715$ on CUB-200-2011 and from $0.757$ to $0.832$ on Stanford Dogs at comparable accuracy. Matched controls attribute most of the ResNet-50 gain to the spatial supervision reshaping the backbone rather than to routing itself: when classification bypasses the gate, most of the improvement remains, and detaching gradients through the gate leaves the ResNet-50 result nearly unchanged. The same detachment preserves most of the gain in two DenseNet-121 chest X-ray settings but removes the apparent gain on Swin-T, and directly supervising the CAM reaches stronger localization at a larger accuracy cost. Overall, spatial supervision can improve separately evaluated post-hoc CAMs, but both the mechanism and the size of the benefit depend on the architecture and the evaluation setting.

AI.tldr: BGER 通过在最终特征图上施加框/掩码监督的轻量门控并让分类经过门控特征，使独立评估的 Grad-CAM 空间定位质量显著提升，但其收益机制与幅度高度依赖架构与评测设置。
AI.motivation: 常规训练目标中没有任何项约束类激活图（CAM）的空间合理性，导致后验 CAM 未必聚焦于真正有判别力的区域。作者希望验证：是否可以用廉价的弱空间监督提升分类器自身预测类 Grad-CAM 的质量，而完全不把归因图纳入优化目标。
AI.method: 提出 Box-Guided Evidence Routing（BGER）：在最终特征图上训练一个轻量门控模块，使用框或掩码监督，并让分类前向经过门控后的特征；而 Grad-CAM 在门控前的表示上单独计算，因此被评估的归因图不进入训练损失。采用 BCE 路由损失。设置多条对照实验：分类绕开门控、门控处梯度截断（detach）、以及直接监督 CAM，以辨析增益来源。
AI.result: 在准确率相当的情况下，BCE 路由损失使 MaxBoxAccV2 在 CUB-200-2011 上从 0.584 提升至 0.715，在 Stanford Dogs 上从 0.757 提升至 0.832。对照实验显示 ResNet-50 的增益主要来自空间监督对骨干网络的重塑而非路由本身：分类绕开门控时大部分提升仍在；门控处 detach 后 ResNet-50 结果几乎不变。该 detach 在两种 DenseNet-121 胸片设置中保留了大部分增益，但消除了 Swin-T 上的表观增益；直接监督 CAM 可获得更强定位，但准确率代价更大。
AI.conclusion: 廉价空间监督确实能改善独立评估的后验 CAM，说明无需把归因图写入目标函数也能提升其空间合理性；但收益的机制与幅度随架构和评测设置而异，需要对具体模型与任务做对照验证。

title: Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions, re-predicting each token multiple times before it is committed. An autoregressive decoder exposes an answer's distribution once, at the step that commits it; a dLLM exposes it at every denoising step before commitment, and we show that an adversary can exploit this. Since an answer remains open to revision over many denoising steps, an adversary with access to internal activations can watch how likely the model is to produce a chosen answer and adjust the intervention accordingly. Building on this observation, we study targeted bias injection, an attack that steers a frozen dLLM toward a demographic answer selected by the adversary. The attack uses a simple proportional-integral (PI) controller that tracks the target-answer probability during denoising and adapts the strength of a steering vector on the fly. On ambiguous BBQ questions where the correct answer is abstention, our attack raises LLaDA-8B-Instruct's preference for the targeted group from 1.8 to 16.7 percentage points, more than three times the strongest fixed-strength steering baseline, and on SocialStigmaQA it raises the selection of stigmatizing answers from 17.6% to 58.1%. Fitted to other demographic targets, the same attack shifts answers by up to 37 percentage points, and each attack takes about 40 minutes on one GPU. On the primary target, feedback is what makes the attack work: constant steering at the same average strength over the token-committing steps produces a far smaller shift while corrupting nearly three times as many outputs, and a constant strength set separately for each example still falls well short. Our findings identify the denoising trajectory as a new control channel in dLLMs and call for bias audits that examine the serving stack rather than the frozen model alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）在去噪过程中反复暴露答案分布，攻击者可利用该特性实施有目标的偏见注入攻击，并通过比例积分（PI）控制器动态调节引导向量强度。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码器仅在提交某个token的那一步暴露其分布，而dLLM在提交前的每个去噪步骤都会暴露答案分布。作者认为这一差异构成了新的攻击面：只要攻击者能访问内部激活，就能持续观察模型产生目标答案的概率并相应调整干预，从而研究针对性的偏见注入。
AI.method: 作者提出一种针对性偏见注入攻击。攻击使用简单的比例积分（PI）控制器：在去噪过程中跟踪目标答案概率，并实时自适应地调整一个引导向量的强度，从而将冻结的dLLM导向攻击者选定的群体性答案。作者还设置了固定强度引导等基线进行对比，并比较了“每步动态反馈调节”与“在token提交步使用相同平均强度恒定引导”“针对每个样本单独设定恒定强度”等变体。
AI.result: 在正确答案应为弃权的模糊BBQ问题上，该攻击将LLaDA-8B-Instruct对目标群体的偏好从1.8个百分点提升到16.7个百分点，超过最强固定强度引导基线的三倍。在SocialStigmaQA上，攻击将污名化答案的选择率从17.6%提升到58.1%。拟合到其他人口目标时，同一攻击最多可移动答案达37个百分点。每次攻击在单块GPU上约耗时40分钟。在主目标上，反馈是攻击奏效的关键：在token提交步使用相同平均强度的恒定引导仅带来远更小的偏移，且对输出的破坏几乎多出三倍；即使为每个样本单独设定恒定强度，效果也仍明显不足。
AI.conclusion: 作者将dLLM的去噪轨迹识别为一种新的控制通道，表明仅审计冻结模型本身不足以发现此类风险，呼吁在部署与服务栈层面上开展偏见审计。

title: TasteRoute: Personalized Routing for Video Generation
summary: Rapid progress in video generation has led to a plethora of models that differ substantially in capability and generation cost. This raises a natural question: can each request be efficiently routed to an appropriate model? We find that even when the consensus of the other annotators is used as an oracle, it agrees with each annotator's own favorite only 34-55% of the time. Motivated by this observation, we introduce TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator jointly based on the input request, user preferences, and available generation budget. Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, TasteRoute is competitive with strong simple baselines on preference routing while reducing average generation cost. The cost saving increases under higher budget caps. Finally, we release TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset containing multi-model video comparisons, quality judgments, preference rankings, and user-profile signals to facilitate future research on personalized and cost-aware video routing.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化视频生成路由器 TasteRoute，依据请求、用户偏好与预算联合选择生成模型，在偏好路由上媲美强基线并降低生成成本，同时发布 TasteRoute-3k 数据集。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型在能力与生成成本上差异显著，如何将每个请求高效路由到合适模型成为问题；且标注者之间偏好分歧大（与共识一致率仅 34-55%），说明单一"通用最优"模型不成立，需引入个性化偏好。
AI.method: 提出 TasteRoute 路由器，联合考虑输入请求、用户偏好画像与可用生成预算来选择生成器；覆盖文生视频与图生视频两种设定；并构建并发布 TasteRoute-3k 人工标注数据集，含多模型视频对比、质量判断、偏好排序与用户画像信号。
AI.result: 在文生视频与图生视频设置下，TasteRoute 在偏好路由上可与强简单基线竞争，同时降低平均生成成本；预算上限越高，成本节省越明显。
AI.conclusion: 个性化、成本感知的视频生成路由是可行且有效的，TasteRoute 兼顾偏好匹配与成本控制，配套数据集为后续个性化与成本感知视频路由研究提供支撑。

title: Fitting Vision Adapters at Frontier Scales
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment
summary: Training a small projector between a frozen vision encoder and language model is an established approach to multimodal learning. As the parameter count of language models scales dramatically, we revisit which vision capabilities this approach can add while keeping their pretrained weights fixed. Here we train a 50M parameter projector from the vision encoder of Kimi K2.6 to GLM 5.2 and 5.3, both models without native vision capabilities, and further present a reproducible recipe for training these adapters at scale. We study the following: (a) how vision capabilities of multimodal models scale as purely the language model side scales, and (b) what specific vision capabilities are able to be imbued into a pure language model at scale, and which ones remain limited. We evaluate on MMMU-Pro and BLINK, examining both overall performance and results on individual visual tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文在冻结视觉编码器与语言模型的前提下，仅训练一个50M参数投影器，将Kimi K2.6的视觉编码器接入无原生视觉能力的GLM 5.2/5.3，研究视觉能力的规模化规律并给出可复现训练方案。
AI.motivation: 以往在冻结视觉编码器与语言模型之间训练小型投影器是多模态学习的常规做法，但语言模型参数急剧扩大后，这种固定预训练权重的方式究竟能带来哪些视觉能力尚不清楚，需要重新审视。
AI.method: 从Kimi K2.6的视觉编码器到GLM 5.2与5.3训练一个50M参数的投影器，保持两侧预训练权重固定，并提出可复现的规模化适配器训练流程；考察(a)仅语言模型侧扩大时多模态视觉能力的规模化规律，以及(b)在规模化下纯语言模型能够获得哪些具体视觉能力、哪些仍受限。评估采用MMMU-Pro与BLINK，兼顾总体性能与单项视觉任务结果。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明在MMMU-Pro和BLINK上同时报告总体性能与各单项视觉任务的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结双端、仅训练小型投影器的方案，可系统刻画随语言模型规模增长而变化的视觉能力边界，并识别可注入与仍受限的视觉能力，为大规模多模态适配器训练提供可复现依据。

title: LoDEOT: Low-Dimensional and Efficient Offset Tokens for Building Footprint Extraction from Off-Nadir Imagery
summary: Instance-level roof-to-footprint offset (RFO) prediction is central to extracting building footprints from off-nadir imagery. Query-based pipelines commonly use high-dimensional instance tokens to predict signed two-dimensional RFOs. We investigate whether RFO prediction can instead use a compact offset token. Under local pinhole projection and vertical-extrusion assumptions, the idealized RFO map admits a five-parameter sufficient descriptor comprising intrinsic shape, composite amplitude, and relative geometry. This factorization provides a structural prior for a five-dimensional offset token, whose channels learn task-relevant latent representations through end-to-end training. Based on this design, we propose LoDEOT, which retains high-dimensional instance tokens for detection and segmentation but maps instance-token, concentration-gated roof, and box-mask evidence to a five-dimensional offset token followed by an independent two-dimensional readout. Known denoising-query target indices further align each supervised decoder-layer estimate with the same clean instance RFO, organizing successive predictions as target-aligned recovery under perturbed query conditions. Experiments on five real-world building datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LoDEOT for building footprint extraction. Experiments on real-world building datasets demonstrate that a five-dimensional offset token can support accurate RFO prediction. On BONAI, LoDEOT achieves the best roof-detection bAP and bAP50 and leads all five offset-corrected footprint metrics among the evaluated end-to-end methods, with FAP50 of 54.58 and mEPE of 5.23 pixels. Its FAP50 exceeds those of the evaluated end-to-end baselines by 7.56-16.85 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoDEOT，用五维偏移token替代高维实例token进行屋顶到足迹偏移(RFO)预测，在五个建筑数据集上验证有效性，BONAI上FAP50达54.58、mEPE为5.23像素。
AI.motivation: 实例级RFO预测是基于非正射影像提取建筑足迹的关键。现有基于查询的流程普遍使用高维实例token预测二维有符号RFO，表征冗余、缺乏结构先验。作者探究能否改用紧凑的偏移token完成RFO预测。
AI.method: 在局部针孔投影与垂直拉伸假设下，理想RFO图具有五参数充分描述符（内禀形状、复合幅值、相对几何），据此构造五维偏移token，其通道经端到端训练学习任务相关隐表征。LoDEOT保留高维实例token用于检测与分割，将实例token、浓度门控屋顶证据、框掩码证据映射为五维偏移token，再经独立的二维读出。利用去噪查询目标索引，使各监督解码层估计对齐同一干净实例RFO，将逐层预测组织为扰动查询条件下的目标对齐恢复。
AI.result: 在五个真实建筑数据集上验证了LoDEOT的有效性。BONAI上取得最佳屋顶检测bAP与bAP50，并在所评估的端到端方法中领先全部五项偏移校正足迹指标，FAP50为54.58、mEPE为5.23像素；FAP50比评估的端到端基线高7.56-16.85个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 五维偏移token可支撑精确的RFO预测，紧凑偏移token结合结构先验与目标对齐监督是建筑足迹提取的有效方案。

title: End-to-End Autonomous Recursive Arborescence Deformable Flow and Non-Linear Hemodynamics for Patient-Specific Coronary Centerline Extraction
summary: Extracting patient-specific vascular trees from volumetric medical images is fundamental to computational angiography and non-invasive hemodynamic assessment. Conventional voxel segmentation models often sever delicate bifurcations, while heuristic Euclidean Minimum Spanning Trees introduce non-anatomical shortcuts. Moreover, linear Poiseuille flow neglects quadratic kinetic dissipation across arterial narrowings, underestimating ischemia. We formulate an end-to-end framework decoupling continuous geometric arborescence generation from non-linear hemodynamics. First, an autonomous 3D Ostium Landmark Localization Head with dual-sinus query channels and spherical-gated refinement eliminates centerline seeding dependency, achieving cohort mean localization error of 7.63 mm (7.43 mm LCA, 7.83 mm RCA; 71.4% <= 8.0 mm) from raw contrast context. Second, a Spatially-Grounded Deformable Step Flow Architecture queries continuous 3D feature pyramids via trilinear sampling, sequentially generating trajectories with anchor boundary enforcement (X(0) = P_start). Third, a Top-Down Recursive Arborescence State Machine detects bifurcation peaks via Tree-NMS and parameterizes predecessor parent pointers (p_k < k), guaranteeing single connected acyclic tree topology (beta_0 = 1, beta_1 = 0) with differentiable step termination. Fourth, an iterative Picard non-linear Kirchhoff solver with Young-Tsai / Gould quadratic dissipation enforces machine-precision mass conservation (residual 5.82e-11 mL/s). Across 14 development patients under standardized in-silico stenosis stress testing (Q_0 = 4.0 mL/s), linear Poiseuille flow misclassifies 75% diameter lesions as non-ischemic (FFR > 0.80) in 14/14 cases, whereas our non-linear solver captures functional ischemia (FFR = 0.5864, lesion disparity 32.89 mmHg, p = 6.10e-5) with 3.66x collateral shunting. Test set firewall isolation was maintained.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端框架，将连续几何血管树生成与非线性血流动力学解耦：通过3D开口定位头消除中心线种子依赖，利用可变形阶梯流架构生成轨迹，以自顶向下递归状态机保证单连通无环树拓扑，并用Picard非线性Kirchhoff求解器（含二次耗散）实现机器精度质量守恒，从而在狭窄应力测试中正确判定功能性缺血。
AI.motivation: 从体层医学图像中提取患者特异性血管树是计算血管造影和无创血流动力学评估的基础。现有方法存在三类缺陷：体素分割模型常切断纤细分叉；启发式欧氏最小生成树引入非解剖捷径；线性Poiseuille流忽略动脉狭窄处的二次动能耗散，导致低估缺血。
AI.method: 1) 自主3D开口标志点定位头，采用双窦查询通道与球面门控细化，从原始对比度上下文消除中心线播种依赖；2) 空间锚定可变形阶梯流架构，通过三线性采样查询连续3D特征金字塔，在锚点边界约束X(0)=P_start下顺序生成轨迹；3) 自顶向下递归血管树状态机，通过Tree-NMS检测分叉峰并参数化前驱父指针(p_k<k)，保证单连通无环拓扑(beta_0=1, beta_1=0)与可微步终止；4) 迭代Picard非线性Kirchhoff求解器，结合Young-Tsai/Gould二次耗散，强制机器精度质量守恒。
AI.result: 开口定位队列平均误差7.63 mm（LCA 7.43 mm，RCA 7.83 mm；71.4%≤8.0 mm）。质量守恒残差5.82e-11 mL/s。14例开发患者标准化在体狭窄应力测试(Q_0=4.0 mL/s)中，线性Poiseuille流在14/14例将75%直径病变误判为非缺血(FFR>0.80)；非线性求解器则捕捉到功能性缺血(FFR=0.5864，病变压差32.89 mmHg，p=6.10e-5)，侧支分流3.66倍。测试集防火墙隔离得以维持。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦框架在几何提取与血流动力学两个环节均优于传统方法：既克服了分割断裂与拓扑伪影，又准确刻画狭窄的非线性耗散，显著提升功能性缺血识别的准确性，并保持测试集隔离的严谨性。

title: On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set
summary: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文对"在测试集上调超参数"这一禁忌进行实证检验，在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10和GLUE三项任务上系统量化其导致的性能膨胀。结果显示该效应真实且显著，但常小于其他噪声来源，多数情况下测试集调参与验证集调参选出同一模型，且模型排名基本保持不变，因此一致的测试集调参未必使基准或模型选择失效。
AI.motivation: 机器学习教科书普遍将在测试集上调超参数视为"原罪"，认为它会产生误导性乐观结果、破坏基准完整性甚至构成学术不端。然而实践中的证据表明该行为确实存在，因此亟需理解其真实后果，而非仅停留在教条式谴责。作者旨在质疑这一教条并通过实证研究回答"它到底有多糟"。
AI.method: 作者系统性地研究了在测试集上调超参数所导致的性能膨胀幅度。实验跨三个数据集：MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10以及GLUE基准中的三个任务。通过对比测试集调参与验证集调参的结果，测量性能膨胀、所选出模型的异同以及模型排名的一致性，并将其影响与其他噪声来源进行比较。
AI.result: 实验表明，测试集调参带来的性能膨胀真实且显著，但相对于其他噪声来源往往较小。在许多情况下，在测试集上调参得到的模型与在验证集上调参得到的模型完全相同。最重要的是，测试集调参后模型之间的排名基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 一致的测试集调参可能并不会使基准测试或模型选择失效。作者呼吁对测试集调超参数问题采取更细致、平衡的观点，并鼓励研究者公开报告其测试集调参行为，以促进更透明和诚实的科研实践。

title: Safe Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models achieve remarkable visual image generation performance, but they can still generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents, including violent or explicit images. Existing safety checker mechanisms are largely confined to pre-generation filtering (e.g. prompt-level text classifiers) or post-hoc moderation applied after an image is completely synthesized. However, adversarial attack methods operate over a much broader space. This imbalance highlights the need for a safety mechanism that intervenes during the generation process. We propose an in-generation safety framework that monitors the denoising trajectory and detects emerging NSFW signals from intermediate representations. Rather than merely detecting NSFW generations, our method applies reinforcement learning to generate safe images from NSFW prompts. By coupling in-generation detection with controllable steering, our approach mitigates unsafe trajectories even when NSFW signals emerge after generation has already begun. Experiments results show that our method consistently outperforms existing safe image generation methods across both standard and adversarial evaluation sets, while preserving perceptual quality and prompt fidelity. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在生成过程中进行安全干预的T2I框架，通过监测去噪轨迹并利用强化学习对不安全轨迹进行可控引导，从而从NSFW提示生成安全图像，在标准与对抗评测集上均优于现有方法且保持感知质量与提示一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型仍会生成暴力或露骨等NSFW内容。已有安全机制主要局限于生成前的提示级文本过滤或图像完全合成后的后处理审核，而对抗攻击可在更广空间中起作用，因此现有防护与攻击面之间存在不平衡，亟需一种能在生成过程中介入的安全机制。
AI.method: 提出生成中（in-generation）安全框架：监控去噪轨迹，从中间表示中检测正在出现的NSFW信号；并不仅限于检测，而是结合强化学习对生成过程进行可控引导，使模型面向NSFW提示也能生成安全图像。通过将生成中检测与可控引导耦合，即使NSFW信号在生成开始后才出现，也能对不安全轨迹进行缓解。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在标准评测集与对抗评测集上均持续优于现有安全图像生成方法，同时保持感知质量和提示保真度。
AI.conclusion: 在生成过程中进行NSFW检测与强化学习引导，是应对提示过滤与事后审核局限性的有效安全方案，可在兼顾图像质量与提示一致性的前提下提升T2I生成安全性。代码将在论文录用后发布。

title: AstraSR: Real-World Thermal Super-Resolution with GPT-6 Astra
summary: Real-world thermal super-resolution (SR) is constrained by limited sensor resolution and the difficulty of obtaining corresponding high-resolution (HR) observations for direct model supervision. Conventional SR methods typically construct training pairs by treating captured thermal images with real-world degradations as HR references and applying predefined degradation to generate synthetic low-resolution (LR) inputs. Such a construction not only introduces a domain gap between synthetic and captured LR observations but also retains acquisition degradations in the supervision. To address this issue, we propose AstraSR, a real-world thermal SR method guided by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier multimodal generative model endowed with emergent and transformative visual capabilities. Specifically, we construct a dataset of image pairs by using captured LR thermal images to condition GPT-based HR reference. We develop a direct generative supervision strategy that learns from captured thermal inputs paired with GPT-generated HR references. Pixel, gradient, and perceptual losses jointly supervise the transfer of intensity patterns, structural boundaries, and visual details from the generated references. Qualitative comparisons with seven existing state-of-the-art real-world SR methods show continuous object contours, distinct structural boundaries, and smooth intensity transitions in the thermal scenes. These results demonstrate that AstraSR outperforms existing real-world SR methods in both thermal clarity and structural coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出AstraSR，利用GPT-6 Astra生成的HR参考构建图像对，配合直接生成式监督策略（像素/梯度/感知损失）实现真实世界热图像超分辨率，在热清晰度与结构连贯性上优于7种现有方法。
AI.motivation: 真实世界热图像超分辨率受限于传感器分辨率低、且难以获取对应的高分辨率（HR）观测用于直接监督。传统方法将带真实退化的捕获热图当作HR参考，再施加预设退化生成合成LR输入，导致合成LR与实采LR之间存在域间隙，同时监督信号中仍残留采集退化。
AI.method: 提出AstraSR，由GPT-6 Astra（具涌现与变革性视觉能力的前沿多模态生成模型）引导。首先以捕获的低分辨率热图像为条件，驱动GPT生成HR参考，构建图像对数据集；随后设计直接生成式监督策略，从实采热输入与GPT生成HR参考的配对中学习，并联合使用像素损失、梯度损失与感知损失，分别监督强度模式、结构边界与视觉细节的迁移。
AI.result: 与7种现有最先进真实世界SR方法的定性比较显示，AstraSR在热图像场景中呈现连续的物体轮廓、清晰的结构边界以及平滑的强度过渡，在热清晰度与结构连贯性两方面均优于现有真实世界SR方法。
AI.conclusion: 以多模态生成模型生成HR参考并直接进行生成式监督，可有效规避合成退化的域间隙与监督污染问题，为真实世界热图像超分辨率提供可行方案，在清晰度与结构一致性上取得优越表现。

title: Every View Counts: View-Consistent Panoptic Quality for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Under review. Youngmin Lee and Byungha Ko contributed equally
summary: Multi-view panoptic segmentation assigns a semantic class and a scene-level instance ID to every pixel of an unordered set of images, and recent feed-forward 3D models predict these labels for the input views in a single forward pass. Their predictions, however, have been evaluated with the scene-level PQ (PQ^scene) borrowed from per-scene optimization methods, typically on rendered held-out views. PQ^scene tiles all views of a scene into a single image, so that a missed appearance or a change of ID lowers the score of the matched pair only in proportion to its area. We propose View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ), which extends PQ from a single image to a set of input views, counts equally every view in which an instance is visible, and penalizes a prediction that is not visible in the same views as its ground truth. A decomposition of VC-PQ attributes the score a method loses to mask accuracy, view consistency, and the matching threshold. A single additional parameter recovers the area weighting of tiling for comparison. Under a fixed evaluation protocol on ScanNet++ and ScanNetv2, recent feed-forward methods are evaluated with VC-PQ and PQ^scene, and the decomposition shows where each of them loses its score. Controlled perturbations of the ground truth show that VC-PQ responds to the number of views in which an instance is missed or changes ID, whereas PQ^scene responds to their area. The aim of this work is to make view consistency part of the evaluation of multi-view panoptic segmentation, with VC-PQ reported alongside PQ^scene.

AI.tldr: 提出VC-PQ新指标，将PQ从单图扩展到多视图集合，等权计数实例可见视图并惩罚视图不一致，弥补PQ^scene对视图一致性不敏感的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有多视图全景分割的前馈3D模型沿用逐场景优化方法的PQ^scene进行评估：它将一个场景所有视图拼接成单张图像，导致漏检或ID变化仅按面积比例影响匹配对得分，无法反映跨视图一致性，评价结果被面积主导。
AI.method: 提出View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ)：将PQ从单张图像扩展到输入视图集合，对实例可见的每个视图等权计数，惩罚与真实标签可见视图不一致的预测。VC-PQ可分解为掩码精度、视图一致性与匹配阈值三部分损失；引入单一附加参数可退化为拼接的面积加权以作对比。在ScanNet++与ScanNetv2固定评估协议下对近期前馈方法同时用VC-PQ与PQ^scene评估，并通过人为扰动真值进行对照实验。
AI.result: 分解结果定位了各方法失分来源；受控扰动实验表明VC-PQ对实例被漏检或ID改变所涉及的视图数量敏感，而PQ^scene仅对其面积敏感。
AI.conclusion: 主张将视图一致性纳入多视图全景分割评估，建议在报告PQ^scene的同时一并报告VC-PQ。

title: Prompt and Refinement: Asymmetric Mutual Learning for Infrared Small Target Detection with Noisy Labels
comment: The code will be released at https://github.com/fuyimin96/PAR upon acceptance
summary: Existing data-driven infrared small target detection (ISTD) methods typically require large-scale datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations for model training. However, such labor-intensive requirements are difficult to satisfy in real-world applications due to the heavy reliance on expert knowledge and the inherently weak distinctiveness of infrared small targets. Consequently, the presence of noisy labels during model training is inevitable, which can severely mislead the learning of target perception toward spurious patterns. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt and Refinement (PAR), a label-noise-robust asymmetric mutual learning paradigm for ISTD. Specifically, PAR comprises a pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM) and an ISTD-specific detector trained from scratch, which learn collaboratively through a peer-teaching scheme. Coupled with local contrast regularity, the predictions of the two asymmetric peer models are mutually exploited as rectification cues for the supervisory masks of their counterparts. The interaction between complementary inductive biases effectively prevents the label correction process from degenerating into the self-confirmation loop of a single model, enabling progressive refinement of the annotations toward intrinsic target characteristics. In addition, the detector predictions are utilized as corrective mask prompts to facilitate task-specific adaptation of the vision foundation model. Moreover, an evidential uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced into the optimization process to further alleviate the adverse effects of noisy labels. Extensive experiments under diverse noisy label scenarios on three ISTD datasets demonstrate that PAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prompt and Refinement (PAR)，一种面向红外小目标检测（ISTD）的标签噪声鲁棒非对称互学习范式，通过 SAM 与专用检测器的互教协同实现标注渐进修正，在三个数据集上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: ISTD 的数据驱动方法依赖大规模像素级精确标注，但专家知识依赖强、红外小目标本身可分性弱，实际中难以满足，训练集必然含噪声标签，会误导模型学习虚假模式，因此需要标签噪声鲁棒的 ISTD 方案。
AI.method: PAR 采用非对称互学习架构：一端为预训练 SAM（视觉基础模型），另一端为从零训练的 ISTD 专用检测器，二者以同伴教学（peer-teaching）方式协同学习。结合局部对比度正则，两个非对称同伴模型的预测被互为监督掩码的修正线索，互补归纳偏置的交互避免标签修正退化为单模型自确认循环，实现标注向目标内在特征的渐进细化。同时检测器预测作为修正掩码提示，促进基础模型的任务适配；并在优化中引入证据不确定性估计以缓解噪声标签影响。
AI.result: 在三个 ISTD 数据集上、多种噪声标签场景下的充分实验表明，PAR 持续取得最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: PAR 通过非对称互学习、掩码提示适配与不确定性估计的有效结合，可在噪声标注条件下稳健提升红外小目标检测性能，为 ISTD 的标签噪声问题提供了可行范式。

title: Beyond Transport Cost: Routing Differences between Flow Matching and Optimal Transport
summary: In generative models, Optimal Transport (OT) is used to improve Flow Matching (FM) by reducing noise-data coupling cost. However, different noise-to-output assignments can yield nearly equal costs, raising a key question. Is cost alone sufficient to guide coupling design? We address this question by separating transport cost from routing, i.e., the destination reached by each noise sample. We show numerically how FM and OT can differ in routing while remaining close in cost. We examine its consequences in learned neural FM. Using the exact FM routing as an oracle, we further construct a routing-aware training coupling and find that it yields a directionally consistent improvement in generation over a cost-matched, cost-only counterpart. Our findings highlight what cost minimization can overlook and motivate using both cost and routing to evaluate the design of OT-based FM couplings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文将最优传输中的"传输代价"与"路由（每个噪声样本到达的目标）"分离，论证仅靠代价不足以指导流匹配中的耦合设计。
AI.motivation: 在生成模型中，最优传输被用于改进流匹配，主要通过降低噪声与数据的耦合代价。但不同的噪声—输出分配可能产生几乎相同的代价，因此需要回答：仅凭代价是否足以指导耦合设计。
AI.method: 作者将传输代价与路由（每个噪声样本到达的目标）分离；在数值上展示FM与OT可在路由不同而代价接近；并以精确FM路由作为oracle，构造一种路由感知的训练耦合，与代价匹配但仅考虑代价的对照方法比较。
AI.result: 数值实验显示FM与OT在代价接近时路由可显著不同；在学习到的神经流匹配中，路由感知训练耦合相比代价匹配的仅代价对照，生成效果出现方向一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 代价最小化会忽视路由层面的差异；评估与设计基于OT的流匹配耦合时，应同时考虑代价与路由。

title: UltraDub: Towards Authentic Dubbing by Unifying Visually-Steered Flow Learning and Trajectory Guidance
summary: Visual voice cloning requires intelligible, speaker-consistent speech synchronized with visible articulation. However, sequential multimodal conditioning can disrupt previously established temporal and speaker cues, while imbalanced inference guidance can improve linguistic accuracy at the expense of lip synchronization. In this paper, we propose UltraDub, a Unifying Visually-Steered Flow learning and trajectory Guidance Dubbing framework that leverages vision in two ways: as continuous motion for multimodal context aggregation, and as structural rhythm for trajectory rectification. Specifically, we introduce the Motion-guided Dual-context Retrieving (MDR) module, which continually recalibrates linguistic and speaker-style retrieval through shared lip-motion query residuals, utilizing independent time-conditioned gates to regulate their contributions. Furthermore, we propose Rhythm-anchored Trajectory Guidance (RTG), a training-free mechanism that evaluates hierarchical multimodal corrections at a visual-only predictive midpoint, safely strengthening semantic conditioning while better preserving temporal alignment. Finally, we construct DiverseDub, a multi-scenario benchmark to evaluate video dubbing in the wild. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraDub achieves state-of-the-art performance across four datasets.

AI.tldr: UltraDub：统一视觉引导的流学习与轨迹校正配音框架，解决多模态顺序条件下的时序/说话人线索破坏与推理引导失衡问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉语音克隆需同时满足可懂度、说话人一致性与唇形同步。但顺序多模态条件会干扰已建立的时序与说话人线索；推理引导失衡时，提升语言准确率往往以牺牲唇同步为代价。
AI.method: 提出 UltraDub 框架，将视觉双重使用：作为连续运动进行多模态上下文聚合、作为结构节律进行轨迹校正。含两模块：1) MDR（Motion-guided Dual-context Retrieving）：通过共享唇动查询残差持续重校准语言与说话人风格检索，并用独立的时间条件门控调节二者贡献；2) RTG（Rhythm-anchored Trajectory Guidance）：免训练机制，在仅视觉预测中点评估分层多模态校正，安全增强语义条件同时更好保持时序对齐。另构建 DiverseDub 多场景基准。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 性能；DiverseDub 用于野外视频配音评测。
AI.conclusion: 视觉既可作连续运动用于上下文聚合，也可作结构节律用于轨迹校正；结合 MDR 与免训练 RTG 可同时增强语义条件并保持时序对齐，实现跨数据集最优的视觉语音克隆配音效果。

title: Structural Foundations of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Inputs: The UID-Induced Normal Form and Minimal-Sensing Structure-from-Motion
summary: This paper establishes the first general structural solution to the problem of state estimation for nonlinear systems driven by unknown inputs. Building upon nonlinear unknown-input observability theory, we show that every such system admits a structurally equivalent representation, referred to as the UID-induced normal form. The proposed representation decomposes the information carried by the unknown inputs into two complementary components: unknown-input directions that are structurally decoupled from the observable dynamics and observable quantities that completely represent the unknown-input information affecting the observable dynamics. As a consequence, the UID-induced normal form provides a unified structural solution to unknown-input decoupling and unknown-input reconstruction, without requiring any model or stochastic assumption on the unknown inputs. The practical significance of the proposed framework is demonstrated through a previously unexplored minimal Structure-from-Motion configuration. The proposed representation enables recursive state estimation from only three point features and a single-axis gyroscope, allowing the recovery of the three-dimensional structure and camera motion up to an unknown global scale factor. Experiments on real-world data validate the proposed framework and demonstrate the feasibility of this minimal sensing configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出由未知输入驱动非线性系统状态估计的通用结构性解法，通过"UID诱导正规型"统一实现未知输入解耦与重构，并以最小Structure-from-Motion配置验证其实用性。
AI.motivation: 非线性系统在受未知输入驱动时，状态估计长期缺乏通用的结构性解法。存在输入时需同时解决"解耦"（隔离不可观方向）与"重构"（恢复影响可观测动态的输入信息）两大难题，且既有方法往往依赖模型或随机假设，适用性受限。
AI.method: 基于非线性未知输入可观性理论，论证任何此类系统均存在结构等价表示，即UID诱导正规型。该表示将未知输入携带的信息分解为两类互补成分：一类是与可观测动态结构性解耦的未知输入方向，另一类是能完整刻画影响可观测动态的未知输入信息的可观测量。整个框架不依赖未知输入的模型或随机假设。随后以最小结构的光度/运动恢复配置为例进行构造与应用。
AI.result: UID诱导正规型为未知输入解耦与重构提供了统一的结构性解，无需对输入建模。在最小Structure-from-Motion配置中，仅用三个点特征与单轴陀螺仪即可实现递归状态估计，恢复三维结构与相机运动（差一个全局尺度因子）；真实数据实验验证了框架有效，并证明该最小传感配置的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 未知输入驱动非线性系统的状态估计可归结为UID诱导正规型这一通用结构框架，从而统一处理解耦与重构问题并削弱对输入模型假设的依赖；最小传感配置的实例与实验表明该理论框架兼具普适性与工程可用性。

title: ReMem: Streaming Video Understanding With Long Context Retention
summary: Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of video understanding tasks, current Vision Language Models (VLMs) are predominantly designed for offline scenarios and struggle to handle online streaming videos that demand low latency response. Several studies have explored memory and token compression strategies in an attempt to adapt offline VLMs for streaming video understanding tasks. However, through our probing experiment, we identify that most existing works tend to progressively lose long context information as length of input stream increases. To address this, we propose ReMem, a novel training-free adaptation technique that enables VLMs to process streaming videos of arbitrary lengths while improving their long context information retention capability. ReMem exploits memory from two perspectives, implemented as two core components. The Streaming Context Memory (SCM) continuously compresses historical context with query-independent attention. The Retrieved Vision Memory (RVM) then retrieves the most salient, query-relevant context from memory to augment the VLM's input. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed ReMem achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a variety of widely used benchmarks, spanning both streaming video and general long video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReMem，一种无需训练的自适应技术，通过流式上下文记忆（SCM）与检索视觉记忆（RVM）两个组件，使视觉语言模型能够处理任意长度的流式视频并提升长上下文信息保留能力，在多类基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要面向离线场景，难以应对要求低延迟响应的在线流式视频。已有的记忆与 token 压缩策略在输入流增长时会逐步丢失长上下文信息。作者通过探针实验证实了这一缺陷，因此需要一种既适配流式处理又能保持长上下文的方案。
AI.method: 提出 ReMem，一种无需训练的自适应技术，从两个视角利用记忆，对应两个核心组件：流式上下文记忆（SCM）以查询无关的注意力机制持续压缩历史上下文；检索视觉记忆（RVM）从记忆中检索最显著、与查询相关的上下文，用于增强 VLM 的输入。二者协同使模型可处理任意长度的流式视频。
AI.result: 在多种广泛使用的基准上取得 SOTA 性能，涵盖流式视频理解与通用长视频理解两类任务。
AI.conclusion: ReMem 通过 SCM 与 RVM 的双重视角记忆机制，在无需训练的前提下有效缓解流式视频中的长上下文信息丢失问题，并兼顾流式与长视频理解的通用性。

title: MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching
summary: Reward post-training of flow models either reweights the model's own samples under a KL penalty or a frozen reference, often for thousands of updates, or backpropagates the reward and moves every sample without checking that the move is worth its size. We introduce MEND, a reinforcement learning method built on proximal velocity matching. MEND caps rewards within each prompt group, so samples that already score well receive no move. Below the cap, it proposes moves along the reward gradient and accepts one only when its capped reward gain exceeds a quadratic displacement price. The model then regresses onto the resulting velocity targets, with no KL term, frozen reference model, or advantage weights. In 100 updates, MEND outperforms Flow-GRPO (about 4k updates) on five of six evaluators at the same distance to base-model images. Under an equal-budget protocol, it surpasses ReFL and DiffusionNFT at every evaluated update across four training rewards, reaching PickScore 24.03 versus 23.92 and 23.43, respectively. A 300-update three-reward run also surpasses the five-reward DiffusionNFT model on all three rewards it trains on. MEND is general and easy to adopt: it applies to any flow backbone with a differentiable reward.

AI.tldr: MEND：基于近端速度匹配的流模型强化学习后训练方法，奖励封顶+二次位移代价接受机制，无需KL项、冻结参考模型或优势权重，100步即超越Flow-GRPO(约4k步)。
AI.motivation: 现有流模型奖励后训练要么在KL惩罚或冻结参考模型下反复重加权自身样本（常需数千次更新），要么直接反向传播奖励并对所有样本施加位移，而不检验该位移是否值得其代价。前者效率低，后者缺乏对更新幅度的合理性约束。
AI.method: 提出MEND，一种基于近端速度匹配(proximal velocity matching)的强化学习方法：在每个prompt组内对奖励做封顶，使已得分良好的样本不再移动；在封顶以下沿奖励梯度提出位移，仅当封顶后的奖励增益超过二次位移代价时才接受；随后模型回归到由此得到的速度目标。整个过程不含KL项、冻结参考模型和优势权重。
AI.result: 100次更新下，在与基座模型图像距离相同的情况下，MEND在六个评估器中的五个上优于Flow-GRPO(约4k次更新)；等预算协议下，在四个训练奖励上的每个评估节点均超过ReFL与DiffusionNFT，PickScore达24.03，对比23.92与23.43；300次更新三奖励运行在所有三个训练奖励上也超过五奖励的DiffusionNFT模型。
AI.conclusion: MEND通用且易于采用：适用于任何具备可微奖励的流模型骨干，以极少更新步数取得更强奖励优化效果，同时保持与基座模型的合理距离。

title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
comment: Extended version of "OnePO: Direct One-stage Policy Optimization for SFT-free Domain Adaptation", accepted at ICML 2026, with additional analysis and scaling to HuatuoGPT-3
summary: Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. While the dominant SFT+RL pipeline offers a convenient cold start, it may reduce exploration diversity and introduces additional complexity through multi-stage optimization. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. We identify these two failure modes as Gradient Starvation and Teacher-Distribution Anchoring. To address them, we propose One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO), which treats teacher outputs as transient guidance for policy improvement. OnePO combines Adaptive Objective Evolution to strengthen learning on informative low-probability teacher tokens and Teacher Retirement to discard teacher outputs once the current policy can surpass them. On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench (Total) with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL and pure RL by 2.7 and 7.4 points, respectively. We further scale OnePO to produce HuatuoGPT-3, an open-source medical LLM series whose 27B variant reaches 70.1 on HealthBench (Total) and 71.4 on HealthBench Professional, surpassing frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra. Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OnePO，一种将教师输出视为瞬时引导的单阶段策略优化方法，用于 LLM 领域自适应；通过自适应目标演化与教师退休机制解决梯度饥饿与教师分布锚定问题，在医学领域以 20K 样本取得优异效果，并据此训练出 HuatuoGPT-3 系列模型。
AI.motivation: 将通用 LLM 转化为领域专家时，主流 SFT+RL 流程虽便于冷启动，但会降低探索多样性并带来多阶段优化的复杂度；纯 on-policy RL 存在冷启动问题，而 mixed-policy RL 仍有两类缺陷：教师输出中的高信息量 token 在训练早期学习过慢，且过时的教师输出会阻碍后期提升。作者将这两类失败模式分别定义为梯度饥饿（Gradient Starvation）与教师分布锚定（Teacher-Distribution Anchoring）。
AI.method: 提出 One-stage Policy Optimization（OnePO），将教师输出作为策略改进的瞬时引导。方法包含两部分：自适应目标演化（Adaptive Objective Evolution），用于加强对高信息量、低概率教师 token 的学习；教师退休（Teacher Retirement），一旦当前策略能超越教师输出即将其丢弃。
AI.result: 在医学领域自适应任务上，OnePO 仅用 20K 训练样本即在 HealthBench（Total）上达到 67.2，分别超过 SFT+RL 与纯 RL 2.7 分和 7.4 分。进一步扩展得到开源医学 LLM 系列 HuatuoGPT-3，其 27B 变体在 HealthBench（Total）达 70.1、HealthBench Professional 达 71.4，超越 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: OnePO 通过把教师监督退化为瞬时引导，有效缓解了 pure/mixed-policy RL 在领域自适应中的冷启动与锚定瓶颈，以更少样本和单阶段流程取得显著性能提升，并具备规模化训练开源领域模型的能力。模型与代码已开源。

title: JLD: Perceptual Distance Through A Jacobian Lens
summary: Image compression, restoration, and generation all require a way to measure how different two images look to a person. Pixel error ignores how people see, while the most accurate perceptual distances are typically fitted to human judgments, tying them to a fixed data and resolution. For example, when image resolution is doubled, the correlation of DISTS with human scores on TID2013 drops from 0.815 to 0.717. We introduce the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), which derives its perceptual geometry from a frozen vision encoder rather than from human labels. JLD combines the locality of early patch features with the perceptual sensitivity captured by later encoder representations. Specifically, we use the encoder Jacobian to identify directions in the early feature space that most strongly affect the encoder output, producing a fixed metric tensor, $E[J^\top J]$, which we call the Jacobian lens. The lens is fitted only once from 100 unlabeled images, taking about 35 seconds. Locally, this construction defines a pullback metric in pixel space, giving JLD a clear geometric interpretation that can be directly analyzed on real images. Across four standard perceptual databases, JLD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms LPIPS, DISTS, PieAPP, and DreamSim. JLD is also robust to changes in image resolution, on TID2013, its lens-term correlation remains nearly unchanged when the resolution is doubled, decreasing only from 0.850 to 0.845. We further introduce JLD-fast, which is $4\times$ faster than LPIPS-VGG while achieving a mean correlation of 0.911. Finally, JLD naturally extends to video, reaching a correlation of 0.786 on Waterloo IVC 4K compared with 0.611 for VMAF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD)，一种从冻结视觉编码器几何结构导出的感知距离度量，无需拟合人类主观评分，在多个感知数据库上达到 SOTA，并对分辨率变化鲁棒，同时可扩展至视频评估。
AI.motivation: 图像压缩、复原与生成都需要衡量两幅图像在人眼中的视觉差异。像素误差无法反映人眼感知，而现有高精度感知距离多依赖人类主观判断拟合，因而受限于固定数据集与分辨率（如分辨率翻倍后 DISTS 与 TID2013 人类评分的相关性从 0.815 降至 0.717）。作者希望构建一种不依赖人类标签、具有明确几何解释且对分辨率鲁棒的感知距离。
AI.method: JLD 从冻结视觉编码器中提取感知几何：结合早期 patch 特征的局部性与深层表示的感知敏感性，利用编码器 Jacobian 识别早期特征空间中影响编码器输出最强的方向，得到固定度量张量 E[J^T J]，称为 Jacobian lens。该 lens 只需用 100 张无标签图像拟合一次，耗时约 35 秒。在局部上，该构造在像素空间定义了一个 pullback 度量，使 JLD 具备可在真实图像上直接分析的清晰几何解释。作者还提出加速版本 JLD-fast。
AI.result: 在四个标准感知数据库上，JLD 取得 SOTA 性能，持续优于 LPIPS、DISTS、PieAPP 和 DreamSim。对分辨率变化具有鲁棒性：在 TID2013 上分辨率翻倍时，其 lens-term 相关性几乎不变，仅从 0.850 降至 0.845。JLD-fast 比 LPIPS-VGG 快 4 倍，平均相关性达 0.911。JLD 还可自然扩展至视频，在 Waterloo IVC 4K 上相关性达 0.786，而 VMAF 仅为 0.611。
AI.conclusion: JLD 通过冻结编码器的 Jacobian 几何提供了一种不依赖人类标签的感知距离，具备明确几何解释、SOTA 精度、分辨率鲁棒性、高计算效率及视频扩展能力，是图像与视频感知质量评估的有效方案。

title: Decomposition-Guided Curvelet Thresholding for Sharp-to-Soft CT Kernel Conversion
summary: Image denoising is a crucial task in image processing, focused on improving image quality by minimizing noise while maintaining essential structural elements. This study presents a hybrid denoising framework that combines several decomposition techniques, including empirical mode decomposition (EMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), multichannel EMD (MEMD), and bidimensional EMD (BEMD), with curvelet transform thresholding. Each decomposition mode undergoes processing through both soft and hard thresholding, and the denoised modes are combined to rebuild the final image. Comprehensive evaluations of standard CT image datasets reconstructed with various kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36) reveal substantial enhancements in denoising efficacy. VMD consistently achieves the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), signifying exceptional noise reduction and feature preservation. The study analyses the trade-offs between soft and hard thresholding: soft thresholding maintains intricate visual details, whilst harsh thresholding provides enhanced noise reduction. The suggested method surpasses traditional techniques in both reference and non-reference quality criteria, indicating its potential for broader application in medical imaging and future incorporation with adaptive thresholding algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将EMD、VMD、MEMD、BEMD分解与曲波变换阈值处理相结合的混合图像去噪框架，在CT图像上验证VMD性能最优。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪需在降低噪声的同时保留关键结构信息，传统单一去噪方法难以兼顾噪声抑制与特征保持，因此需要融合多种分解技术与阈值策略以提升去噪效果。
AI.method: 构建混合去噪框架：分别采用经验模式分解（EMD）、变分模式分解（VMD）、多通道EMD（MEMD）和二维EMD（BEMD）进行分解，并结合曲波变换阈值处理；对每种分解模式同时施加软阈值与硬阈值处理，再将去噪后的模式分量重构为最终图像。
AI.result: 在采用不同重建核（B50、B46、B41、B36）的标准CT图像数据集上评估，去噪效果显著提升；VMD在峰值信噪比（PSNR）和结构相似度（SSIM）上始终最高，兼具优异的噪声抑制与特征保留能力；软阈值更好保留细节，硬阈值噪声抑制更强；该方法在参考与非参考质量指标上均优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 该混合分解-阈值去噪框架在医学CT图像去噪中表现优越，具备在医学成像领域推广及未来与自适应阈值算法结合的潜力。

title: Can Language Models Learn to Reject Their Own Bad Reasoning Steps?
summary: Verifier-guided decoding can prevent harmful reasoning steps from contaminating subsequent generation, but typically relies on an external learned verifier. We ask whether a language model can instead reject its own bad reasoning steps. We define a prefix's recoverability as the probability that the frozen generator can complete it correctly. Diagnostics show that adjacent recoverability changes are often difficult to resolve with practical Monte Carlo budgets, while same-prefix candidates exhibit a sparse low-recoverability tail. We introduce Self-Step Rejection (SSR), which trains a lightweight LoRA acceptance gate on the generator backbone while keeping the base model frozen. SSR uses confidence-qualified first-passage supervision: steps before the first resolved crossing of a root-relative recoverability barrier are accepted, the crossing step is rejected, and unresolved steps and suffixes are excluded. Training combines pointwise classification, same-prefix pairwise learning, and group-relative policy refinement using final-answer correctness. At inference, SSR accepts candidates or resamples from the unchanged prefix under rejection budgets, without an external learned verifier. Across three reasoning models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SSR improves macro-average accuracy over single-pass decoding by 5.4--10.1 points using 1.21--1.40x as many generated tokens, and achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among evaluated step-level methods. Full-solution scaling methods require 4.47--8.27x the single-pass token cost for comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 提出自步拒绝（SSR）：让冻结生成器通过轻量 LoRA 接受门实现自我拒绝坏推理步，无需外部验证器。
AI.motivation: 现有验证器引导解码虽能阻止有害推理步污染后续生成，但依赖外部学习型验证器，成本高且需要额外训练。作者希望探究语言模型能否自行拒绝自身的坏推理步。
AI.method: 定义前缀可恢复性（冻结生成器正确完成该前缀的概率）。诊断发现相邻前缀可恢复性变化难以用实际蒙特卡洛预算区分，而同一前缀候选存在稀疏的低可恢复性尾部。基于此提出SSR：在冻结生成器主干上训练轻量LoRA接受门；采用置信度合格的首达监督——根相对可恢复性障碍首次被跨越前的步骤接受、跨越步拒绝、未解析步骤与后缀剔除；训练结合逐点分类、同前缀成对学习与基于最终答案正确性的组相对策略优化。推理时在拒绝预算下接受候选或从不变前缀重采样。
AI.result: 在3个推理模型与5个数学推理基准上，SSR相对单遍解码将宏平均准确率提升5.4–10.1个百分点，仅多用1.21–1.40倍生成token，在评估的步级方法中取得最高宏平均准确率；全解缩放方法需4.47–8.27倍单遍token成本才能达到相当性能。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可在无外部验证器情况下自我拒绝坏推理步，SSR以极低token开销显著提升推理准确率，优于步级与全解缩放基线。

title: StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs
summary: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.

AI.tldr: StagQ：一种多位宽权重量化格式，主流为2-bit分组仿射基加可配置1-bit细化平面，任意支持的精度都是可读前缀，无需按权重查表，并配有稀疏旁记录处理难拟合权重。
AI.motivation: 在集群中部署LLM需要多种权重精度操作点，传统做法为每种精度各存一份权重副本，存储开销大；需要一种单一码流即可服务多种精度的统一量化格式。
AI.method: 主流采用2-bit分组仿射基，后接若干1-bit细化平面，细化步长按二进制（dyadic）阶梯递减；每种精度对应码流的一个前缀，通过所有精度共享的元数据所导出的仿射映射解码，无需逐权重查找；额外的稀疏旁记录在网格拟合前后两次填充，用于存储网格拟合最差的少量权重；报告了编码器的两种配置。
AI.result: 2-bit廉价配置在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B上分别领先最强多位宽基线3.1至7.0个MMLU点，逻辑速率略低；3-bit配置在Llama-3.1-8B上领先、Phi-4上以更高速率领先、OLMo-2-7B上持平；4-bit在三个模型上均持平但速率更高。在NVIDIA A100上进行batch=1矩阵-向量乘（合成权重计时），多数形状-精度组合下内核快于两个基线内核。
AI.conclusion: StagQ以单一前缀可读码流支撑多个精度操作点，在低比特下精度优于现有多位宽基线并保持较高逻辑速率，同时GPU内核在多数情形下更具速度优势，适合多精度LLM部署。

title: Byte Language Models: Scaling, Emergent Abstractions, and Information Allocation
summary: Tokenizer-free language models remove the inductive bias of fixed tokenizers by modeling text directly as bytes, but the resulting longer sequences substantially increase computation and eliminate explicit text abstractions. We ask whether this additional computation can be useful, and whether standard Transformers can learn the abstractions that tokenization provides. We study these questions on Transformers without specialized tokenization-related architectures. With token-superposition training and hash embeddings, byte Transformers consistently outperform subword Transformers as model size scales. We further find that byte Transformers build local text abstractions as external tokenizers: a set of segmentation-like positions are used to collect local context representations, and restricting up to $25\%$ of intermediate layers to these local representations preserves downstream performance. Finally, these learned structures induce highly non-uniform generation difficulty, with uncertainty concentrated near local structure boundaries; exploiting them for speculative decoding yields $3.4\times$ more accepted tokens than in subword Transformers.

AI.tldr: 无分词器（byte）语言模型去除了固定分词器的归纳偏置，但序列变长、算力增加且缺乏显式文本抽象。本文在标准Transformer上研究这些额外算力是否有用、以及能否学到分词提供的抽象。通过token-superposition训练与hash embeddings，byte Transformer随规模增大持续优于子词模型，并自发学到类似分词的局部抽象结构，可用于加速推测解码。
AI.motivation: 分词器会引入固定归纳偏置，而无分词器语言模型虽直接以字节建模文本、去除了该偏置，却带来两个问题：序列长度显著增加导致计算量上升；同时失去了显式的文本抽象（如分词提供的分割结构）。作者由此提出两个核心问题：这部分额外计算是否能带来收益？标准Transformer能否自行学到分词所提供的抽象？
AI.method: 研究在无专门分词相关架构的标准Transformer上进行，采用token-superposition训练与hash embeddings。通过对比byte Transformer与subword Transformer在不同模型规模下的表现，并分析中间层表示，考察模型是否形成类似分词的分割位置及局部上下文表示。进一步通过限制最多25%的中间层仅使用这些局部表示来验证其功能等价性，并利用所学结构进行推测解码。
AI.result: 随模型规模扩大，byte Transformer持续优于subword Transformer。分析发现byte Transformer会构建类似外部分词器的局部文本抽象：存在一组分割样位置用于收集局部上下文表示，将最多25%的中间层限制为这些局部表示仍能保持下游性能。此外，这些学习到的结构导致生成难度高度不均，不确定性集中在局部结构边界附近；利用这一特性进行推测解码，可接受的token数比subword Transformer多3.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 无分词器模型所带来的额外计算并非浪费：标准Transformer能够在无专门分词架构的情况下自行学到分词所提供的抽象结构。这些自发形成的局部抽象既支撑下游性能，又可用于加速推测解码，表明去除固定分词器偏置在规模化下具有优势。

title: Breaking the Tie: A Cluster-Aware Routing Framework for Large Language Models
summary: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the emergence of various Large Language Models (LLMs) has created a rich model ecosystem. However, this also brings a key challenge: how to select the optimal model for a specific user query. LLM routing addresses this need by dynamically assigning queries to the most suitable expert in the pool of candidate models. However, existing routing frameworks often simplify this process to a standard classification task; thus, a critical vulnerability is exposed when multiple candidate models correctly answer the same query. We formalize this capability overlap as routing noise, which misleads the router with arbitrarily correct candidate models, ultimately leading to routing collapse (a severe decline in generalization ability on unseen tasks). To address this problem, we propose a novel Cluster-Aware Soft-Labeling Routing (CASLR) framework. CASLR shifts the evaluation paradigm from the success of a single query to macro-domain consensus by replacing traditional one-hot vectors with a masked softmax mechanism. Specifically, for experts who answer incorrectly, we penalize their target probability to zero; for the remaining candidates, we directly compute continuous fine-grained soft labels based on their global clustering utility scores. We then use these refined soft labels to supervise a lightweight router. Specifically, the framework not only demonstrates superior accuracy on multiple benchmarks, but also outperforms Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct by 7.80% in overall average performance. Furthermore, the extremely low routing inference latency of only 1.13s further confirms that CASLR can achieve efficient system scheduling with almost zero additional overhead, while ensuring high response quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CASLR 框架，将 LLM 路由从单查询成功范式转为宏域共识，用掩码 softmax 生成软标签监督轻量路由器，缓解路由噪声与路由崩溃问题，并在准确性、性能和时延上取得优势。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 生态日益丰富，如何为特定用户查询选择最优模型成为关键挑战。现有 LLM 路由框架常将路由简化为标准分类任务，当多个候选模型都能正确回答同一查询时会暴露严重脆弱性。作者将这种能力重叠形式化为"路由噪声"，它会让路由器被任意正确的候选模型误导，最终导致"路由崩溃"，即在未见任务上泛化能力严重下降。
AI.method: 提出 Cluster-Aware Soft-Labeling Routing（CASLR）框架。其核心是将评估范式从单个查询的成功转向宏域共识，用掩码 softmax 机制替代传统 one-hot 向量：对回答错误的专家，将其目标概率惩罚为零；对剩余候选模型，直接基于其全局聚类效用分数计算连续的细粒度软标签，再用这些精炼软标签监督一个轻量级路由器。
AI.result: 该框架在多个基准上展现出更优的准确性，整体平均性能比 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 高出 7.80%。同时路由推理延迟极低，仅为 1.13s，表明 CASLR 能在几乎零额外开销的情况下实现高效系统调度，同时保证高响应质量。
AI.conclusion: CASLR 通过将路由噪声问题形式化，并以聚类感知的软标签监督轻量路由器，有效缓解了路由崩溃，兼顾准确性、整体性能与推理效率，为 LLM 路由的动态专家选择提供了一种高效且低开销的解决方案。

title: Label-Free Coreset Selection with Foundation Models for Efficient Annotation in Computational Pathology
summary: Computational pathology has the potential to improve clinical outcomes through a demonstrated increase in diagnostic and prognostic accuracy. However, the development and validation of deep learning algorithms still require annotated data, a costly procedure involving expert pathologists who already face critical workforce shortages. Existing coreset selection methods to optimize annotation efforts currently all rely on hyperparameters tuned on natural-image benchmarks that do not transfer to histopathology and are cumbersome to use in clinical practice. In this study, we present GCcore, a novel label-free coreset selection method that embeds every image of a dataset with any pathology foundation model and greedily selects the samples that collectively maximize the global coverage of the embedding space. The proposed method provides a lower-bound guarantee on the global coverage of the returned coreset for any coreset size, while being completely hyperparameter-free and deterministic. We demonstrate GCcore's superior performance over 14 baselines including state-of-the-art methods across 10 tasks and datasets spanning whole slide image classification, tile classification, and tissue segmentation, where it ranks first on six and within the top three on nine, while also demonstrating how existing methods can shift by up to five rank positions depending on their hyperparameter settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/OncoAI-ULBHUB/GCcore.

AI.tldr: 提出GCcore——一种无标签、无超参数、确定性的coreset选择方法，通过贪婪最大化病理基础模型嵌入空间的全局覆盖，在10个任务/数据集上超越14个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 计算病理深度学习算法开发与验证依赖病理学家标注数据，而病理专家面临严重人力短缺。现有coreset选择方法均依赖在自然图像基准上调优的超参数，无法迁移到组织病理学，且临床使用繁琐。
AI.method: GCcore使用任意病理基础模型对数据集每张图像进行嵌入，然后贪婪地选择能够共同最大化嵌入空间全局覆盖的样本。该方法对任意coreset大小提供全局覆盖的下界保证，且完全无超参数、具有确定性。
AI.result: 在涵盖全切片图像分类、图像块分类和组织分割的10个任务与数据集上，GCcore在6个任务中排名第一，9个任务中进入前三，优于14个基线（含最先进方法）；同时证明现有方法会因超参数设置不同而排名波动多达5位。
AI.conclusion: GCcore为病理图像标注优化提供了一种高效、易用且稳健的coreset选择方案，代码已开源。

title: From Transformation to Target State: Rethinking Query Representation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a desired target image from a query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. This task exhibits an unusual representational asymmetry: the modification text specifies a transition from the reference state, whereas retrieval candidates depict completed target states. This creates a representation mismatch for zero-shot methods that query pretrained vision-language spaces directly with transformation-oriented language. We study this mismatch and reformulate zero-shot composed image retrieval as target-state reconstruction followed by retrieval. We instantiate this formulation with ASAP-CIR, a training-free framework that reconstructs a static target representation using a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). The representation combines multiple holistic descriptions with a variable set of importance-weighted atomic semantics, thereby preserving both overall target identity and fine-grained visual constraints. Retrieval then integrates holistic state alignment, atomic constraint grounding, and calibrated target-state evidence aggregation. A controlled text-only diagnostic shows that target-side static query formulations achieve more reliable retrieval than dynamic composed query formulations, particularly when source-state semantics must be suppressed or transformed. Experiments on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO further characterize the effectiveness and limitations of this representation principle, with the clearest gains on the multi-target CIRCO benchmark. These results show that how composed intent is represented before retrieval is a consequential design choice, distinct from the choice of retrieval backbone itself.

AI.tldr: 将零样本组合图像检索重新表述为"目标状态重建+检索"，提出免训练框架 ASAP-CIR，用冻结 MLLM 重建静态目标表示（整体描述+重要性加权原子语义），在 FashionIQ、CIRR、CIRCO 上验证，CIRCO 多目标场景增益最明显。
AI.motivation: 组合图像检索（CIR）存在罕见的表示不对称性：修改文本描述的是从参考状态出发的"转换过程"，而检索候选图像呈现的是已完成的"目标状态"。零样本方法直接用面向转换的语言查询预训练视觉-语言空间，导致表示错配。作者认为"检索前如何表示组合意图"本身是关键设计选择，而非仅取决于检索骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出 ASAP-CIR 免训练框架：先用冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）重建静态目标表示，该表示由多组整体性描述与一组可变数量的重要性加权原子语义组成，从而兼顾目标整体身份与细粒度视觉约束；检索阶段整合整体状态对齐、原子约束接地与校准后的目标状态证据聚合三个环节。
AI.result: 受控的纯文本诊断实验表明：目标侧静态查询表述比动态组合查询表述检索更可靠，尤其在需要抑制或变换源状态语义时；在 FashionIQ、CIRR、CIRCO 三个基准上进一步刻画了该表示原则的有效性与局限，其中多目标的 CIRCO 基准上增益最清晰。
AI.conclusion: 将零样本 CIR 建模为目标状态重建后再检索是有效的表示原则；组合意图在检索前的表示方式是一项具有实际影响的设计选择，其作用独立于检索骨干网络本身。

title: Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine
comment: Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each API as a finite-state machine, representing the system as abstract states that determine when each tool may be called, producing state-valid sequences of tools; sequences are translated into complete examples with a single LLM call. Rather than optimize diversity, we set a target distribution over the number of turns, the tool sequence and task complexity. We measure data quality by fine-tuning SLMs on generated trajectories, showing that our FSM-based generation significantly improves downstream accuracy over an unmutated baseline and, against existing works, reaches 70.7% full accuracy over 63.4% and 53.7% with 3.6-6.6$\times$ fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于有限状态机（FSM）的全自动轻量级数据合成框架，用于为小语言模型（SLM）生成多轮工具调用微调数据，以低成本达到更高下游准确率。
AI.motivation: 基础小语言模型虽部署成本低、可跑在私有基础设施上，但在多轮工具调用上表现不足；而微调需要各API的真实数据，这类数据稀缺。现有合成方法需为不同领域构建模拟运行环境，且每生成一轮对话就要多次调用LLM，成本过高，难以支撑大规模微调。
AI.method: 将每个API建模为有限状态机，用抽象状态表示系统，决定每个工具何时可被调用，从而生成状态合法的工具序列；再通过单次LLM调用把工具序列翻译成完整训练样本。该方法不追求多样性优化，而是为目标分布设定约束，即对轮数、工具序列和任务复杂度设定目标分布。
AI.result: 通过在生成轨迹上微调SLM来评估数据质量，基于FSM的生成相比未变异基线显著提升下游准确率；与现有工作相比，全准确率达到70.7%（对比63.4%和53.7%），同时token消耗减少3.6–6.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于FSM的轻量级自动合成框架能在显著降低数据生成成本（更少LLM调用与token）的前提下，为小语言模型提供高质量的多轮工具调用微调数据，并取得优于现有方法的下游性能。

title: A BEMD-Based Quaternion Filtering Approach Sharp-to-Soft Kernel CT Image Conversion
summary: The quality of computed tomography (CT) images is significantly affected by the selection of reconstruction kernels: sharp kernels improve spatial resolution but increase noise, whereas soft kernels diminish noise at the expense of edge clarity. This study presents an innovative enhancement framework utilising Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition in conjunction with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (BEMD--QBF) to convert sharp-kernel CT images into representations resembling soft-kernels, while maintaining critical anatomical structures. The technique disaggregates each image into intrinsic mode functions via BEMD and analyzes them inside a cohesive quaternion framework to attain efficient noise reduction and structural integrity. The proposed methodology is evaluated using several reconstruction kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36, B35, B31) and compared with recognised filtering strategies, including Non-Local Means, Anisotropic Diffusion, Bilateral Filtering, and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering. Quantitative evaluations of the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) indicate that BEMD-QBF consistently attains superior structural fidelity and competitive noise reduction across all evaluated kernels. The results underscore the efficacy of the proposed strategy as a viable approach to enhancing post-reconstruction CT images, yielding superior image quality without requiring access to raw projection data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEMD-QBF混合框架，将锐核CT图像转换为类软核表示，在保持解剖结构的同时实现降噪与结构保真。
AI.motivation: CT重建核选择存在分辨率与噪声的固有权衡：锐核提升空间分辨率但噪声增加，软核降噪却损失边缘清晰度。本文旨在无需原始投影数据的情况下，对重建后的CT图像进行质量增强。
AI.method: 采用二维经验模态分解（BEMD）将图像分解为多个本征模态函数，并在统一的四元数框架内结合四元数双边滤波（QBF）进行处理，实现高效降噪与结构完整性保持。在B50、B46、B41、B36、B35、B31等多种重建核上评估，并与非局部均值、各向异性扩散、双边滤波及四元数双边滤波对比。
AI.result: SSIM与PSNR定量评估表明，BEMD-QBF在所有评估的重建核上均持续取得更优的结构保真度，并具备具竞争力的降噪性能。
AI.conclusion: 该策略可作为后重建CT图像增强的可行方案，无需访问原始投影数据即可获得更优图像质量。

title: On Color Alignment in VAE Latent Spaces and Its Applications
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are a key part of modern text-to-image models, which generate images within their latent space. VAEs are known to disentangle the main factors of variation in the data, and color is known to be one of the most structured of these in natural images: decorrelating it yields one luminance axis and two opponent-color axes. Color should therefore be expected to emerge as a distinct factor in the VAE latent space. Yet how these latent spaces represent color remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that the VAEs of text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-colors. Through a linear approximation of the encoder and targeted latent steering, we find this subspace consistently across a broad range of VAEs, from SD1.5 to FLUX.2 and Z-Image. Building on this characterization, we propose three applications: ColorTuning, which achieves state-of-the-art in precise numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench, saturation control, to adjust the global chromatic intensity, and color transfer, to change the palette to match a reference. The code and models are publicly available at https://julian075.github.io/Color_Subspace/

AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到图像模型的VAE潜空间中存在一个与亮度和对立色对齐的共享彩色子空间，并基于此提出 ColorTuning、饱和度控制和颜色迁移三项应用。
AI.motivation: VAE是现代文本到图像模型生成图像的关键组件，其潜空间被认为能解耦数据的主要变化因素。自然图像中颜色是最具结构性的因素之一（去相关后可得到一条亮度轴和两条对立色轴），因此颜色理应在VAE潜空间中作为独立因素出现，但现有研究对其潜空间如何表征颜色仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 作者通过编码器的线性近似与有针对性的潜空间引导（latent steering），在从 SD1.5 到 FLUX.2 和 Z-Image 的广泛VAE中一致地定位并刻画该彩色子空间；并在此基础上设计了三项应用：ColorTuning（细粒度数值颜色生成）、饱和度控制（调节全局色彩强度）和颜色迁移（匹配参考图像调色板）。
AI.result: 实验表明，文本到图像模型的VAE共享一个与亮度和对立色对齐的彩色子空间；利用该子空间，ColorTuning 在 GenColorBench 的细粒度 CSS3/X11 颜色体系上取得了精确数值颜色生成的最先进性能，饱和度控制与颜色迁移也验证了该子空间的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VAE潜空间中的彩色子空间是跨模型稳健且可解释的结构，可作为统一接口实现精确颜色控制；代码与模型已公开。

title: LRCC: Generalizing Low-Rank Compression with Conditional Computation
summary: Low-rank compression reduces the cost of pretrained language models by replacing linear transformations with low-rank factorizations. However, conventional methods use a fixed rank allocation during inference, assigning the same amount of compute regardless of the input token. We introduce Low-Rank Conditional Computation (LRCC), which adds token-dependent computation to pretrained models by training one lightweight router per Transformer block to select among a small set of nested low-rank paths. During training, the low-rank factors remain frozen, and only the routers are optimized. We evaluate LRCC on Llama and Qwen models for language modeling and zero-shot downstream tasks. Within the same average active-parameter budget, LRCC improves the predictive performance over static low-rank compression, including a 7.6 percentage-point gain in average downstream accuracy on Llama-2-7B over static methods. At matched batch-size-1 decoding latency, LRCC improves both perplexity and downstream accuracy on Llama-3.2-1B and remains competitive on Llama-2-7B, without specialized kernels. Finally, we assess the usefulness of assigning a token-wise path by analyzing the routers' path choices.

AI.tldr: LRCC通过在Transformer各层加入轻量路由器，使低秩压缩模型能根据输入token动态选择嵌套低秩路径，仅训练路由器即可在相同平均激活参数预算下超越静态低秩压缩。
AI.motivation: 传统低秩压缩在推理时采用固定秩分配，对所有token分配相同计算量，忽略了不同token对计算需求的差异，造成计算资源利用不充分。
AI.method: LRCC在每个Transformer块训练一个轻量路由器，从一组嵌套低秩路径中选择；训练时冻结低秩分解因子，仅优化路由器参数，从而为预训练模型引入token相关的条件计算。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen模型的语言建模与零样本下游任务上，相同平均激活参数预算下LRCC优于静态低秩压缩，Llama-2-7B平均下游准确率提升7.6个百分点；在batch-size-1解码延迟匹配条件下，Llama-3.2-1B的困惑度和下游准确率均有提升，Llama-2-7B保持竞争力，且无需专用kernel。
AI.conclusion: LRCC以极低的训练成本为预训练模型赋予token级动态计算能力，在同等计算预算和延迟下提升性能，路由器路径选择分析进一步验证了token-wise路径分配的有效性。

title: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
summary: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"检索诱导潜在转移模型"，将超声操作引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索问题；基于V-JEPA 2.1编码图像并检索参考库中相似视图的探头位姿，用非参数的物理转移替代参数化动力学，无需探头追踪硬件即可实时引导。
