AI.motivation: 超声成像质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求增长快于合格超声技师供给。现有操作者引导系统旨在帮助经验较少的用户把探头移动到目标视图，但需要一种能准确刻画超声采集动态、且部署时无需额外追踪硬件的引导方案。
AI.method: 1) 采用V-JEPA 2.1骨干网络，将观测编码到解剖相关视图彼此靠近的潜在空间；2) 建立参考数据库，存储编码潜在状态及对应的探头位置与朝向；3) 不学习参数化转移函数，而是直接检索数据库中的物理执行转移，构建非参数、检索诱导的转移模型，支持滚动时域（receding-horizon）规划；4) 部署时仅凭实时超声图像流生成引导，无需探头追踪硬件；5) 通过蒸馏在CPU上实时运行。
AI.result: 在颈动脉超声任务上，所提规划器在86%的回顾性闭环回合中到达目标视图，代表性基线分别为52%和43%；在每个目标视图（包括较难的颈内、颈外动脉纵切视图）上均优于两个基线。在未见志愿者的前瞻性可行性研究中，使用蒸馏方法在CPU上实时运行，达到83%的目标视图可达率。
AI.conclusion: 由于规划由与任意可编码目标潜在状态的接近程度驱动，同一世界模型可导航回任意先前采集的患者特异性帧，从而支持可重复的纵向成像，如围术期或随访监测。

title: D-Loop: Looped Diffusion Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Block diffusion accelerates speculative decoding by drafting multiple tokens in one forward pass. However, each position predicts a marginal distribution without observing earlier proposed tokens, limiting draft quality and acceptance length. We identify a concrete failure, the \emph{repetition trap}, in which neighboring positions produce redundant copies of the same token. We explain this tendency theoretically and empirically examine its association with shorter accepted drafts. Recent methods refine marginal predictions with an additional causal head or a separately trained drafter, increasing parameter storage and introducing separate training objectives. We instead propose D-Loop, which introduces \emph{intra-block causal conditioning} within the original diffusion drafter without additional model components. Inspired by semi-autoregressive generation and parameter sharing, D-Loop reuses the same backbone across looped passes. The first pass proposes a block, and the second conditions on a selected prefix to regenerate the suffix in parallel. A complementary prefix--suffix objective trains the shared drafter for both anchor-only prefix prediction and prefix-conditioned suffix prediction. Across eight math, code, and chat benchmarks, D-Loop can beat DFlash and DSpark on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with obvious gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 D-Loop，在扩散式推测解码草稿器内部引入块内因果条件，通过循环复用同一骨干网络两遍生成，无需额外模型组件，缓解重复陷阱并提升接受长度。
AI.motivation: 块扩散推测解码一次前向并行草拟多个 token，但每个位置仅预测边缘分布，无法观测同一块内先前提出的 token，导致草稿质量与接受长度受限。作者识别出具体失效模式——重复陷阱：相邻位置产生同一 token 的冗余副本，并从理论与实证两方面说明其与草稿接受长度变短的关联。现有方法用额外因果头或单独训练的草稿器来精修边缘预测，代价是参数存储增加与引入独立训练目标。
AI.method: D-Loop 不增加额外模型组件，在原始扩散草稿器内实现块内因果条件。受半自回归生成与参数共享启发，跨循环遍复用同一骨干：第一遍提出一个块，第二遍以选定的前缀为条件并行重生成后缀。配套的前缀—后缀联合目标训练共享草稿器，使其同时胜任仅锚点前缀预测与前缀条件下的后缀预测。
AI.result: 在八个数学、代码与对话基准上，D-Loop 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 上均能超过 DFlash 与 DSpark，且提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过循环复用共享骨干引入块内因果条件，D-Loop 以零额外参数组件的方式改善草稿质量与接受长度，验证了参数共享与半自回归条件化在扩散式推测解码中的有效性。

title: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究STVG模型在无关查询与文本缺失下的行为，发现当前模型仍能输出看似合理的时空预测，并指出数据集规律可能是诱因，呼吁引入负样本感知的评测协议与架构。
AI.motivation: 现有STVG模型普遍假设每个查询都与输入视频相关，忽略了查询无关或文本缺失的情形，这一假设可能掩盖模型的真实局限性。
AI.method: 在无关查询与缺失文本输入两种条件下，对当前最先进的STVG模型进行实验测试，并分析HCSTVG-v2与VidSTG数据集中的规律性。
AI.result: 即使查询与视频无关或完全移除，现有模型仍能生成看似合理的时空预测；数据集存在可能助长查询不敏感行为的规律。
AI.conclusion: STVG模型存在未被充分探索的局限，需引入显式评估查询相关性的负样本感知评测协议与架构。

title: Patch-based Querying Identifies Structures of Interest in Electron Microscopy
comment: 41 pages, 20 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Computers in Biology and Medicine
summary: Volume electron microscopy (vEM) has emerged as an essential sensing technique in biomedical research, allowing the three-dimensional imaging of biological cells and tissues at nanometer-scale resolution. The ability to generate extensive datasets has reached the limitations of downstream analysis processes, which depend significantly on the intervention of human experts for preprocessing and annotation. We propose an efficient and reliable patch-based retrieval framework based on self-supervised learning of local image descriptors to locate self-similar structures in vEM datasets. Given a few manual annotations of a given cellular structure, our method can retrieve similar structures across the EM volume. Our framework is interactive, allowing the human expert to refine the search queries and retrieve relevant image patches quickly and using little labeled data. Experiments on real-world vEM images of biological tissues demonstrate that our framework can reliably identify relevant cellular structures, generalize across different organelles and acquisition modalities, and substantially reduce the search space for downstream analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于自监督学习局部图像描述子的块检索框架，利用少量人工标注即可在vEM数据集中快速定位自相似结构，减少下游分析搜索空间。
AI.motivation: 体积电子显微镜(vEM)可在纳米尺度对细胞与组织进行三维成像，但海量数据的下游分析高度依赖人工专家的预处理与标注，成为瓶颈，亟需高效可靠的自动化检索手段。
AI.method: 采用基于图像块(patch-based)的检索框架，通过自监督学习训练局部图像描述子；给定某细胞结构的少量人工标注，在EM体积中检索相似结构。框架具有交互性，允许专家迭代细化搜索查询，借助少量标注数据实现快速检索。
AI.result: 在真实生物组织vEM图像上的实验表明，该框架能够可靠地识别相关细胞结构，可跨不同细胞器和不同采集模态泛化，并显著缩小下游分析的搜索空间。
AI.conclusion: 自监督局部描述子检索为vEM数据分析提供了一种高效、可交互且标注成本低的解决方案，具有跨结构、跨模态的通用性。

title: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Revised version with additional off-target, reward and SFT control, human evaluation, and OmniGen2 transfer results; clarified related work and experimental scope
summary: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO

AI.tldr: 该论文将"最小改动原则"作为基于指令图像编辑的优化目标，摒弃潜空间L1正则化，改用强化学习并结合智能体式视觉语言奖励模型（审计未实现改动与意外改动两类失败），在FLUX.1 Kontext-dev上提升EditScore并减少无关像素改动。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑应仅改变指令指定的属性并保留其余内容，但现有方法常产生非预期改动。作者希望把这一"最小改动"原则显式建模为优化目标；然而潜空间L1正则化对现代非线性生成器而言只是输出局部性的劣质代理指标，且通常需要难以大规模获取的监督信号。
AI.method: 作者用强化学习直接优化编辑结果。引入智能体式视觉语言奖励模型，对源图像、指令与编辑后图像进行审计，识别两类失败：请求改动未实现、非预期的改动；再通过组级评分规则（group-level rubric）对这些问题进行合并与验证，从而在无需逐指令人工标注的情况下为候选编辑提供一致奖励。方法命名为ARRO。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1 Kontext-dev上，ARRO将MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench与Emu-Edit上的平均EditScore从5.21提升至5.88；在600个评测样本上，相较基础编辑器减少8.4%的偏离目标像素改动。奖励与SFT对照实验、盲测人工评估及向OmniGen2的迁移提供了补充证据。
AI.conclusion: 以强化学习配合智能体式奖励模型来优化编辑结果，是替代潜空间L1正则化、实现指令编辑中最小改动的有效途径，且具备跨模型迁移能力。

title: Differentiable Bit-Widths: Co-optimizing Pruning and Quantization via SVD for Ultra-Efficient LLM Compression
comment: Accepted to Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: SVD-based pruning and quantization have recently emerged as a promising strategy for the ultra-efficient compression of large language models. In these methods, compression is performed in two stages: components are first truncated, and the remaining ones are subsequently quantized. Although this decoupled pipeline benefits from both pruning and quantization, it requires separate optimization for each stage and fails to fully exploit their balance, which can lead to suboptimal performance under aggressive compression. To address this limitation, we propose a new LLM compression method that co-optimizes pruning and quantization in a unified framework. Our key idea is a differentiable method for learning component-wise bit-widths, allowing less important components to be assigned 0-bit precision and pruned away. Notably, our method performs favorably against two-stage baselines, even when subjected to extreme quantization settings ($1.61$ bits) designed for ultra-efficiency. Code: https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架，通过可微的按分量比特宽度学习，联合优化SVD剪枝与量化，实现极端压缩（1.61比特）下优于两阶段方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SVD的剪枝与量化方法采用两阶段解耦流程：先截断分量，再量化剩余分量。该流程虽然兼得剪枝与量化之利，但需分别优化各阶段，无法充分挖掘二者之间的平衡，在激进压缩下性能次优。
AI.method: 提出在统一框架内联合优化剪枝与量化的新LLM压缩方法。核心是一个可微的分量级比特宽度学习方法，使不重要分量可被赋予0比特精度从而直接剪除，实现剪枝与量化的端到端协同优化。
AI.result: 在面向超高效率的极端量化设置（1.61比特）下，该方法仍优于两阶段基线方法。代码已开源于 https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW 。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化剪枝与量化的统一框架可有效克服两阶段解耦流程的局限，在极端压缩条件下取得更优性能。

title: LightMTP: Lightweight Latent Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LightMTP，一种轻量级、参数高效的潜在多token预测方法，利用模型自身隐藏状态自举未来token表示，最多仅增加1%参数，在通用语言建模与规划、编码、推理任务上保持或提升性能。
AI.motivation: 标准下一token预测（NTP）仅对紧邻的下一token提供显式训练信号，易使模型利用局部模式而难以捕捉长程结构与语义。现有多token预测（MTP）虽能预测多个未来token，但通常引入大量新参数且下游性能提升有限。潜在MTP通过将未来token编码为向量来提升效率，却往往依赖外部辅助模型提供未来token编码。
AI.method: 提出LightMTP，一种轻量级（参数高效）潜在MTP方法，从模型自身隐藏状态自举（bootstrap）未来token表示。设计了两种LightMTP变体，在不引入传统MTP额外计算开销、也不依赖潜在MTP通常所需的外部监督的前提下，将监督信号扩展到更多未来token。
AI.result: LightMTP最多仅增加1%的额外参数，在通用语言建模基准上保持更优性能，并在规划、编码和推理任务上取得相当的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: LightMTP以极低的参数开销实现潜在多token预测，无需外部辅助模型或显著计算开销，即可在语言建模与规划、编码、推理等下游任务上获得收益，为参数高效的多token预训练目标提供了有效方案。

title: How well do routinely collected demographic and clinical variables aid point-of-care lung ultrasound TB classification
summary: We consider the fusion of lung ultrasound images with routinely-collected clinical and demographic data for the purpose of automated tuberculosis (TB) screening using deep-learning. Such deep-learning based screening tools for TB could meaningfully support the health care system in Africa, where the burden of disease is severe and resources are constrained. Beginning with an established ResNet baseline for classification of lung ultrasound images, which achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic (AUROC) curve of 0.91 [0.86,0.96] (95% CI), we consider the incorporation of the clinical and demographic data using three fusion approaches. We find that a simple average-based fusion of the output scores of separately-trained image and clinical data classifiers consistently matches or outperforms a more complex approach where the data is fused earlier and a combined classifier is trained. Fusing the image and the clinical classifiers in this way leads to a classifier with an overall AUROC of 0.95 [0.91,0.99] (specificity of 0.76 at sensitivity 0.93) which is an improvement of 4% absolute over the image-only baseline. We also find that greedy feature selection can be used to reduce the number of clinical and demographic inputs without sacrificing classification performance. Finally, when we differentiate between clinical and demographic data that are self-reported, that require some basic measurement or calculation, and that require a point-of-care (POC) test, we find the inclusion of the POC tests included in this study to be of minimal benefit to classification performance. We conclude that the incorporation of routinely-collected clinical and demographic data is a promising way to improve the performance of lung ultrasound based automatic classification.

AI.tldr: 融合肺部超声图像与常规临床及人口学数据，采用简单分数平均融合策略可提升结核病自动筛查性能，AUROC从0.91提升至0.95。
AI.motivation: 非洲结核病负担重、资源有限，基于深度学习的肺部超声自动筛查工具有望支持医疗系统。研究旨在通过融合常规采集的临床与人口学数据来提升分类性能。
AI.method: 以ResNet为肺部超声图像的分类基线（AUROC 0.91），比较三种融合方式：简单平均融合、早期融合并联合训练分类器，以及结合贪心特征选择减少输入维度。并按数据来源（自报、需基本测量/计算、需即时检测POC）进行分类分析。
AI.result: 简单平均融合持续匹配或优于更复杂的早期融合。融合后整体AUROC达0.95（灵敏度0.93时特异度0.76），相比仅图像的基线绝对提升4%。贪心特征选择可在不降低性能的情况下减少临床与人口学输入。本研究中POC检测的加入对分类性能收益甚微。
AI.conclusion: 融合常规采集的临床与人口学数据是提升肺部超声自动分类性能的有效途径。

title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
summary: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合静态光照与闪光灯（闪光开/关，独立视角）的室内逆向渲染方法，基于2DGS框架引入"GS锚定漫反射场"（在2DGS深度处查询哈希编码MLP），实现视角一致的材质分解，在合成与真实室内场景中于漫反射色、反照率、粗糙度及重光照上超越六个基线（PSNR提升4.17 dB）。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖静态光照从照片恢复几何、材质与光照存在严重歧义；主动光照方案虽能降低歧义，但需要暗室或专用硬件，限制了实用性。作者希望利用日常室内随手拍摄（闪光灯开/关、各自独立视角）来协同两种光照信息，以低成本方式缓解歧义。
AI.method: 1) 协同静态光照与闪光光照：闪光残差约束反照率与BRDF，静态光照捕捉闪光缺失的掠射角高光。2) 以2DGS重建为框架，提出GS锚定漫反射场：在光栅化的2DGS深度处查询哈希编码MLP，因其仅依赖世界坐标，故在3D中视角一致，可让闪光残差驱动材质分解，避免被跨视角alpha混合漂移吸收。3) 用延迟着色渲染静态光照，使其同样监督材质分解。
AI.result: 在5个合成场景与3个真实室内场景上评测，本方法在漫反射颜色、反照率与粗糙度等材质参数上优于6个近期基线；重光照任务中PSNR比次优基线提升4.17 dB。
AI.conclusion: 将随意拍摄的静态与闪光光照进行协同，并借助2DGS锚定的视角一致漫反射场，可在无需专用硬件的条件下有效缓解逆向渲染歧义，显著提升材质估计与重光照质量。

title: Representation Disentanglement for Fair Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
summary: Deep learning has advanced chest X-ray (CXR) diagnosis, yet demographic biases in learned representations may contribute to performance disparities across intersectional groups. We propose a single-encoder framework combining dual-level decorrelation with prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning to reduce demographic dependence while accounting for within-class variation. We further propose Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR), a new metric that quantifies the reduction in demographic structure within disease representations. The framework is evaluated on four classification tasks using 34,809 CheXpert test images across eight intersectional groups, defined by age, sex and ethnicity. Compared with empirical risk minimization (ERM), our method reduces the mean equalized-odds gap from 15.41\% to 10.86\% and the AUC gap from 5.95\% to 5.01\%. Our method achieves a DRAR of 59.04\% relative to ERM, with only a slight decrease in mean AUC. These results demonstrate that representation disentanglement can reduce demographic bias and improve intersectional fairness. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging}.

AI.tldr: 提出单编码器框架（双重去相关+原型引导跨群体对比学习）并新增DRAR指标，在CheXpert交集群体上降低人口统计偏差并提升公平性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习已推动胸部X光（CXR）诊断发展，但所学表示中的人口统计偏差可能导致不同交集群体间性能差异，需在考虑类内变化的同时降低人口统计依赖。
AI.method: 单编码器框架：结合双重层级去相关（dual-level decorrelation）与原型引导的跨群体对比学习（prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning）；提出新指标DRAR（Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction），量化疾病表示中人口统计结构的减少程度。在34,809张CheXpert测试图像、按年龄/性别/种族划分的八个交集群体、四个分类任务上评估。
AI.result: 相较ERM，平均均衡赔率差距由15.41%降至10.86%，AUC差距由5.95%降至5.01%；DRAR相对ERM达59.04%，平均AUC仅略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 表示解耦可降低人口统计偏差并改善交集公平性。

title: Backdooring Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used not only to interpret language models but also to intervene on their internal representations. We show that this creates a supply-chain attack surface: a maliciously modified SAE can induce attacker-chosen behavior when inserted into the forward pass of an otherwise unchanged language model. We introduce a decoder-only SAE backdoor that leaves both the underlying LLM and the SAE encoder frozen, restricting the attack to a single auxiliary component at a single insertion layer. Using code generation as a case study, we demonstrate high rates of unsolicited code insertion across three language models and a wide range of insertion layers, as well as trigger-dependent behavior conditioned on a prompt cue. We further evaluate the modified SAEs using HumanEval and selected SAEBench metrics. While attack effectiveness varies across models and layers, strong backdoor behavior can coexist with relatively small changes in several conventional SAE quality measures. These results establish that SAEs can carry behavioral backdoors without modifying the language model itself and should therefore be treated as security-sensitive components.

AI.tldr: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）不仅用于解释语言模型，还可用于干预其内部表示；本文揭示这构成一条供应链攻击面：恶意修改的 SAE 插入冻结语言模型的前向传播后，可诱导攻击者指定行为，且常规 SAE 质量指标变化很小，说明 SAE 应被视为安全敏感组件。
AI.motivation: SAE 正从可解释性工具扩展为干预语言模型内部表示的组件，但此前缺乏对其作为可被篡改的供应链环节的安全评估。作者希望探究：在不改动底层 LLM 的情况下，单独向某一插入层注入一个被恶意修改的 SAE，是否足以植入行为后门。
AI.method: 提出一种仅解码器（decoder-only）的 SAE 后门：保持底层 LLM 与 SAE 编码器冻结，仅修改单个辅助组件且仅作用于单一插入层。以代码生成为案例，在三个语言模型和多种插入层上进行测试，涵盖无触发条件下的非请求代码插入以及基于提示线索的触发依赖行为，并用 HumanEval 和部分 SAEBench 指标评估被修改 SAE 的"质量"。
AI.result: 在三个语言模型和广泛的插入层范围内实现较高的非请求代码插入成功率，并能呈现由提示线索触发的条件行为。攻击效果因模型与层而异，但强后门行为可与多项常规 SAE 质量指标的较小变化共存，即现有指标难以察觉此类篡改。
AI.conclusion: SAE 能够在不修改语言模型本身的前提下携带行为后门，因此应被当作安全敏感组件对待，SAE 的分发与复用环节需要纳入供应链安全审查。

title: Local2Mesh: Spatially Localized Contour-to-Mesh for Left Ventricular Reconstruction from Sparse 2D Cardiac MRI
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) left ventricular (LV) reconstruction from sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging remains challenging due to inter-slice misalignment and insufficient local spatial information between slices. Global aggregation of contour features may obscure local contour-to-surface relationships. We propose Local2Mesh, a spatially localized contour-to-mesh framework that deforms a template mesh to reconstruct 3D LV geometry from sparse 2D contours without 3D mesh annotations. The framework introduces geometry-aware alignment to correct inter-slice misalignment and a plane-aware Local Router that routes contour features to template vertices using vertex-to-plane distances. Local and global contour features then jointly guide graph-based template deformation for 3D LV reconstruction. Experiments on two public datasets, M\&Ms-2 and ACDC, demonstrate superior geometric reconstruction and functional estimation over existing methods. Zero-shot transfer from M\&Ms-2 to ACDC demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Reconstructed meshes also improve disease classification over sparse contours, supporting their utility for downstream cardiac analysis. These results demonstrate that combining geometry-aware alignment with local contour-to-vertex modeling improves LV reconstruction from sparse 2D contours and supports downstream cardiac analysis. The code is available at https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh.

AI.tldr: 提出Local2Mesh框架，通过几何感知对齐和平面感知Local Router将稀疏2D轮廓路由到模板网格顶点，实现无3D标注的3D左心室重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏CMR切片重建3D左心室面临层间错位与层间局部空间信息不足的问题；全局轮廓特征聚合会掩盖局部轮廓-表面的对应关系，因此需要空间局部化的建模方式。
AI.method: Local2Mesh以模板网格变形为核心，引入几何感知对齐纠正层间错位；设计平面感知Local Router，依据顶点到平面的距离将轮廓特征路由到模板顶点；局部与全局轮廓特征联合引导基于图的模板变形，且不需要3D网格标注。
AI.result: 在M&Ms-2与ACDC两个公开数据集上，几何重建与功能估计均优于现有方法；M&Ms-2到ACDC的零样本迁移展现强跨数据集泛化；重建网格相较稀疏轮廓提升了疾病分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知对齐与局部轮廓-顶点建模相结合，能有效提升稀疏2D轮廓的3D左心室重建质量并支持下游心脏分析。代码已开源。

title: ROT: Rotating Hidden States towards Contextual Vectors for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucination. Existing training-free interventions primarily manipulate attention weights, which indirectly affect the deep semantics reaching the final predictive layers. In this work, we shift our focus to the hidden state vectors extracted after self-attention and residual addition. Empirical analysis reveals that hallucinated tokens do not simply over-rely on linguistic priors; instead, they exhibit an anomalous contextual deviation, showing significantly lower similarities to both textual and visual contexts in intermediate layers. Motivated by this, we propose ROT, a layer-specific, training-free framework. ROT dynamically detects semantic deviation in the middle layers and applies a norm-preserving rotation to steer the hidden states back toward the local multimodal context plane spanned by the contexts. For subsequent layers, a representational smoothing mechanism is introduced to stabilize the calibrated trajectory. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ROT consistently reduces hallucinations across various model architectures and scales, offering an efficient, geometry-driven solution for grounded generation.

AI.tldr: 提出ROT框架，通过中层语义偏差检测与保范旋转校准隐状态，训练无关地缓解LVLM物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）普遍存在物体幻觉。现有免训练干预方法主要操纵注意力权重，仅间接影响抵达最终预测层的深层语义，未直接作用于隐状态表征本身。
AI.method: 分析发现幻觉token并非单纯过度依赖语言先验，而是在中间层呈现异常上下文偏差——与文本和视觉上下文的相似度均显著偏低。据此提出ROT：在中间层动态检测语义偏差，施加保范旋转（norm-preserving rotation），将隐状态推向由上下文张成的局部多模态上下文平面；在后续层引入表征平滑机制以稳定校准轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，ROT在不同模型架构与规模上均能持续降低幻觉，提供了一种高效且几何驱动的有据生成方案。
AI.conclusion: ROT作为层特定、免训练、基于几何的干预方法，通过直接校准隐状态有效缓解LVLM物体幻觉，兼具有效性与泛化性。

title: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/palmcity_challenge . Trained models available at https://huggingface.co/yunusserhat/palmcity-eomt-dinov3-large
summary: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer using DINOv3. The two leading candidates are trained independently with three random seeds and longer budgets. Equal averaging of class probabilities from the three Encoder only Mask Transformer models, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, produces 60.95% mean intersection over union and 71.16% mean F1 on the 84 image public validation split. The submitted predictions receive 57.08% mean intersection over union and 67.96% mean F1 on the hidden test leaderboard. Producing all 249 test masks takes 251.49 seconds including model initialization and provenance checks on one NVIDIA RTX 5090. Peak allocated GPU memory is 2.70 GiB. The study reports all eligible models, all inference variants, class level errors, source conditions, and reproducibility checks, providing a documented challenge workflow with existing architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PalmCity挑战赛第一名方案：在等算力预算下对比九种预训练分割系统，最终以DINOv3编码器+Mask Transformer、三随机种子等权概率平均、三尺度+水平翻转测试时增强取得最优效果。
AI.motivation: 街景全景语义分割可支撑城市环境的细粒度描述，但小规模数据集与不均衡的训练代价使模型选择困难；需要一套可控、可复现的选型与推理流程。
AI.method: 在近似相等计算预算下比较九种预训练分割系统（DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、DINOv3+线性解码器、Encoder-only Mask Transformer using DINOv3等）；对两个领先候选以三个随机种子和更长预算独立训练；对三个Encoder-only Mask Transformer模型做类别概率等权平均，并在三个图像尺度结合水平反射进行测试时增强。
AI.result: 84张公开验证集上达到60.95% mIoU、71.16% mean F1；隐藏测试榜57.08% mIoU、67.96% mean F1；生成全部249张测试掩码耗时251.49秒（含模型初始化与溯源检查），单张NVIDIA RTX 5090，峰值分配显存2.70 GiB。
AI.conclusion: 基于现有架构即可构建有文档记录的挑战赛工作流；论文完整报告所有合格模型、推理变体、类别级误差、来源条件与可复现性检查。

title: TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) assistants routinely decide whether they can trust users and third parties whose competence, intentions, and integrity they cannot verify. This uncertainty matters for safety, as trusting the wrong party can lead an agent to comply with harmful requests or act on malicious instructions encountered during tool use. To study this problem, we define trust as an assistant's willingness to accept vulnerability to the actions of another party and ask whether such behavior can be causally controlled through model activations. We build 2,000 contrastive conversations spanning ability, benevolence, and integrity, where paired responses complete the same request but differ in whether the assistant trusts the user. From these pairs, we learn steering matrices while keeping the model parameters frozen and test them across six instruction-tuned models from three families, finding that steering changes trust decisions monotonically in both directions. We then ask whether this effect extends to several safety-related agent settings involving harmful requests, prompt injections, and insider threats, while using benign-task and reasoning as controls. Our findings provide evidence that trust in the user can be causally controlled along linear directions in model activations and provide a way to study how trust shapes safety-relevant behavior in language models.

AI.tldr: 通过构建2000组对比对话学习激活引导矩阵，证明LLM对用户信任行为可沿线性方向被因果调控，且该调控会影响有害请求、提示注入、内部威胁等安全场景下的行为。
AI.motivation: LLM助手常需判断是否信任无法验证能力、意图与诚信的用户或第三方，错误信任可能导致顺从有害请求或执行工具使用中的恶意指令，因此需要探究信任行为能否被因果控制。
AI.method: 将信任定义为助手愿意接受对他人行为的脆弱性；构建覆盖能力、善意、诚信三要素的2000组对比对话，成对回复完成同一请求但信任与否不同；在冻结模型参数下学习引导矩阵，并在三个家族六个指令微调模型上测试。
AI.result: 引导可使信任决策双向单调变化；该效应延伸至有害请求、提示注入和内部威胁等安全相关代理场景，而良性任务与推理作为对照未受同等影响。
AI.conclusion: LLM对用户的信任可在激活空间中沿线性方向被因果控制，为研究信任如何塑造语言模型的安全相关行为提供了方法。

title: Attention Tax, Handoff Tax: A Stylised Model of When Multi-Agent LLM Systems Help
summary: Recent work on multi-agent LLM systems reaches sharply different conclusions: some results show that a single agent with the same information and compute should dominate a delegated system, others that multi-agent gains grow with task depth. We argue that much of the disagreement comes from modelling different bottlenecks, and introduce a stylised reliability model built around two trade-offs. Decomposition reduces the burden of long contexts but incurs a handoff tax when information is compressed or transferred between agents. Redundancy gains from multiple samples, but its benefit depends on how much their failures are shared. With reasoning budget, verification, and task structure added, the model yields two crossover conditions: decomposition becomes preferable once the attention cost avoided by resetting context exceeds the handoff cost, and parallel sampling at equal budget is eventually preferable when its shared-failure floor lies below the error floor of one agent thinking longer. We connect these regimes to recent theoretical and empirical results. On a ledger-reconciliation task we measure the context-degradation curve and the handoff tax from single-agent and handoff runs alone. From these the model places the crossover at depth 10 and predicts decomposition to win at depths 20, 50, and 100. It does, on step-level and final-balance accuracy, and the decomposed system's success, which the prediction never sees, lands within 9 percentage points of the predicted rate at every depth.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个风格化的多智能体LLM可靠性模型，用"分解-交接税"和"冗余-共享失败"两组权衡解释已有文献中单智能体与多智能体结论的分歧，并给出两个交叉条件；在账目核对任务上测得上下文退化曲线与交接税，模型预测深度10为交叉点，并在深度20/50/100上验证分解系统更优，成功率误差在9个百分点以内。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统研究结论尖锐对立：一派认为相同信息与算力下单智能体应占优，另一派认为多智能体收益随任务深度增长。作者认为分歧主要源于建模了不同的瓶颈，因而需要一个统一框架来刻画两种范式各自适用的条件。
AI.method: 提出一个风格化（stylised）可靠性模型，围绕两组权衡构建：(1) 分解降低长上下文负担，但信息压缩/转移时产生"交接税"（handoff tax）；(2) 冗余采样带来收益，但其效果取决于各样本失败的共享程度（shared-failure floor）。模型进一步纳入推理预算、验证与任务结构，推导出两个交叉条件：当重置上下文省下的注意力成本超过交接成本时分解更优；当等预算下并行采样的共享失败下界低于单智能体长思考的误差下界时，并行采样更优。在账目核对（ledger-reconciliation）任务上，仅用单智能体与交接运行的测量即可得到上下文退化曲线与交接税。
AI.result: 由上下文退化曲线与交接税，模型将交叉点定在深度10，并预测深度20、50、100时分解方案获胜。实验结果与预测一致：在步骤级与最终余额准确率上分解系统均更优；且分解系统的成功率（预测过程未使用该数据）在每个深度上都落在预测速率±9个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体与单智能体的表面矛盾可由不同瓶颈的建模差异统一解释，两个交叉条件给出了分解与并行采样各自的适用边界。少量单智能体与交接测量即可标定模型并外推到更深的未见任务深度，预测精度较高，表明该可靠性模型对多智能体LLM系统的设计选择具有指导价值。

title: Cross-Lingual Transferability of Training Data Extraction Attacks to Recover Memorized PII
summary: The robustness of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical concern, yet the risks associated with cross-lingual data extraction remain under-explored. This study evaluates the vulnerability of English-centric and multilingual models to Training Data Extraction (TDE) attacks when prompted in non-English languages. We construct a multi-domain PII dataset comprising social media handles, email addresses, and phone numbers and translate the attack contexts into Italian, Spanish, French, and German. Our results show that TDE attacks against both English-centric and multilingual models transfer to different languages: the attacks are successful on translated prompts, even though only the original English prompt might have been included in the pre-training data. A web-presence check on a sample of the translations confirms that they are not available online. The share of English leaks recovered in other languages grows with the multilingual capability of the model, and it drops sharply when the original wording is lost, even without a change of language. This suggests that native multilingual pre-training facilitates the emergence of latent cross-linguistic bridges that simplify the retrieval of personally identifiable information (PII). We analyze the activations of multilingual large language models (LLMs) and find that different translations of the same prompt are bridged in similar representations, with the strongest alignment in the middle layers. Our results highlight a fundamental security gap in modern LLMs, necessitating more robust, language-agnostic sanitization strategies for future model alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）跨语言训练数据抽取（TDE）风险：构造多领域PII数据集并将攻击上下文翻译为意、西、法、德四种语言，发现英文提示的攻击可跨语言迁移，泄露比例随模型多语言能力提升，且不同译文在中间层激活表示上高度对齐。
AI.motivation: PII保护在大语言模型中的鲁棒性至关重要，但跨语言数据抽取风险尚未被充分探索。现有研究多聚焦英语场景，忽视了模型在多语言能力增强过程中可能出现的跨语言泄露通道。
AI.method: 构建包含社交媒体账号、邮箱地址和电话号码的多领域PII数据集；将攻击上下文翻译成意大利语、西班牙语、法语和德语；对以英语为中心和多语言的模型实施TDE攻击，并对翻译样本进行网络存在性核查；分析多语言LLM的激活表示，考察同一提示不同译文之间的表征对齐情况。
AI.result: TDE攻击对两类模型均可从英语迁移到其他语言：即使预训练数据中仅包含原始英文提示，针对翻译提示的攻击依然成功。网络存在性核查确认这些翻译未公开于网络。其他语言中恢复的英语泄露比例随模型多语言能力增强而上升；当原始措辞被丢失时，泄露比例急剧下降，即便语言未改变。激活分析显示不同译文在相似表征中被桥接，中间层对齐最强。
AI.conclusion: 现代LLM存在根本性安全缺口：原生多语言预训练促成潜在跨语言桥接，简化了PII检索，使语言成为可绕过的防护层。未来模型对齐需要更鲁棒、语言无关的数据净化与防护策略。

title: Anatomy-preserving unpaired cone-beam CT refinement for image-guided radiotherapy using pseudo-label guided diffusion
summary: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used in image-guided radiotherapy, but scatter, beam hardening, noise, truncation, and other artifacts limit image quality and CT number accuracy. Paired CBCT and CT data are difficult to obtain clinically because of motion, anatomical changes, and acquisition mismatch. We present RefineCBCT, an unpaired CBCT refinement framework that uses pseudo-label guidance and short-step diffusion to reduce artifacts while preserving patient-specific anatomy. RefineCBCT was trained and evaluated on unpaired CBCT and planning CT data from public LUNG TCIA and PELVIC TCIA datasets and compared with representative GAN and diffusion based methods. On LUNG TCIA, it achieved the best results across all metrics, with MAE 19.411, RMSE 62.758, PSNR 30.845 dB, and SSIM 0.931. On PELVIC TCIA, it achieved the best MAE, PSNR, and SSIM, with values of 14.905, 36.671 dB, and 0.876. The refined images showed fewer streaking and shading artifacts, clearer anatomical boundaries, and improved soft tissue uniformity, with line profile and ROI analyses showing closer agreement with planning CT. These results suggest that RefineCBCT provides efficient and effective CBCT refinement under clinically realistic unpaired training conditions and may support more reliable CBCT use in image-guided radiotherapy workflows. Code is publicly available on GitHub, and the evaluated datasets are available from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

AI.tldr: RefineCBCT：一种基于伪标签引导与短步扩散的非配对CBCT精修框架，在公开肺部和盆腔数据集上取得优于代表性GAN与扩散方法的指标。
AI.motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导放疗，但散射、射束硬化、噪声、截断等伪影限制图像质量与CT值准确性；临床上难以获取配对的CBCT与CT数据（受运动、解剖变化、采集不匹配影响），因此需要非配对条件下的CBCT精修方法。
AI.method: 提出RefineCBCT非配对精修框架，采用伪标签引导与短步扩散（short-step diffusion）策略，在减少伪影的同时保留患者特异性解剖结构；使用公开LUNG TCIA与PELVIC TCIA数据集的非配对CBCT与计划CT数据进行训练与评估，并与代表性GAN和扩散方法对比。
AI.result: LUNG TCIA上所有指标最优：MAE 19.411、RMSE 62.758、PSNR 30.845 dB、SSIM 0.931；PELVIC TCIA上MAE、PSNR、SSIM最优，分别为14.905、36.671 dB、0.876。精修图像条状与阴影伪影减少、解剖边界更清晰、软组织均匀性提升，线剖面与ROI分析与计划CT更一致。
AI.conclusion: RefineCBCT在临床现实的非配对训练条件下实现了高效有效的CBCT精修，有望支持图像引导放疗流程中更可靠的CBCT应用；代码已在GitHub公开，评估数据集可从The Cancer Imaging Archive获取。

title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
summary: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. We instantiate this paradigm with Trace2Env, a learning-free framework for settings where the original system is unavailable but historical interaction traces remain accessible. Trace2Env reconstructs these traces into a reusable environment worldbook containing environment schemas, grounded evidence, and induced behavioral knowledge. At runtime, the world model agent actively consults the worldbook together with persistent episodic state to infer each action's observation and lasting state effects. Across nine environments, Trace2Env improves both next-observation fidelity and long-horizon interaction consistency over conventional prompt-based LWMs. In multi-turn interaction, task agent actions generated against Trace2Env remain valid more often when replayed in the real environment, indicating that its simulated dynamics better preserve the consequences of earlier actions across successive turns. These results establish agentic language world modeling as an alternative direction for building realistic environment replicas without reconstructing the original executable system.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能体化语言世界建模"范式与Trace2Env框架，无需重建原系统，仅凭历史交互轨迹即可构建可复用、有状态的环境模拟器。
AI.motivation: 为LLM智能体提供逼真环境副本对训练与评估很有价值，但原始系统往往无法访问或难以复现，因此需要一种不依赖重建可执行环境的替代方案。
AI.method: Trace2Env为免训练框架：将历史交互轨迹重构为可复用的环境worldbook，包含环境模式、有据证据与归纳的行为知识；运行时世界模型智能体结合worldbook与持久化情节状态，推断每个动作的观测结果及持续性状态影响。
AI.result: 在九个环境中，Trace2Env相比传统基于提示的语言世界模型，在下一观测保真度与长时程交互一致性上均有提升；多轮交互中，针对Trace2Env产生的任务智能体动作在真实环境中回放时有效性更高，说明其模拟动态能更好地跨轮次保留先前动作的后果。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了智能体化语言世界建模作为构建逼真环境副本的替代方向，无需重建原始可执行系统。

title: Benchmarking CLIP for Zero-Shot Face and Periocular Gender Estimation
comment: Accepted for publication at 25th International Conference of the Biometrics Special Interest Group, BIOSIG 2026
summary: We investigate CLIP for zero-shot gender estimation from full-face and periocular images. Three CLIP backbones are evaluated on 11,299 frontal images from Adience using image-text similarity with male/female prompts, achieving 95.54% full-face accuracy without task-specific training. For periocular, zero-shot predictions are strongly biased towards males, primarily due to a misaligned decision boundary. Threshold alignment substantially reduces this bias, reaching 85.29% accuracy. Linear SVMs trained on CLIP features provide only marginal gains, with a best periocular accuracy of 86.17%, approximately 2.8% above previous Adience results in the literature. Nevertheless, the gap with full-face performance confirms the greater difficulty of periocular gender estimation

AI.tldr: 研究评估了CLIP在整脸与眼周图像上的零样本性别估计性能，整脸达95.54%，眼周经阈值对齐后达85.29%，线性SVM最佳眼周结果为86.17%。
AI.motivation: 探究CLIP能否在无需任务特定训练的情况下用于性别估计，并比较整脸与眼周（periocular）图像的难度差异，尤其关注零样本眼周预测存在性别偏置的问题。
AI.method: 在Adience的11,299张正面图像上评估三种CLIP骨干网络，采用图像-文本相似度与male/female提示进行分类；针对眼周零样本预测的男性偏置，进行阈值对齐；并训练基于CLIP特征的线性SVM作为对比。
AI.result: 整脸零样本准确率达95.54%；眼周零样本存在强烈男性偏置，主要源于决策边界不对齐，阈值对齐后准确率达85.29%；线性SVM仅带来边际提升，最佳眼周准确率为86.17%，较文献中先前Adience结果高约2.8%。
AI.conclusion: CLIP零样本即可实现高精度整脸性别估计；眼周估计难度更大，其性能与整脸仍存在明显差距，阈值对齐可有效缓解偏置。

title: AnchorGen: Anchored Optimization for Customizable Generative 3D Design
summary: Engineering design often starts from a 2D sketch that fixes style and proportions, yet the subsequent 3D shape optimization relies on learned generative priors to keep the geometry valid. However, these priors are agnostic to the sketch: while they admit a valid design by correcting a drifted proposal back to its training distribution, they often correct it towards the high-density region, ignoring the specified design. We introduce \emph{AnchorGen}, a rectified-flow framework trained unconditionally on the concatenated shape and sketch latents of paired data. The learned manifold represents the joint distribution of shape-sketch pairs, so constraining the sketch component restricts the iterate to the sub-manifold of shapes consistent with a target style. Since training employs no conditioning signal, the constraint is imposed at inference: gradient descent optimizes the shape latent to minimize a differentiable drag surrogate, while constraining the sketch latent to remain close to the target sketch via a token-wise cosine penalty. A single model thereby supports design-preserving optimization, dimensionally explicit design edits, and sketch-only synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出AnchorGen，一种在形状-草图联合潜空间上无条件下训练的rectified-flow框架，通过在推理时约束草图分量，实现对目标风格的形状优化与编辑。
AI.motivation: 工程设计常从确定风格与比例的2D草图出发，但后续3D形状优化依赖学习到的生成先验来保证几何有效性。这些先验对草图无感知：虽能将漂移的提案纠正回训练分布，却往往朝高密度区域纠正，从而忽略指定的设计意图。
AI.method: 在配对数据的拼接形状-草图潜变量上进行无条件下训练rectified-flow，使学习到的流形表示形状-草图对的联合分布；由此约束草图分量即可将迭代限制在与目标风格一致的形状子流形上。训练时不使用任何条件信号，约束在推理阶段施加：用梯度下降优化形状潜变量以最小化可微的阻力代理目标，同时通过token级余弦惩罚约束草图潜变量逼近目标草图。
AI.result: 单一模型同时支持三类任务：保持设计意图的优化、维度显式的设计编辑，以及仅基于草图的合成。
AI.conclusion: 将条件约束从训练阶段移至推理阶段，并利用形状-草图联合分布的子流形结构，可在不训练条件模型的前提下实现风格一致的生成式3D优化与编辑。

title: On Impact of Loss Function on the Performance of Neural Networks in Melanoma Diagnosis
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Melanoma is the deadliest type of skin cancer, whose early diagnosis is crucial for patients' survival. Image classification using deep learning models has shown promising results for melanoma diagnosis. However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 研究不同损失函数对深度神经网络在SIIM-ISIC黑色素瘤分类任务中的性能与不确定性校准的影响，发现focal loss在AUC与ECE之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤是最致命的皮肤癌，早期诊断对患者生存至关重要。深度学习图像分类已展现潜力，但SIIM-ISIC等数据集存在类别不平衡问题，严重影响模型性能，而损失函数修改是应对该挑战的方法之一。
AI.method: 分别采用focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax交叉熵损失（CE）以及加权softmax CE损失训练深度神经网络，并报告多种性能与不确定性校准评价指标。
AI.result: 在AUC（性能）与期望校准误差ECE（不确定性校准）等指标上对比三种损失函数的表现。
AI.conclusion: focal loss可同时在AUC性能与ECE不确定性校准两方面取得良好组合效果。

title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据增强对医学图像分类（黑色素瘤诊断）中模型校准与预测不确定性的影响。
AI.motivation: 在黑色素瘤诊断中，准确的预测不确定性量化对患者护理意义重大；数据增强虽已被证明能提升不平衡数据集上的模型性能，但其对校准（尤其是黑色素瘤分类）的影响尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 在 SIIM-ISIC 2020 黑色素瘤分类数据集上，于两种条件（使用与不使用数据增强）下训练神经网络，并比较 AUC 与期望校准误差（ECE）的差异。
AI.result: 不同数据增强方法在使用后均带来了不确定性校准的改善。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强可作为改善不平衡医学图像分类任务中模型校准的有效手段。

title: Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts
comment: Accepted for publication in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability but remain vulnerable to target-domain shifts at inference time. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical remedy, yet most existing VLM-TTA methods follow a prediction-side adaptation paradigm. They use test samples to adjust logits, prototypes, caches, priors, or feature statistics, often incurring additional computational overhead. In this paper, we take a different perspective and reframe VLM-TTA as candidate verification rather than prediction adjustment. We propose Test-Time Correction (TTC), a hypothesis-based correction framework guided by a simple principle: hypothesize, reconstruct, correct. Given a test feature and its top-k candidate labels, TTC treats each candidate label as a hypothesis, reconstructs the feature within the corresponding latent subspace stored in a memory bank, and measures the resulting divergence shift. This shift quantifies how much the candidate subspace and its relations to other candidates change after the hypothetical insertion of the test feature. A correct candidate hypothesis induces only a small shift, whereas an incorrect one perturbs the subspace more strongly. TTC therefore corrects the prediction by selecting the candidate with the minimum aggregated divergence shift. This training-free candidate-verification mechanism avoids iterative optimization and provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across five TTA settings and 15 benchmark datasets, including zero-shot classification, domain generalization, few-shot classification, base-to-novel generalization, and cross-dataset evaluation, TTC consistently improves accuracy over state-of-the-art VLM-TTA methods while achieving up to 2x speedup, over 3x lower CPU memory usage, and up to 1.4x lower GPU memory usage than the lowest-memory training-free baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Test-Time Correction (TTC)，将 VLM 测试时自适应（TTA）重新表述为候选验证问题，通过“假设-重构-修正”的无训练框架，在 15 个数据集和 5 种 TTA 设置下持续提升精度，同时实现最高 2 倍加速和显著降低的内存占用。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 测试时自适应方法多采用预测侧调整范式，即利用测试样本调整 logits、原型、缓存、先验或特征统计量，往往带来额外计算开销。作者希望跳出这一范式，寻找一种无需迭代优化、兼顾精度与效率的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 Test-Time Correction (TTC)，一种基于假设的修正框架，遵循“假设、重构、修正”原则。给定测试特征及其 top-k 候选标签，将每个候选标签视为假设，在记忆库中对应潜在子空间内重构特征，并度量由此产生的散度偏移，该偏移量化候选子空间及其与其他候选关系在假设性插入测试特征后的变化程度。正确候选引起的偏移小，错误候选扰动更强。TTC 选择聚合散度偏移最小的候选来修正预测。该机制无需训练，避免迭代优化。
AI.result: 在 5 种 TTA 设置和 15 个基准数据集（包括零样本分类、域泛化、少样本分类、base-to-novel 泛化、跨数据集评估）上，TTC 一致优于最先进的 VLM-TTA 方法，同时实现最高 2 倍加速、超过 3 倍更低的 CPU 内存占用，以及相比最低内存的无训练基线最高 1.4 倍更低的 GPU 内存占用。
AI.conclusion: TTC 通过将 VLM-TTA 重构为候选验证而非预测调整，提供了一种无训练、精度-效率权衡良好的解决方案，在多种 TTA 设置下验证了其有效性和效率优势。

title: Graph-Based Recognition of Simulated Train-Driver States From Facial and Upper-Body Keypoints
summary: Driver fatigue poses a significant challenge to railway safety, with traditional systems like the dead-man switch offering limited and basic alertness checks. This study presents a vision-based monitoring system that relies solely on a single front-facing RGB camera and a graph neural network to classify simulated train-driver states into alert, not-alert, and an emergency class comprising acted emergency-like behaviours. To optimize input representations for the model, an ablation study was performed, comparing three feature configurations: skeletal-only, facial-only, and a combination of both. Experimental results show that combining facial and skeletal features yields the highest accuracy (81%) for the three-class model under the light condition, outperforming models that use only facial or skeletal features. Furthermore, the combination of facial and skeletal features achieves 99% accuracy in the alert/not alert classification in light condition. Additionally, we introduced a controlled RGB video dataset containing alert, not alert, and acted emergency-like behaviours recorded under three illumination conditions. These contributions represent a step toward passive and non-contact train-driver state recognition based on facial and upper-body dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种仅依赖单个前向RGB相机与图神经网络的视觉疲劳监测系统，将模拟列车驾驶员状态分为清醒、非清醒与紧急三类，并通过消融实验证明面部与骨骼特征融合效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 传统列车安全监测手段（如司机制动开关/dead-man switch）对警觉性的检查有限且基础，因此需要一种被动、非接触的驾驶员状态识别方案。
AI.method: 采用单个前向RGB相机采集数据，使用图神经网络进行状态分类；通过消融实验比较三种输入特征配置：仅骨骼、仅面部、面部与骨骼结合；并构建包含三种光照条件下清醒、非清醒及模拟紧急行为的受控RGB视频数据集。
AI.result: 在光照条件下，面部与骨骼特征融合的三分类模型准确率最高（81%），优于仅面部或仅骨骼模型；该融合特征在清醒/非清醒二分类任务中达到99%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 基于面部与上半身动态特征的被动、非接触式列车驾驶员状态识别具有可行性，为铁路安全监测提供了新思路。

title: Introducing Code-Switched Contexts to Cognitively-Inspired Bilingual Model Training
summary: During language acquisition, bilingual children are regularly exposed to code-switched input and use it as a cognitive scaffold to accelerate vocabulary growth and cross-linguistic syntactic mapping. In contrast, computational bilingual models are conventionally pretrained on interleaved monolingual corpora. While introducing synthetic code-switching during pretraining has become a promising strategy to enhance cross-lingual alignment and downstream performance, the structural and developmental parameters governing the success remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of training with synthetic code-switched data across two typologically distinct language pairs by controlling two key variables: the structural location of code-switches and the dynamic switching rate across training stages. Our results show that training with code-switched data improves cross-lingual alignment for typologically close languages.

AI.tldr: 本文探究合成语码转换数据在双语模型预训练中的作用，通过控制转换位置与动态转换率两个变量，发现在类型学相近语言对中能提升跨语言对齐。
AI.motivation: 双语儿童通过语码转换输入加速词汇增长与跨语言句法映射，而计算双语模型通常仅用交错单语语料预训练。虽已有研究引入合成语码转换以增强跨语言对齐，但决定其成效的结构与发展参数尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在两个类型学上存在差异的语言对上开展实验，控制两个关键变量：语码转换的结构位置，以及训练各阶段的动态转换率。
AI.result: 使用语码转换数据训练可提升类型学相近语言对之间的跨语言对齐。
AI.conclusion: 合成语码转换预训练的收益受语言类型学相似度制约；转换位置与转换率是关键调节变量，需针对语言对特性进行设计。

title: Bayesian Optimization in Sequence-to-Architecture Latent Space for Zero-Shot NAS
summary: Zero-shot Neural Architecture Search removes the prohibitive cost of traditional NAS, but its search process is typically based on the evolutionary algorithm (EA); lacking an explicit model of the objective, it often resorts to a near-random search through mutation. Bayesian Optimization offers a principled alternative by modeling the objective and aggregating information across iterations, but scales poorly to the high-dimensional, discrete, graph-structured spaces of modern NAS, restricting its use to only small networks. In this paper, we bring Bayesian Optimization to zero-shot NAS for large-scale architectures by learning a latent space via a Variational Autoencoder trained to reconstruct a novel prefix encoding of architectures and propose a proxy scalarization that combines several zero-shot proxies into a single Bayesian Optimization objective. After only 10,000 iterations of the proposed search algorithm (8 hours on a single GPU), our method found a network architecture which under the given model parameter count constraints achieves state-of-the-art results on three separate tasks -- image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将贝叶斯优化引入零样本神经架构搜索（zero-shot NAS），通过VAE学习潜空间并设计代理标量化，在极低搜索成本下找到在三项任务上达到SOTA的架构。
AI.motivation: 零样本NAS虽然免去了传统NAS高昂的训练成本，但其搜索过程通常依赖进化算法，缺乏显式的目标模型，往往退化为近似随机的变异搜索。贝叶斯优化通过建模目标并跨迭代聚合信息提供了更合理的替代方案，但在现代NAS的高维、离散、图结构搜索空间中扩展性差，通常仅适用于小型网络。
AI.method: 作者将贝叶斯优化扩展到大规模架构的零样本NAS：1）训练一个变分自编码器（VAE）学习潜空间，其重构目标是作者提出的新型架构前缀编码（prefix encoding）；2）提出一种代理标量化（proxy scalarization），将多个零样本代理指标组合为单一的贝叶斯优化目标。
AI.result: 在所提搜索算法仅进行10,000次迭代（单张GPU上8小时）后，该方法在给定的模型参数量约束下，于图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三项独立任务上均取得了SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习适合贝叶斯优化的架构潜空间表征与多代理标量化，能够将贝叶斯优化有效应用于大规模零样本NAS，在极低的搜索开销下获得跨任务的强泛化架构。

title: MS-Exam-Gen: An Automatic Benchmark Construction Toolkit for Evaluating LLMs on Multiple Sclerosis-MRI Imaging Knowledge
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication to BHI 2026
summary: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出MS-Exam-Gen框架，用于自动构建并审计面向多发性硬化MRI文本知识的MCQ基准，产出3,058题候选题库，在12个LLM端点上区分出42.8个百分点的准确率区间。
AI.motivation: 生物医学大模型评测需要可审计、来源可溯源、针对狭窄且不断演进的亚专业知识进行评估；MS-MRI是高风险文本知识测试场景，正确推理需掌握现行诊断标准、标准化采集与报告知识、纵向监测概念、病灶形态学及疑难模仿病变识别。
AI.method: MS-Exam-Gen组合专家来源索引、考试导向主题归纳、证据接地MCQ生成、自动化质量审计、同族一致性筛查和经验校准；从66个来源语料索引为4,289个检索块。
AI.result: 生成锁定3,058项候选基准，覆盖16个主题、53个子主题；在12个主流LLM端点上获得36,696条题目级预测，准确率区间89.7%至46.9%（42.8个百分点）；25.5%题目被至少4个端点答错；审计显示刷新构建减少答案线索，但选项顺序测试表明绝对MCQ分数仍具位置敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 生成标签仅为元数据而非经效度验证的心理测量类别；因尚缺专家裁定与完整选项顺序平衡，MS-Exam-Gen并非临床认证考试，应视为自动过滤、来源接地的候选基准与可复现审计流程，用于题目级和主题级LLM评测。

title: Anosognosia in LLMs: Probing Self-Awareness of Quantized Computational Substrate
summary: Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate? Inspired by anosognosia, a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization. We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue. Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints. Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output. A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels. Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations. Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该研究借鉴神经病学中的"病感失认症"概念，探究LLM能否识别自身计算基底因量化而产生的退化。结果表明模型无法自我报告量化状态，生成文本几乎不携带量化痕迹，但内部表征含有方法特异性的量化指纹，且基于内部表征的探针在泛化到未见量化方法时失败。
AI.motivation: 受病感失认症（患者无法识别自身能力受损）启发，作者希望探究LLM是否具备识别自身计算基底退化（由量化引起）的能力，并检验外部自我观察与内部表征两条路径中哪条更有助于实现这种自我意识。
AI.method: 1) 测试现有模型能否自我报告其量化状态，包括提供自身生成文本作为外部线索；2) 使用线性探针（linear probing）分析生成文本与内部表征中量化痕迹的差异；3) 通过训练让模型学习识别严重退化输出（如4-bit模型）；4) 跨量化级别联合训练共享LoRA以读出内部指纹，并测试其在未见量化方法上的泛化能力。
AI.result: 模型无法自我报告量化状态，即使提供自身生成文本作为外部线索；生成文本几乎不携带量化痕迹，而内部表征包含清晰且方法特异性的指纹；经训练模型可通过对比识别严重退化输出（如4-bit），但无法从单一输出中识别；共享LoRA能读出内部指纹，但在未见量化方法上失败，仅是将方法特异性指纹映射到标签。
AI.conclusion: 外部自我观察虽能在某些人类病感失认症案例中恢复意识，但在LLM中更可行的路径可能在于其内部表征。研究揭示了LLM自我监控在泛化性方面的根本局限。

title: What Does It Cost to Simulate a Quantum Sentence Classifier? An Energy and Compute Perspective on Near-Term QNLP
summary: Near-term quantum natural language processing (QNLP) experiments often run on classical simulators, so simulator cost is part of the field's practical compute burden, yet accuracy tables do not show it. We measure that cost for a variational quantum classifier (VQC) on binary SST-2 sentiment classification, using PennyLane's state-vector simulator over a controlled grid of 27 configurations: three balanced training-set sizes (N = 200, 500, 1000), three qubit counts (4, 6, 8), and three circuit depths. Each VQC is compared with logistic regression on the same PCA-reduced input; full TF-IDF logistic regression gives an uncompressed reference. The VQC beats its matched baseline in 6 of 27 single-seed comparisons. After reruns at two further seeds, only 1 of these 6 keeps a positive mean advantage larger than its paired seed-to-seed variability, and paired tests on the fixed validation set do not establish it. VQC training is 886-21,127 times slower in measured wall-clock time than the matched classical fit (median 3,158 times); going from 4 to 8 qubits roughly doubles simulator time, and within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count. CodeCarbon energy and CO2 estimates are secondary: they imply an almost constant power of about 41 W, so they add little beyond runtime, and we do not build an energy ratio from them. The study is narrow (one dataset, representation, ansatz, simulator, and CPU environment) and is a reproducible feasibility measurement, not a general verdict on QNLP.

AI.tldr: 在SST-2二分类上以PennyLane态矢量模拟器系统测量VQC的模拟器算力开销：27种配置下VQC仅在6/27单种子比较中优于匹配的逻辑回归基线，多种子复跑后仅1例优势超过种子间波动且配对检验不显著；VQC训练墙钟时间比经典拟合慢886–21,127倍（中位3,158倍），4→8量子比特约使模拟时间翻倍，逐步成本近似为参数量的线性函数；CodeCarbon能耗估计功率近乎恒定（约41 W），信息量有限。
AI.motivation: 近期QNLP实验多在经典模拟器上运行，模拟器成本构成该领域的实际算力负担，但精度表格并不反映这一成本。作者旨在量化VQC在经典模拟器上的真实计算开销与相对经典基线的性能，并提供可复现的可行性测量，而非对QNLP作一般性论断。
AI.method: 在SST-2二分类上使用PennyLane态矢量模拟器训练变分量子分类器（VQC）。受控网格共27种配置：3种平衡训练集规模（N=200、500、1000）×3种量子比特数（4、6、8）×3种电路深度。VQC与在相同PCA降维输入上的逻辑回归对照；另以完整TF-IDF逻辑回归作为未压缩参考。测量墙钟训练时间，并在额外两个随机种子下复跑，采用配对种子间波动与固定验证集上的配对检验。同时用CodeCarbon估计能耗与CO2。
AI.result: VQC在27个单种子比较中仅6个优于其匹配基线；在两个额外种子复跑后，6个中仅1个保持大于配对种子间波动的正平均优势，且固定验证集上的配对检验未能确立该优势。VQC训练墙钟时间比匹配的经典拟合慢886–21,127倍（中位3,158倍）；量子比特数从4增至8约使模拟时间翻倍，测试范围内逐步成本可较好地用参数量线性函数近似。CodeCarbon能耗与CO2估计为次要结果：隐含功率近乎恒定（约41 W），除运行时间外信息增量很小，作者未据此构造能耗比。
AI.conclusion: 该研究范围有限（单一数据集、表示、拟设、模拟器与CPU环境），是一项可复现的可行性测量，而非对QNLP的一般性结论。其贡献在于把模拟器算力成本作为QNLP实际负担予以显式量化，并表明在当前设置下VQC相对匹配经典基线缺乏稳定优势。

title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
summary: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.

AI.tldr: 在受控源失败检索环境中，智能体对失败工具结果的判断与其停止行为存在系统性分离：判断准确率97-100%，但极少据此停止；只有通过harness强制"连续5次判定无用后必须作答"的整合步骤，停止才真正跟随证据，并提升各模型在失败源上的成功率。
AI.motivation: 智能体在工具持续返回无效结果时应停止依赖该工具，但此前工作未区分"如何判断结果"与"据此采取何种行动"。本文旨在解耦判断与行为，探究智能体停止行为究竟由证据驱动还是由时钟、预算、提示线索等外部因素驱动。
AI.method: 构建受控源失败的检索环境，对同一时间步上"较长/较短无用结果序列后停止"进行对比（该对比对时钟或截止时间驱动的停止为零）。测试七个智能体，记录其判断，并操纵提示线索（记忆作答许可、推理模式、显式预算、停止规则、调用成本）。设置强制整合步骤：智能体连续五次判定结果无用后必须作答，并在300个新问题上进行预注册复制。
AI.result: 七个智能体对失败源结果判定为无用的比率为97-100%，但多数很少依此停止。提示线索只改变何时停止而非停止所依据的内容；记忆作答许可与推理模式导致无视证据的早停，显式预算使7-8B模型的停止推迟至截止点，提示中的停止规则或调用成本最多被部分遵循。强制整合步骤提升所有模型在失败源上的成功率，预算翻倍时停止点保持不变，且当智能体已表述判断时无需额外判断调用。预注册复制在300个新问题上证实了该分离及规则效果。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的停止行为与结果判断相分离，提示层面干预难以使其依证据停止；唯有在harness层面执行强制整合步骤，才能让停止真正跟随证据并稳定提升失败源上的表现。

title: Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations
summary: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"被动探针"（固定、未训练、与属性无关的投影）观察训练过程中表征的变化，并在$S^2$预测任务中发现额外的loss-invariant迹坐标，进而构建通用框架。
AI.motivation: 神经网络学到的特征表征中常包含超出最终任务输出直接所需的结构，作者希望研究这部分结构。
AI.method: 使用被动探针：对训练中不断演化的表征施加固定的、未训练的、与属性无关的投影；通过对$S^2$预测任务中等价的向量参数化与Hermitian参数化的分析，引出随机固定投影作为学习特征的观察者。
AI.result: 被动探针的集成可直接反映目标对齐等任务相关信息；最终难度的可及性在不同任务中演化不同——在表面法线估计和图像修复等回归任务中随训练上升，而在图像分类中基本保持初始水平；与学习到的线性探针相比，可恢复性与被动可及性可呈现不同演化。
AI.conclusion: 被动探针能够分别刻画表征几何的变化与最终任务难度的可及性。

title: EORestore-Agent: Fidelity-Guided Agentic Restoration of Remote Sensing Images with Composite Degradations
summary: Remote sensing images often carry composite degradations, in which haze, cloud, noise, blur, low light, and low resolution coexist. Restoring them requires deciding which tool to apply, in what order, and when to stop, yet no clean reference is available at inference time to verify these decisions. All-in-one models trained on single degradations converge to a narrow PSNR band as degradations accumulate. To formulate real-world remote sensing restoration as a traceable trajectory, we present EORestore-Agent, which replaces this unmeasurable objective with reference-free, verifiable per-step decisions. A fine-tuned vision-language model reports all residual degradation types, whose tool pools are scored together, so the restoration order emerges from step-wise selection. A relative quality scorer, trained with full-reference supervision on synthetic degradation chains, predicts the changes in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS from the current image to each candidate. A step is accepted only when no predicted change is negative and the predicted PSNR gain is positive. Otherwise, the agent keeps the current image. On a synthetic Landsat-8 benchmark with six degradation types, EORestore-Agent improves PSNR by 2.3 to 3.2 dB over the strongest retrained all-in-one baseline on composites of two to six degradations, whereas zero-shot natural-image agents fall below the degraded input in PSNR in 17 of 18 settings. Replacing the learned scorer with no-reference quality differences costs 1.1 to 4.6 dB. The remaining harmful steps are small and cluster near the acceptance threshold. Sentinel-2 examples illustrate transfer to real atmospheric degradation without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 EORestore-Agent，将遥感图像复合退化恢复建模为可追溯的逐步决策轨迹：用微调视觉语言模型识别残余退化类型并对工具池联合打分，用全参考监督训练的相对质量评分器预测各候选操作带来的 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 变化，仅当无负面变化且 PSNR 增益为正时接受该步。在合成 Landsat-8 六类退化基准上，复合 2–6 种退化时较最强重训 all-in-one 基线提升 PSNR 2.3–3.2 dB。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像常伴随雾、云、噪声、模糊、低照度、低分辨率并存的复合退化，恢复时需决定用哪种工具、按什么顺序、何时停止，但推理阶段没有干净参考图来验证这些决策。在单一退化上训练的 all-in-one 模型随退化叠加会收敛到狭窄的 PSNR 区间，说明缺少可度量、可验证的目标。
AI.method: 将真实遥感恢复表述为可追溯轨迹，用无参考但可验证的逐步决策替代不可测目标。微调视觉语言模型报告所有残余退化类型，其对应工具池被联合打分，恢复顺序由逐步选择自然涌现。相对质量评分器在合成退化链上以全参考监督训练，预测当前图像到各候选结果的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 变化量。接受准则为：所有预测变化均非负且预测 PSNR 增益为正，否则保留当前图像。
AI.result: 在含六种退化类型的合成 Landsat-8 基准上，对 2–6 种退化复合，EORestore-Agent 相对最强重训 all-in-one 基线提升 PSNR 2.3–3.2 dB；零样本自然图像智能体在 18 个设置中有 17 个 PSNR 低于退化输入。用无参考质量差异替换学习型评分器会损失 1.1–4.6 dB。残余的有害步骤幅度较小且聚集在接受阈值附近。Sentinel-2 示例显示无需重训即可迁移到真实大气退化。
AI.conclusion: 以无参考、可验证的逐步决策构建恢复轨迹，可有效应对遥感复合退化，并在合成基准上显著优于 all-in-one 基线，同时具备向真实大气退化场景迁移的潜力；评分器的全参考相对预测与严格接受准则是性能关键。

title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris
summary: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.

AI.tldr: 本研究用 GRPO 对 4 个 Gemma 4 检查点（2.3B–31B）进行双边多议题谈判训练，发现强化学习增益随模型规模增大而上升，且学习率调优（提高 3 倍）在几乎所有规模上带来更大提升；作者强调在判断小模型能否学会谈判前应先调好学习率，并用多模型家族的买家做评测。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正逐步承担完整客户体验，未来可能在买卖双方代表企业/客户进行交易；小模型在规模化时更具成本优势，但尚不清楚强化学习能否将其训练成合格的"卖方"。因此作者探究：小模型能否通过 RL 学会谈判，以及性能如何随规模与超参数变化。
AI.method: 在程序化效用奖励下，使用 GRPO 训练 4 个 Gemma 4 检查点（有效参数 2.3B 至 31B），任务为双边多议题谈判；所有实验臂在相同的 1,152 场谈判上评测，且对手为训练中未见过的两个前沿买家。共享学习率设为 10⁻⁶，另设 3 倍学习率的对照（训练步数相同或更少），并额外测试 2.3B 在 10 倍学习率下的表现。每个规模仅训练一次，最小两个检查点采用不同架构，因此不拟合缩放律。
AI.result: 在共享学习率 10⁻⁶ 下，RL 相对基座的增益随规模由 2.3B 的 +0.001 升至 31B 的 +0.078。学习率提高 3 倍后，在每个规模上均优于共享学习率：2.3B 提升 +0.032，4.5B 提升 +0.081。探索性比较中，以卖方身份运行的 12B（3 倍学习率）得分高于两个前沿模型，但其未训练基座本身已与二者相当；4.5B（3 倍学习率）与两者无可检测差异，且可单张 48GB GPU 部署。2.3B 在 10 倍学习率下池化得分提高，但增益集中在与训练池同一模型家族的评测买家上。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：在断言小模型无法学会谈判之前，应优先调优学习率；同时评测应覆盖来自多个模型家族的买家，以避免增益被同家族买家所混淆。

title: MoCAR: Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression for Continuous Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Autoregressive generation is natural for language, where predicted tokens can be directly reused as the next prediction state, but trajectory forecasting lacks such a clean token: motion is continuous, multimodal, and expressed in local coordinate frames that evolve with the predicted trajectory. We present MoCAR (Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression), a decoder-only framework that casts trajectory forecasting as next-code prediction in a coordinate-aware continuous latent space. MoCAR learns a continuous motion-code space from endpoint-normalized trajectory segments, where each code jointly captures local trajectory geometry and the reference-frame transition induced by that segment. Historical motion codes are used as a teacher-forced prefix, future codes are generated autoregressively under temporal, map, agent, and mode interactions, and predicted codes persist in latent memory while decoded endpoints update the local scene context. This enables rollout without trajectory-space re-tokenization, trajectory queries, goal candidates, or proposal-and-refinement pipelines. On Argoverse (AV) benchmarks, MoCAR achieves top-tier performance with a simple single-stage architecture, transfers strongly from AV2 to AV1 in zero-shot evaluation, and improves on turn-heavy scenarios. Ablations confirm that the learned continuous motion-code space, latent alignment, weak KL regularization, and joint tokenizer-predictor optimization are essential for stable latent autoregression.

AI.tldr: MoCAR是一个仅含解码器的自回归框架，将轨迹预测建模为坐标感知连续隐空间中的“下一运动码”预测。
AI.motivation: 语言建模中预测token可直接复用为下一状态，但轨迹预测缺乏这种干净的token：运动连续、多模态，且表达在随预测轨迹演化的局部坐标系中，难以直接套用自回归范式。
AI.method: 从端点归一化的轨迹片段学习连续运动码空间，每个码同时编码局部轨迹几何与该片段诱导的参考系转移；历史运动码作为teacher-forced前缀，未来码在时间、地图、智能体和模态交互下自回归生成；预测码保留于隐记忆，解码端点更新局部场景上下文。整个流程无需轨迹空间重token化、轨迹query、目标候选或proposal-refinement。
AI.result: 在Argoverse（AV）基准上以简单单阶段架构取得顶级性能，AV2到AV1零样本迁移表现强，转弯密集场景提升明显；消融显示连续运动码空间、隐对齐、弱KL正则与tokenizer-预测器联合优化对稳定隐自回归至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 将轨迹预测转化为坐标感知连续隐空间中的下一码预测，可去除多阶段启发式设计并实现稳定自回归rollout，同时保持强精度与跨数据集迁移能力。

title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
summary: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.

AI.tldr: 研究预生成成功探针在跨语言场景下的可靠性，从区分度、校准度和路由实用性三方面评估，发现英语训练探针跨语言迁移后校准变差，而多语言池化训练可同时改善区分度与校准度，并在成本感知路由中取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 预生成成功探针可在解码前从语言模型隐藏激活中估计回答正确性，用于成本感知路由，但已有工作主要在英语输入上验证其效用，跨语言可靠性尚不清楚。多语言路由需要成功估计在不同语言和模型间保持校准且可比。
AI.method: 使用10种语言的3,000道MATH题目和8种开放权重模型配置，从三个维度评估探针：(1)区分度，即是否保持可能成功与失败的排序；(2)校准度，即概率是否匹配观测成功频率；(3)实用性，即分数在候选模型间是否足够可比以支持成本感知多语言路由。对比英语训练探针的跨语言迁移与等预算的多语言池化探针。
AI.result: 英语训练探针在跨语言迁移后仍保留有用的区分度，但校准度下降；多语言池化监督同时改善区分度和校准度，并给出更可靠的成功估计。在路由实验中，池化路由器相比始终选择平均成功率最高模型，测试成功率提高0.7%，建模成本降低13.0%。
AI.conclusion: 多语言路由要求成功估计在不同语言和模型间保持良好校准且可比；多语言池化监督是实现这一目标的有效途径。

title: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring
summary: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction. However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization. Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出频率解耦后验引导（frequency-decoupled posterior guidance），将频率激活与衰减感知的谱正则化显式分离，并引入局部轨迹正则化器稳定采样，在非盲去模糊任务上取得较强的PSNR/SSIM表现。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型为图像复原的无训练后验采样提供了强先验。频率感知方法通过跨频段逐步引入测量信息实现由粗到细重建，但现有方法未显式区分频率激活与退化引起的衰减，导致非激活频率间的衰减差异建模不足。
AI.method: 提出频率解耦后验引导：以渐进式低频到高频调度确定激活的测量频带；用由退化核导出的衰减图对非激活分量定义选择性谱先验。引入局部轨迹正则化器抑制空间上不规则的“状态到干净图像”的偏差。对固定端点能量给出KL正则化的路径空间解释；实际中通过Tweedie插入近似进行局部能量校正，构造时间相关引导。
AI.result: 在自然图像基准上，于多种具挑战性的非盲去模糊设置（包括较高测量噪声水平）下，均取得较强的PSNR与SSIM性能。
AI.conclusion: 将频率激活与衰减感知谱正则化解耦、并结合局部轨迹正则化，可有效提升扩散后验采样的去模糊复原质量；同时提供了路径空间的理论解释，验证了该引导机制在含噪非盲去模糊下的有效性。

title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeAVJEPA，首个在LeJEPA无坍缩目标下训练的音频-视觉编码器，用单一早期融合ViT处理音频、视频及联合输入，并通过模态dropout实现隐式跨模态对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有音频-视觉自监督方法依赖EMA目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等复杂机制。作者希望以更简洁的架构和更简单的目标函数实现有效的音频-视觉表征学习。
AI.method: 采用单一早期融合Vision Transformer处理音频、视频和联合音视频输入；利用模态dropout将缺失模态视为同一事件的另一视图，使跨模态对齐隐含于目标中；对齐全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入，并用SIGReg防止表征坍缩。
AI.result: 冻结评估下在AudioSet-20K达到36.0 mAP，在ESC-50达到91.3%准确率；微调后在VGGSound达到61.1%准确率；嵌入还支持零样本音视频检索。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明模态dropout是音视频对齐的关键机制；尽管架构简单，LeAVJEPA仍取得有竞争力的性能，并具备零样本检索能力。

title: A Data-Centric Review of Plant Disease Datasets: Taxonomy, Critical Analysis, Environmental Variability, and Implications for Precision Agriculture
summary: Despite rapid advances in artificial intelligence, reliable real-world plant disease detection remains a persistent challenge. Visual and deep learning approaches have shown promising results, but their deployment under field conditions remains limited. A key bottleneck is the reliance on laboratory-generated datasets that lack environmental diversity, realistic backgrounds, and balanced class distributions, resulting in poor generalization. In contrast, datasets collected directly from agricultural environments capture natural variability and better reflect challenges faced by farmers across regions. This review presents a critical analysis of visual and deep learning approaches for plant disease detection, with emphasis on plant disease datasets. It establishes a taxonomy based on acquisition setting, accessibility, plant diversity, disease composition, class structure, and imbalance severity, and examines their implications for model generalization and real-world deployment. A comparative analysis of laboratory and real-field datasets identifies critical gaps that hinder disease detection. The review further analyzes how multi-level dataset imbalance, including intra-class, inter-crop, and cross-dataset imbalance, and limited environmental variability affect model performance and robustness, an area insufficiently examined in existing surveys. Beyond image-based approaches, it highlights the importance of integrating environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, and leaf wetness with image data to improve prediction under dynamic field conditions. Finally, the review identifies key challenges, research gaps, and future directions concerning dataset construction, environmental variability, structural imbalance, standardization, and multimodal disease monitoring. It provides a foundation for developing next-generation multimodal frameworks for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 该综述批判性分析植物病害检测的视觉与深度学习方法，聚焦数据集构建问题，提出基于采集场景、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构与不平衡严重度的分类体系，并比较实验室与真实田间数据集差距，强调多层级不平衡与环境变异对泛化能力的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管人工智能与深度学习在植物病害检测上进展迅速，但其实际田间部署仍受限。核心瓶颈在于依赖实验室生成的数据集，缺乏环境多样性、真实背景和均衡类别分布，导致模型泛化差；而直接从农业环境采集的数据能反映自然变异与农民面临的真实挑战。现有综述对环境变异与多层级数据集不平衡的考察不足，因此需要系统性批判分析。
AI.method: 采用文献综述与批判性分析方法：1）建立分类体系，维度包括采集场景、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构与不平衡严重度；2）对实验室数据集与真实田间数据集进行对比分析，识别阻碍病害检测的关键差距；3）分析多层级数据集不平衡（类内、作物间、跨数据集）及有限环境变异对模型性能与鲁棒性的影响；4）探讨将温度、湿度、叶片湿度等环境参数与图像数据融合的潜力。
AI.result: 分析表明：实验室数据集与真实田间数据集之间存在显著差距，主要体现在环境多样性不足、背景不真实和类别分布失衡；多层级不平衡（类内、作物间、跨数据集）与有限环境变异会削弱模型的性能与鲁棒性；融合温度、湿度、叶片湿度等环境参数与图像数据，有助于提升动态田间条件下的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 综述指出数据集构建、环境变异、结构性不平衡、标准化及多模态病害监测等关键挑战、研究空白与未来方向，为开发面向精准农业的下一代多模态框架奠定基础。

title: Joint Class-Time Learning for Video Classification with Multi-Instance Partial-Label Learning
summary: Multi-instance partial-label learning (MIPL) addresses inexact supervision in both the instance and label spaces, which can be applied to video classification. However, bag-level labels do not explicitly supervise the correspondence between candidate classes and temporal evidence. We propose {\ours}, which couples label disambiguation with temporal evidence allocation through a joint class--time assignment. Occupancy-regularized spherical matching associates contextualized video features while learning nonuniform temporal mass and discouraging excessive concentration. During training, candidate-restricted inference recomputes the assignment within the candidate label set. A dual-marginal KL projection then constructs a structured teacher that incorporates momentum-refined class beliefs while preserving the proposal's temporal occupancy. A single plan-level KL objective aligns the full-space predictor with this teacher. Our analysis characterizes when candidate re-solving differs from masking and shows that, under the stated construction, the joint objective decomposes into class-marginal and class-conditional temporal supervision. We construct VCMIPL benchmarks from Breakfast, DoTA, and FineAction using model-generated candidate labels and evaluate the method across four feature representations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PIVOTMIPL outperforms existing MIPL algorithms in both effectiveness and efficiency.
