The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个用于端到端评估与社区标准模式（Croissant）对齐的元数据抽取基准，包含602篇论文（102篇人工验证金标注、500篇LLM生成银标注），覆盖完整Croissant模式及RAI字段，并用双层评估框架（规则评分+经人工审核选定的LLM评审）评测多类抽取系统。
AI.motivation: Croissant已成为机器可读数据集元数据的事实标准，但填充其字段仍高度依赖人工、需仔细阅读数据集配套文档，成本高且难以规模化。现有工作缺乏与社区标准模式对齐的端到端元数据抽取评测基准。
AI.method: 构建首个端到端元数据抽取基准：602篇论文（102篇人工验证金标注、500篇LLM生成银标注），覆盖Croissant完整模式的核心字段与Responsible AI（RAI）字段；评测对象涵盖前沿模型、开放权重模型及智能体式（agentic）架构；采用双层评估框架，将规则评分与经人工审核选出的LLM评审相结合。
AI.result: 单遍（single-pass）抽取一致优于所评测的四种智能体式架构：在不同骨干模型上，这些分解式变体准确率均低于单次全上下文抽取。最大差距出现在长篇RAI字段上——该类字段需综合并解读散落于论文各处的信息，而非从单一位置复制，现有系统在此场景下可靠性仍远不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了分解式智能体架构在元数据抽取中并不优于单遍全上下文抽取，且长文本RAI字段抽取仍是主要瓶颈。作者公开基准、评测代码、评审审核结果、在线演示及面向新系统开放的排行榜，以推动该方向的可复现研究与持续改进。

title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
summary: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.

AI.tldr: 提出InterMimicGen自进化运动模仿框架，通过机器人运动数据与跟踪策略的相互促进，将人-物交互演示转化为可执行的人形机器人运动资源。
AI.motivation: 采集到的人-物交互数据蕴含丰富的监督信息，但存在稀疏、异构且无法直接被机器人执行的问题，亟需一种从人类演示到机器人可执行运动资源的统一转化路径。
AI.method: 分为三步：1）整合运动捕捉的人-物交互数据集，重定向为人形机器人参考，保持全身协调与灵巧手-物关系；2）训练基于物理的通用跟踪器，在仿真中以带灵巧手的人形机器人执行参考动作；3）构建数据飞轮，每轮对交互发生位置与身体执行方式做保任务的微调，在其上微调跟踪器，仅保留仿真可完成任务的变体作为下一轮种子。
AI.result: 实验表明：跨机器人构型的保接触重定向有效；单一通用策略实现广泛跟踪；可执行动作随增强轮次持续增长；并可迁移至真实机器人。
AI.conclusion: InterMimicGen为从异构人类演示到持续扩展的人形机器人学习运动资源提供了统一路径。

title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
summary: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.

AI.tldr: 研究起始词元线索如何通过训练数据塑造基座模型的推理行为：固定线索可显著提升性能并逼近RL模型，RL会提升这些线索的概率，且可通过数据干预任意添加或移除线索效果。
AI.motivation: 探究基座模型响应起始处的词元线索（token cues）与后续推理行为之间的关联来源，尤其是训练数据在其中所起的作用，并检验RL训练与这些线索的关系。
AI.method: 在数学与代码任务上固定特定起始线索并评测基座模型表现，与RL训练对应模型比较；通过因果数据干预将一个任意词（如"chicken"）改造成有效推理线索，或消除已有线索的效果；比较不同线索诱导的隐状态表示与训练集文档类型的相关性；并以安全场景为案例研究不同线索引发的拒绝与顺从行为。
AI.result: 固定线索使基座模型性能逼近RL训练模型，如".\n\nOkay"将Olmo-3-7B在MATH-500的pass@1从42%提升到78%，"Alright,"将Qwen3-14B从72%提升到87%；RL使这些线索更可能出现，固定线索可恢复大部分性能增益；数据干预可让"chicken"成为有效线索，并使"Think duck duck goose"与"Think step by step"在引发推理上同样有效；不同线索诱导的隐状态表示与不同训练文档类型相关；在安全场景中，不同线索引发与不同训练数据类型对应的拒绝与顺从行为。
AI.conclusion: 基座模型中响应起始词元线索与推理行为之间的关联源自训练数据；RL通过提高这些线索的概率部分地获得性能提升；线索效果可通过数据干预因果地添加或移除，且与训练数据的文档类型和隐状态表示系统相关，该机制亦扩展到安全相关行为。

title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
summary: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: 提出"宽高比自适应流程图重排版"新任务：给定栅格流程图与目标比例，输出结构忠实、无幻觉、可编辑的布局。方法为Parse-Style-Layout三阶段智能体流水线，每阶段配主智能体与批评者（确定性约束检查+VLM视觉反馈），显式校验连通性，输出draw.io可编辑mxGraph XML。在100个流程图×5种比例基准上，内容保真度达68.6%，显著优于先前工作的11.2–41.4%。
AI.motivation: ML论文中的流水线图需在论文栏（双栏）、16:9幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1社媒图、9:16手机预览等多种画布间复用，同一计算图被施加不同宽高比。任何"静默断裂"的连接都会错误表达方法。现有方案各有失效模式：图生图模型拉伸块体且无法处理极端比例；文生图智能体系统产生幻觉内容；先解析后渲染的系统错误路由边。因此需将宽高比自适应流程图重排版确立为独立任务。
AI.method: 提出智能体流水线，分解为Parse（解析）、Style（风格）、Layout（布局）三个阶段。每个阶段由一个主智能体搭配一个批评者组成；批评者融合确定性约束检查与VLM视觉反馈，从而对连通性进行显式检查，避免连接被静默破坏。最终输出为draw.io可编辑的mxGraph XML。
AI.result: 在精心构建的基准上评估：100个流程图、5种宽高比，使用Gemini 3.1 Pro评测并对照人工判断验证。本方法内容保真度（Content Fidelity）达68.6%，而先前工作仅为11.2–41.4%。
AI.conclusion: 宽高比自适应流程图重排版是一类独立且具有实用价值的任务；将流水线按Parse/Style/Layout分阶段、并为每阶段引入"确定性约束+VLM反馈"的双重批评机制，可有效保证结构忠实与连通性完整、抑制幻觉，同时保持输出可编辑性，性能大幅超越现有方法。项目页面：https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

title: A theory of platonic representations in language models
summary: Representations of translated sentences are similar in the inner layers of multilingual language models -- an observation connected to the platonic representation hypothesis, yet unexplained theoretically. We provide an explanation based on the assumption that data have a hidden hierarchical structure whose abstract levels are shared across languages while surface levels are modality- or language-specific. Concretely, we generate synthetic languages from probabilistic context-free grammars sharing upper-level but not lower-level production rules. In this setting the Bayes-optimal next-token predictor is belief propagation (BP); encoding its messages in successive layers yields analytical predictions that agree well with transformers trained on the same data. The framework explains why cross-lingual similarity peaks in middle layers, coexists with language-specific structure, and strengthens with language proximity, model quality and data exposure. It distinguishes similarity (shared neighborhood geometry) from alignment (shared coordinates), showing that the latter occurs when code-switched data, i.e. mixed-language sentences, are abundant enough. It further predicts that subtracting from each layer the component linearly predictable from the preceding one increases cross-lingual similarity, which we confirm in pretrained LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上解释了多语言模型中翻译句表征在中间层相似的现象：假设数据具有跨语言共享抽象层、表层语言特异的隐层级结构，用概率上下文无关文法生成合成语言，证明贝叶斯最优下一词预测器即信念传播，其逐层消息传播可解析预测Transformer的表征相似性规律。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型内部层中翻译句表征相似，这一现象与柏拉图表征假说相关但缺乏理论解释；作者希望给出机制性说明，并区分"相似"与"对齐"两种概念。
AI.method: 假设数据具隐层级结构（抽象层跨语言共享、表层语言/模态特异）；构造共享上层但不共享下层产生式规则的概率上下文无关文法合成语言；证明该设定下贝叶斯最优下一词预测器为信念传播，将其消息映射到连续层得到解析预测，并与同数据训练的Transformer对比；进一步在预训练LLM上验证"逐层减去可由前一层线性预测的分量可提升跨语言相似度"的预测。
AI.result: 解析预测与Transformer训练结果吻合良好；框架解释了跨语言相似度在中间层达到峰值、与语言特异结构共存、并随语言接近度、模型质量和数据暴露增加而增强；区分相似（共享邻域几何）与对齐（共享坐标），指出后者需代码混杂数据足够丰富才出现；预测并验证了逐层残差去除可提升跨语言相似度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多语言模型中间层跨语言表征相似提供了可解析的理论框架，将其归于共享隐层级结构与信念传播式消息传递，并给出可检验预测，深化了对跨语言相似与对齐机制的理解。

title: CALR: Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning via Render-of-Thought Compression
summary: Visual latent reasoning compresses rendered derivations into compact intermediate states, reducing textual reasoning overhead. Existing approaches differ in how they represent these states: continuous methods avoid vocabulary constraints, whereas discrete methods improve accuracy through quantization into a finite codebook. Our analysis of representative continuous and discrete systems identifies two functional requirements: answers must rely on latent states, and those states must carry valid, problem-specific reasoning. Continuous latents influence answers despite collapsed reasoning content, whereas discrete latents retain recoverable intermediate reasoning that answer prediction largely bypasses. To address these challenges, we propose Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning (CALR), which connects latent formation with answer use through functional anchoring. With reference latents from information-balanced compression, CALR couples latent-mediated answer supervision with derivation-level semantic anchoring: the former routes answer supervision through intermediate states, while the latter grounds their decoded content in problem-specific derivations. A parallel-to-autoregressive curriculum develops sequential reasoning by conditioning subsequent latent blocks on generated prefixes. Evaluations on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks across model families show substantial accuracy gains. Under matched budgets, CALR gains 26.0 percentage points over a comparable continuous latent reasoning method. Further analyses show that its latents support answer prediction and carry problem-specific intermediate reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该文提出连续锚定潜在推理（CALR），通过功能性锚定将潜在状态的形成与答案使用相连接，兼顾答案对潜在状态的依赖与潜在状态携带问题特定推理内容，在五个数学推理基准上取得显著准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉潜在推理将渲染的推导过程压缩为紧凑中间状态以降低文本推理开销，但现有连续方法与离散方法各有缺陷：连续潜在状态虽影响答案却推理内容塌缩，离散潜在状态虽保留可恢复的中间推理但答案预测基本绕过这些状态。作者据此提出两个功能需求——答案必须依赖潜在状态，且潜在状态必须携带有效、问题特定的推理。
AI.method: 提出连续锚定潜在推理（CALR），以信息均衡压缩得到的参考潜在状态为基础，通过功能性锚定连接潜在形成与答案使用：一是潜在中介的答案监督，将答案监督经由中间状态传递；二是推导级语义锚定，把解码内容锚定到问题特定的推导。并采用并行到自回归的课程学习，通过生成的前缀条件化后续潜在块以发展序列推理能力。
AI.result: 在五种数学推理基准、多种模型家族上评估，准确率显著提升；在预算匹配条件下，相比可比的连续潜在推理方法提升26.0个百分点。进一步分析表明其潜在状态既支持答案预测，又携带问题特定的中间推理。
AI.conclusion: CALR通过功能性锚定有效解决了连续潜在推理中推理内容塌缩与答案绕过潜在状态的问题，使潜在状态同时具备答案依赖性与推理可解释性，验证了两个功能需求的必要性与有效性。

title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
summary: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.

AI.tldr: 对比式决策模型 CLM-v0.1-8B 在五个公开偏好基准和一个幻觉基准上接近随机水平，仅在置信度校准与决策稳定性两方面表现良好，但经校准的置信度无法支撑有效的级联筛选。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在检验一个开放式对比式决策模型（CLM-v0.1-8B）作为"裁判"的实际判别能力，通过预注册、真实标签的公开基准，与生成式裁判、奖励模型以及平凡基线进行严格对照，以厘清其是否具备可靠的评判能力。
AI.method: 在预注册（在见到任何测试样本前冻结）框架下，选取五个公开偏好基准和一个带真实标签的幻觉基准进行评测；将 CLM 与同参数量级的生成式裁判、奖励模型及平凡基线（如 always-first）对比，并在 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正下检验差距显著性；同时分析置信度校准（池化温度拟合）、决策顺序翻转率和长度偏好偏移；最后构建以置信度为门控的级联系统，在 0.97 保留阈值下评估升级到强裁判的样本比例。
AI.result: CLM 得分介于 0.351（四选一，随机 0.250）至 0.593（配对，随机 0.500）之间，在 RM-Bench 与 JudgeBench 上与抛硬币统计上不可区分，并在 HaluEval 上恒输出同一标签，等同于 always-first 基线 0.581。同参数量裁判表现显著更高：奖励模型 0.764–0.976，生成式裁判 0.611–0.778，且所有与 CLM 的差距经 BH 校正后显著。两项特性有效：原始置信度过度自信达 +0.401，但单一池化温度拟合将在留出校准集上的期望校准误差降至至多 0.062，且修复后的置信度在六个基准中的三个上能以高于随机的水平对自己错误排序；决策顺序翻转率为 0.0002（生成式裁判为 0.2188），长度偏好偏移为 -0.023（生成式裁判为 -0.217）。置信度门控级联在 0.97 保留阈值下将 0.923–1.000 的样本升级给强裁判。
AI.conclusion: CLM 作为裁判在困难公开基准上接近随机，明显逊于同规模奖励模型与生成式裁判；其唯一可取之处是决策顺序极稳定、长度偏好弱，并且经简单温度校准后置信度能较好反映自身错误。然而，对近乎随机裁判的校准置信度几乎无可保留的信息，导致置信度门控级联几乎把所有样本都升级给强裁判，实际节省效果有限。

title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
summary: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 ResearchTrails 数据集，从 Git 仓库提交历史中抽取人类科研探索轨迹，以刻画论文之外的中介研究决策过程，并在经验检索与轨迹训练等场景中验证其价值。
AI.motivation: AI 科研系统的核心挑战是实现"科学探索"，即通过一连串研究决策与行动系统性地探究未知现象。然而现有科学语料普遍缺失这一过程：论文主要记录最终结果，而非产生结果的研究轨迹，导致模型难以学习探索过程本身。
AI.method: 作者构建自动化、可扩展的流水线，从 Git 仓库的 commit 历史中抽取结构化的研究轨迹，将提交序列作为科研探索的代理信号，捕获方法、实验与消融研究的连续变更；随后对数据集进行特征刻画，并设计多个用例进行验证。
AI.result: 数据集刻画显示，这些轨迹包含关于中介研究决策的有意义信号，其信息超出最终论文所揭示的内容；在多个用例中均体现效用，包括在测试时检索人类研究经验作为外部技能，以及在研究轨迹上训练模型以提升对新研究决策的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，AI 系统不仅可以学习科学的最终产物，还可以学习发现过程本身，为面向科学探索的 AI 系统提供了一条可行路径。

title: Identifying Introspection From the Inside
comment: Published at COLM 2026. Project page: https://iii.baulab.info
summary: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. How can we distinguish plausible confabulations from genuine introspection? In this paper, we identify mechanistic signatures of faithful self-report in a controlled setting. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控设定下识别出忠实自我报告的机制特征：忠诚的自我报告伴随偏好表征向早期层的转移，且在归因修补中决策与自我报告任务表现出高度归因相似性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型关于自身的陈述既具有重要后果，又越来越难以仅凭行为加以验证；如何区分看似合理的虚构与真正的内省，是亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: 使用低秩适配器（LoRA），让模型依据潜在线性偏好函数为虚构角色做决策；通过权重消融、冻结层实验考察表征的结构位置变化，并使用归因修补（attribution patching）比较决策任务与自我报告任务的归因相似度。
AI.result: 在隐式决策任务上持续微调可使模型在无显式自我报告监督的情况下，涌现出对所学偏好的准确自我报告；偏好表征随训练向更早层迁移；忠实模型在决策与自我报告任务间的归因相似度显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 至少在本文受限的设定中，通过检视网络自身结构（而非报告内容本身）即可区分忠实与不忠实的自我报告模式，为识别机制性忠实提供了可行信号。

title: Responsible Institutional Analytics: Interpreting Bias with AI Support
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Universal Computer Science (J.UCS)
summary: Institutional Analytics (IA) dashboards inform decision-making in higher education, yet data limitations, constraints in analytical techniques, and missing contextual information often affect their interpretation. To support more responsible interpretation of IA, we introduce FACTRIA, a framework that organizes potential biasing factors across four areas: the analytics pipeline, institutional context, course-level characteristics, and demographics. We used the FACTRIA framework as input to a generative-AI chatbot designed to prompt users to reflect on these factors while analyzing IA. A qualitative study with stakeholders, drawing on four authentic IA cases, and a transition network analysis showed that the chatbot prompted participants to recognize how overlooked factors influenced their initial interpretation. Findings indicated that combining a structured framework with AI-based guidance can enhance context-aware, responsible interpretation of institutional data.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FACTRIA框架，将机构分析（IA）仪表盘解读中的潜在偏差因素归纳为四个领域，并将其嵌入生成式AI聊天机器人以引导用户反思，通过定性研究与转移网络分析验证其能提升情境感知的负责任解读。
AI.motivation: 机构分析仪表盘广泛用于高等教育决策，但受数据局限性、分析技术约束以及情境信息缺失的影响，其解读常出现偏差。因此需要一种支持更负责任解读IA的机制。
AI.method: 提出FACTRIA框架，从四个领域组织潜在偏差因素：分析流程、机构情境、课程层面特征与人口统计特征。将该框架作为生成式AI聊天机器人的输入，用于在分析IA时提示用户反思这些因素。随后基于四个真实IA案例开展利益相关者定性研究，并采用转移网络分析（transition network analysis）。
AI.result: 转移网络分析显示，聊天机器人促使参与者识别出此前被忽视的因素如何影响其初始解读。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化框架与AI引导相结合，能够增强对机构数据的情境感知与负责任解读。

title: Energy-Conditioned Noise Schedule and Whitening for Spectral Diffusion
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, Manuscript submitted for publication in Elsevier Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: This paper introduces an energy-adaptive noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Existing spectral diffusion methods account for the non-uniform statistics of transform coefficients through coefficient scaling, normalization, or frequency prioritization, while the forward diffusion noise schedule remains largely independent of the underlying spectral-energy distribution. We investigate whether the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process should also follow the spectral organization of natural images. The proposed formulation combines global spectral whitening with energy-conditioned noise allocation that jointly modulates the injected noise according to the energy of individual transform coefficients and an image-dependent energy path over diffusion time. The resulting forward process preserves Gaussian transitions with closed-form marginals and remains compatible with standard DDPM and DDIM procedures without modifying the diffusion architecture. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the contribution of the proposed energy-conditioned noise schedule and spectral whitening, reducing Fréchet Inception Distance from 142.48 for a compact DCTdiff U-Net variant to 100.45.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向变换域扩散模型的能量自适应噪声调度与白化策略：在全局谱白化基础上，引入按变换系数能量与图像相关能量路径调节的噪声分配，使前向扩散过程保持高斯转移与闭式边缘分布，并兼容DDPM/DDIM，在CIFAR-10上将FID从142.48降至100.45。
AI.motivation: 现有谱域扩散方法多通过系数缩放、归一化或频率优先来建模变换系数的非均匀统计，但前向扩散的噪声调度基本独立于潜在谱能量分布。作者旨在探究前向扩散过程的时间演化是否也应遵循自然图像的谱组织特性，从而把噪声注入与谱能量分布耦合起来。
AI.method: 提出全局谱白化与能量条件噪声分配相结合的前向公式：按各变换系数的能量以及随扩散时间变化的图像相关能量路径，共同调制注入噪声；该前向过程保持高斯转移与闭式边缘分布，且无需改动扩散架构即可兼容标准DDPM与DDIM流程。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上，能量条件噪声调度与谱白化的组合使紧凑型DCTdiff U-Net变体的FID由142.48降至100.45，验证了所提调度与白化策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 前向扩散噪声调度应遵循自然图像的谱能量分布；将谱白化与能量条件噪声分配结合，可在不改变扩散架构的前提下显著改善变换域扩散模型的生成质量。

title: Forecasting the Growth of Social Media Information Cascades: Towards Human-in-the-Loop Misinformation Triage
comment: Work done as part of the SHTEM Internship at Stanford University
summary: Limited review teams must identify which emerging claims are likely to keep growing before their eventual reach is known. We center early misinformation triage on this continuation-forecasting problem: predicting subsequent recorded propagation-tree growth from the first 30 minutes of activity. On FibVID, we compare early node count with structural depth entropy, temporal arrival entropy, and their pair while keeping all propagation trees from each original claim in one partition. Across 352 test trees from 59 claim groups separate from training, the combined model raises $R^2$ for log-transformed future growth from 0.307 to 0.323 and reduces log-MAE by 2.4% (95% claim-bootstrap CI, -0.4% to 5.2%). The gain is especially pronounced among 97 high-activity trees: $R^2$ rises from 0.248 to 0.395, Spearman's $ρ$ from 0.394 to 0.529, and log-MAE falls by 11.7% (95% CI, -1.9% to 23.9%). Complementing the 30-minute growth forecast, we analyze the first 15 replies in 563 PHEME threads. In this cohort, the 15th reply arrives after a median of 28.8 minutes; 52.0% reach the fixed reply prefix within 30 minutes and 71.6% within one hour. Even without the LLM-generated factual-accuracy dimension, the remaining stance, communicative, and affective state composition retains cross-event ranking signal (ROC-AUC 0.538); including that dimension increases ROC-AUC to 0.562. In a separate Check-COVID evaluation of 229 claims, reciprocal-rank fusion retrieves a gold evidence document within the top five for 74.2% of claims and within the top 20 for 94.3%; sentence reranking reaches Recall@20 of 58.1%. We propose an integrated human-review system that brings these early forecasts, response patterns, and retrieved evidence together for misinformation triage relying on the potential virality of claims.

AI.tldr: 本文将早期虚假信息分流建模为"延续预测"问题，基于前30分钟传播活动预测后续传播树增长，并整合回复模式与证据检索，构建人机协同的分流系统。
AI.motivation: 审核团队资源有限，必须在传播范围未知时判断哪些新兴主张会持续增长，因此需要早期证据支持的虚假信息分流方法。
AI.method: 在FibVID上，将同一原始主张的传播树划入同一分区，以早期节点数为基线，比较结构深度熵、时间到达熵及其组合对对数转换后未来增长的预测；在PHEME中分析前15条回复的时间与立场、交际、情感状态构成；在Check-COVID上采用互惠排名融合与句子重排进行证据检索。
AI.result: FibVID测试352棵树、59个主张组：组合模型将R²由0.307提升至0.323，log-MAE降低2.4%；高活跃97棵树中R²由0.248升至0.395，Spearman ρ由0.394升至0.529，log-MAE降11.7%。PHEME中第15条回复中位到达时间28.8分钟，52.0%在30分钟内、71.6%在1小时内；不含事实准确性维度时ROC-AUC为0.538，加入后升至0.562。Check-COVID的229个主张中，前5与前20检索命中率分别为74.2%与94.3%，句子重排Recall@20为58.1%。
AI.conclusion: 早期传播增长可预测，回复时序与状态构成、以及检索证据均具补充信号，三类信息可整合为面向潜在病毒式传播的虚假信息人机分流系统。

title: RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning
summary: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboCap（250g六摄像头双IMU帽子硬件）与Grounded API（设备无关3D算法套件），实现野外第一视角操作数据的大规模采集，并在公开基准上取得SLAM、深度估计与手部追踪的SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 第一视角操作数据对机器人学习扩展极具潜力，但当前数据稀缺；规模化采集需要将人机工程学硬件与厘米级精度3D算法垂直整合，而该精度此前尚未有公开验证。
AI.method: 设计轻量（250g）、六摄像头、双IMU的可穿戴帽子RoboCap用于野外第一视角采集；配套提出Grounded API——一组与设备无关、针对RoboCap调优的3D算法；并系统研究硬件、标定与3D算法之间的协同作用。
AI.result: 在公开基准上取得SOTA：跨多种场景与设备的SLAM、第一视角设置下的深度估计、以及适配第三方设备后的手部追踪。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件、标定与3D算法的垂直整合，可在厘米级精度上实现大规模野外第一视角数据采集，并达到公开基准领先水平。

title: Deep Learning Based Illegal Bowling Action Detection
summary: Cricket, often referred to as the "gentleman's game," adheres to a strict rule set for both batsmen and bowlers, where each delivery can significantly impact the match outcome. Detecting illegal bowling actions is crucial for maintaining fair play, yet it remains challenging for umpires to monitor in real time. Existing sensor-based solutions have limitations in live match scenarios, making real-time assessment difficult. This paper proposes a computer vision-based deep learning solution to detect illegal bowling actions in live cricket matches. To develop and evaluate our approach, we compiled a dataset of 62 videos featuring 11 male bowlers, capturing both legal and illegal bowling actions from multiple angles-front, back, and side. However, the dataset predominantly comprises right-handed bowlers with conventional actions. The proposed system identifies two key frames, the shoulder frame and the release frame from video footage of a bowler's delivery and analyzes the change in the bowling arm's angle between these frames. If the angle difference exceeds a predefined threshold (e.g., 15 degrees), the delivery is flagged as potentially illegal. We evaluated the system on a custom dataset and achieved a high true positive rate, suggesting the system's potential effectiveness in real-time match settings. However, further research is required to validate the system across diverse environmental conditions and larger datasets to ensure generalizability and robustness in various live match scenarios. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first AI-based computer vision method for detecting illegal bowling actions in cricket.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于AI计算机视觉的板球非法投球动作检测方法，通过肩部帧与释放帧间投球臂角度变化判断是否违规。
AI.motivation: 板球投球动作违规会显著影响比赛公平性，但裁判难以实时监控；现有基于传感器的方案在实况比赛中存在局限，难以实现实时评估。
AI.method: 构建包含62段视频、11名男性投球手、从前/后/侧多角度拍摄的合法与非法投球动作数据集；利用深度学习从投球视频中识别肩部帧与释放帧两个关键帧，计算两帧间投球臂角度差；当角度差超过预设阈值（如15度）时判定为疑似非法投球。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上取得较高的真阳性率，显示该系统在实时比赛场景中具有应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作据称是首个用于检测板球非法投球动作的AI计算机视觉方法；但数据集以右手投球手和常规动作为主，需在多样化环境条件与更大数据集上进一步验证，以确保泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
summary: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

AI.tldr: TIDE 2.0 是一个 MIT 许可的去标识化引擎，将识别与匿名化解耦，通过密钥化密码学生成替代值，在本地硬件上运行，无需存储链接表；配套的 TIDE2-Sentry 识别器在两个机构的语料上取得 0.88/0.77 的跨度级召回率与 0.88/0.87 的精确率。
AI.motivation: 临床记录虽记录了大部分诊疗信息，但因含受保护健康信息（PHI）而无法直接用于研究。现有做法把去标识化当作单纯的检测问题：仅做识别并不充分——脱敏会连同临床内容一起删除，日期置空会破坏纵向分析所需的时间间隔，而为每次出现分配新的随机替代值则会割裂同一患者多份记录之间的关联。
AI.method: 提出 TIDE 2.0，一个 MIT 许可、可在机构自有硬件上运行的引擎，包含两个可分离阶段：可互换的识别器与密钥化匿名器。替代值以密码学方式生成，不保存链接表；日期按患者施加保间隔的偏移；在给定密钥下，同一取值在所有出现位置获得相同替代值；换用新密钥生成的发布版本无法与早期发布版本关联。同时发布 TIDE2-Sentry，一个从大语言模型蒸馏得到的识别器。
AI.result: 在两个机构的两份金标准标注语料上，默认配置达到跨度级召回率 0.88（域内）与 0.77（第二家机构语料），精确率分别为 0.88 与 0.87；论文同时报告了各细分类别的召回率与精确率。
AI.conclusion: 该引擎开源，识别器以受限研究用途协议提供，使机构能够在自身环境中运行、审查并扩展两部分组件。

title: Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning
summary: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化"最小见证识别"问题，并提出最小见证强化学习（MWRL），利用黑盒验证器反馈同时学习最小性与多解覆盖。
AI.motivation: 计算与科学中普遍存在"产生某结果的最小充分条件是什么"这一问题，其答案即最小充分见证（解释、机制、原因）。这类问题通常需要多个最小见证，而标准RL方法往往只能给出单一解或冗余解。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为最小见证识别，提出MWRL：取策略采样得到的成功提案所认证集合的并集，并按"移除某提案后该并集覆盖的损失"对其分配信用。该信用分配直接源自问题定义，用单一黑盒验证器比特统一了最小性与替代解恢复两个需求。基于此原理推导出可恢复完整见证族的值迭代规划器，以及可扩展到大型语言模型的策略梯度方法。
AI.result: 在不同实验设置下，MWRL能恢复大多数最小见证，而其他方法返回冗余超集或单一见证。
AI.conclusion: 通过使见证族可从验证器反馈中学习，MWRL将强化学习的适用范围扩展到单解优化之外。

title: Monocular Navigation Relative to Unknown Spacecraft Using a Transformer-Aided Kalman Filter
summary: This work presents a novel learning-based pipeline for pose estimation of unknown spacecraft using only monocular images from a single servicer. The approach combines a transformer-based neural network with a Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) to estimate the pose (i.e., position and orientation of the target spacecraft relative to the camera) throughout rendezvous and proximity operations. Unlike existing vision-based methods that require prior knowledge of the target shape or inertia properties, rely on additional sensing modalities such as depth, lidar, or stereo, or only recover translation up to scale, the proposed pipeline generalizes to previously unseen spacecraft using a single monocular camera. The transformer network estimates the odometry, the change in pose between images up to scale, from SuperPoint features matched by LightGlue. The MSCKF uses these pseudo-measurements along with an orbit and attitude kinematics model to estimate the pose of the target. In particular, the relative orbit elements, the target's attitude with respect to the servicer's camera, and the associated angular velocity are estimated directly by the filter. Given the monocular approach and short distance to the target, the full observability of the range to the target is recovered via attitude maneuvers by the servicer. The method is trained and evaluated on a re-rendered high-resolution version of the SPE3R dataset, which includes synthetic images of 103 spacecraft. Eleven of these spacecraft are held out during training to evaluate the generalization to unseen targets. Monte Carlo simulations are then used to evaluate the navigation pipeline on rendered trajectories of the held out spacecraft. The results demonstrate that learned vision pipelines as a front-end for Kalman filters provide median errors of 3.7° in attitude and 2.2% of range in ROE when navigating about unknown targets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用单目图像的未知航天器位姿估计学习流水线，将Transformer网络与MSCKF结合，在SPE3R数据集上对未见目标实现姿态中值误差3.7°、ROE距离误差2.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的位姿估计方法依赖目标形状或惯量先验、需要深度/激光雷达/立体等额外传感器，或仅能恢复至尺度的平移，难以泛化到未知航天器，本文旨在解决交会与近距离操作中未知目标的单目位姿估计问题。
AI.method: 流水线以SuperPoint特征提取、LightGlue匹配，再由Transformer网络估计图像间尺度不确定的里程计作为伪观测；MSCKF融合该伪观测与轨道及姿态运动学模型，直接估计相对轨道要素、目标相对服务航天器相机的姿态及角速度；利用服务航天器的姿态机动恢复目标距离（尺度）的可观测性。
AI.result: 在重渲染的高分辨率SPE3R数据集（含103个航天器图像）上训练与评估，留出11个航天器用于泛化测试；对留出目标渲染轨迹进行蒙特卡洛仿真，导航流水线取得姿态中值误差3.7°、ROE距离误差为距离的2.2%。
AI.conclusion: 学习式视觉前端与卡尔曼滤波相结合，可在仅有单目相机、无目标先验的条件下对未知航天器实现有效的位姿估计与泛化，验证了该框架在交会与近距离操作中的可行性。

title: Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network for Early Breast Cancer Detection in Low-Resource Clinical Settings
comment: 5 double pages numbers, conference paper presented at AI4SD 2026 (https://www.mu.edu.et/index.php/component/content/article/artificial-intelligence-for-sustainable-development-conference-participants?catid=69&Itemid=101)
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women in Sub-Saharan Africa, where delayed diagnosis results from limited radiology expertise and fragmented clinical data systems. Although deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in mammographic analysis, most rely solely on imaging data and are trained on Western populations, limiting their applicability in African healthcare settings. This paper presents a Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network (HCMAN) that integrates mammogram images with structured clinical data using transformer-based cross-modal attention mechanisms. The model was developed and validated using a locally collected dataset of 2,560 mammogram images from 1,024 patients across four Ethiopian referral hospitals, with biopsy-confirmed ground truth labels. The proposed framework achieves 97.8% accuracy, 97.2% sensitivity, 98.3% specificity, and an AUC of 0.987, significantly outperforming image-only baselines. The system demonstrates robustness to low-quality images typical of resource-limited settings, with only 3.2% performance degradation compared to 8.7% for image-only models. Cross-modal attention analysis reveals clinically appropriate behavior: higher reliance on clinical features for ambiguous cases such as dense breasts and young patients. The model's lightweight architecture enables deployment on standard hospital workstations (<2 seconds inference on CPU). This work advances sustainable, context-aware AI solutions for equitable breast cancer diagnostics in Africa.

AI.tldr: 提出混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），融合乳腺钼靶图像与结构化临床数据，在埃塞俄比亚四家转诊医院的本地数据集上达到97.8%准确率、AUC 0.987，并具备低质图像鲁棒性与CPU轻量部署能力。
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲乳腺癌死亡率高，延迟诊断源于放射学专业人才匮乏与临床数据系统碎片化；现有深度学习模型多仅依赖影像且基于西方人群训练，难以适用于非洲医疗场景。
AI.method: 构建HCMAN，采用基于Transformer的跨模态注意力机制，将钼靶图像与结构化临床数据融合；使用本地采集数据集（4家埃塞俄比亚转诊医院、1,024名患者、2,560张钼靶图像、活检确诊金标准）进行开发与验证，并与纯影像基线模型对比。
AI.result: 准确率97.8%、敏感度97.2%、特异度98.3%、AUC 0.987，显著优于纯影像基线；对资源受限场景常见的低质量图像更鲁棒（性能下降3.2% vs 8.7%）；跨模态注意力分析显示对致密乳腺、年轻患者等模糊病例更依赖临床特征；轻量架构可在标准医院工作站CPU上实现<2秒推理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非洲公平乳腺癌诊断提供了可持续、情境感知的AI解决方案，验证了跨模态融合在资源受限环境中的临床适用性与部署可行性。

title: Lineage-Aware Memory Governance: A Derivation-Gated Framework for Privacy-Preserving Column-Level Access Control in Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Enterprise AI agents that share a memory store face two unaddressed risks: sensitive data can leak through legitimately computed results the requester could not derive, and departments can silently compute a same-named key performance indicator (KPI) through conflicting logic. Existing agent-memory systems (e.g., MemGPT, Zep, A-MEM) gate retrieval by content, ownership, and role, not derivation, missing a cached insight that embeds a forbidden column. We introduce the Analytical Memory Unit (AMU), a memory schema that attaches a full derivation (lineage) graph to every cached result, gated by a retrieval policy that serves a hit only when the requester is authorised for every column touched. Provided lineage recording is complete, we prove by construction that the policy blocks retrieval of results derived from a sensitive column outside the requester's permissions, at O(n) worst case -- a conditional design guarantee, not an empirical claim, that excludes derived features encoding sensitive information without naming their source. Eliminating measured leakage required 75-90% recorded lineage completeness, so we treat 90% as a conservative deployment target. Across six experiments, lineage-gated retrieval removes the 18.8-25.5% cross-department leakage naive content-gated memory suffers, keeping 81.5-82.6% of memory reuse at 13.8 microsecond worst-case overhead. A real-agent proof-of-concept with LLM-generated SQL is consistent with the guarantee: zero leaks over 9 round-trips, two conflicts caught automatically -- though a feasibility demonstration, not evidence of production viability. This offers a practical governance layer for shared agent memory, complementing source-layer access control and supporting EU AI Act compliance.

AI.tldr: 提出分析记忆单元（AMU），为每条缓存结果附加完整推导（血缘）图，并以检索策略门控：仅当请求者对涉及的每一列均被授权时才返回命中，从而在共享记忆的智能体间阻断派生泄漏与同名 KPI 冲突。
AI.motivation: 企业级 AI 智能体共享记忆存储存在两个未被解决的风险：敏感数据可经由请求者本无权推导的合法计算结果泄漏；不同部门可能以相互冲突的逻辑静默计算同名 KPI。现有智能体记忆系统（MemGPT、Zep、A-MEM 等）按内容、归属与角色门控检索，而非按推导过程门控，因而会漏掉内嵌受限列的缓存洞察。
AI.method: 设计 AMU 记忆模式，为每条缓存结果绑定完整的推导（血缘）图；检索策略在请求者对其所触及的每一列均获授权时才提供命中。理论上（在血缘记录完整的前提下）以构造法证明该策略可阻断源自请求者权限之外敏感列的结果检索，最坏复杂度 O(n)。实验上开展六组实验，并构建使用 LLM 生成 SQL 的真实智能体概念验证。
AI.result: 血缘门控检索消除了朴素内容门控记忆所存在的 18.8–25.5% 跨部门泄漏，同时保留 81.5–82.6% 的记忆复用率，最坏情况额外开销为 13.8 微秒。消除可测量的泄漏需要 75–90% 的血缘记录完整度，故将 90% 视为保守的部署目标。真实智能体概念验证（LLM 生成 SQL）与理论保证一致：9 轮往返中零泄漏，自动捕获两处冲突。
AI.conclusion: AMU 为共享智能体记忆提供了实用的治理层，可补充源头层访问控制并支持 EU AI Act 合规。需强调其理论保证为有条件的设计保证（依赖血缘记录完整），概念验证仅为可行性展示，不构成生产可用性的证据；且不排除以其他方式编码敏感信息而未标注来源的派生特征。

title: What Words Keep of a Place: Zero-Shot Language Reasoning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Cross-view geo-localization is commonly solved as an image retrieval problem, matching a ground-level image against a database of satellite tiles through a jointly trained embedding. Such models are accurate, but they need large paired supervision and cannot show what evidence supports a match. In this paper, we study a different question: how much of this task can be solved through language alone? We prompt a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to describe each ground panorama and each satellite tile as structured text, and localize by comparing these descriptions. No component is trained. We evaluate on 9,826 VIGOR pairs from four U.S. cities, in three settings. First, the descriptions are faithful but not discriminative. They agree closely across the two views, yet ranking the full pool by description similarity almost never returns the correct tile (0.39% Recall@1). Second, we narrow the pool to ten neighboring tiles, as a coarse prior would do. The same descriptions now become useful: an MLLM judge that scores structural consistency doubles random ranking and matches a strong lexical baseline. It also states which fields of the two descriptions agree and which conflict, which an embedding distance cannot do, and which we see as a step toward interpretable localization. Third, we place the judge on a trained visual retriever. On the queries it ranks wrongly, reranking from images works, while reranking from our descriptions does not (23.5% against 10.7% Recall@1). Scene structure survives the conversion into language, while the fine appearance detail needed to separate nearby places does not. Code and prompts are publicly available at https://github.com/AyeshAbuLehyeh/GeoLingual.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究跨视角地理定位任务能否仅通过语言完成：用多模态大模型将地面全景与卫星瓦片转成结构化文本，再比较描述定位。在VIGOR数据集的9,826对上实验：全库检索几乎失效（0.39% Recall@1），缩小到10个邻近瓦片后描述变得有用，可解释一致/冲突字段；但在错误查询上，图像重排优于描述重排（23.5% vs 10.7% Recall@1）。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位多作为图像检索问题，靠联合训练的嵌入匹配地面图像与卫星瓦片，虽准确但依赖大量配对监督，且无法说明匹配依据。作者想探究：仅用语言能解决多少该任务，并追求可解释的定位证据。
AI.method: 无需训练的流程：提示多模态大模型分别把地面全景和卫星瓦片描述为结构化文本，通过比较描述进行定位。在四个美国城市的9,826个VIGOR配对、三种设置下评估：(1) 全库按描述相似度排序；(2) 缩小到十个邻近瓦片，用MLLM评判者打分结构一致性；(3) 把该评判者用于已训练视觉检索器的重排。
AI.result: 全库排序按描述相似度几乎无法返回正确瓦片（0.39% Recall@1）；在十个邻近瓦片的小池中，MLLM评判者的结构一致性打分使排序提升到随机的两倍，并匹敌强词法基线，还能指出两描述中一致与冲突的字段；在训练视觉检索器上，对错误查询，图像重排优于描述重排（23.5% vs 10.7% Recall@1）。
AI.conclusion: 场景结构信息能经受转化为语言的损失，但区分邻近地点所需的细粒度外观细节不能。语言单独可支持粗粒度、可解释的定位，但精细判别仍需视觉信息。代码与提示已公开。

title: CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
summary: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持续指令协调任务CIRRA，通过语义推理与结构约束结合的方式，在不破坏正在执行的任务序列前提下整合新指令。
AI.motivation: 家用机器人在执行任务时常收到新指令，现有智能体倾向于重新生成或大幅修改剩余任务序列，导致计划歧义、逻辑不一致和冗余执行。
AI.method: CIRRA为双层框架，融合基于大语言模型的语义推理与规则约束的结构集成。首先将新指令落地为唯一可执行技能，并消解欠规范的动作与执行位置；随后保留正在进行的子任务序列作为执行主干，将新子任务按位置匹配插入相应片段生成集成候选；语义推理器仅评估被修改片段以识别依赖与冲突，选出逻辑最连贯的局部集成方案。
AI.result: 在CHIRP基准（120个episode、八类家庭环境、六类日常活动）上，CIRRA取得74.2%的决策一致率，超过最强重规划基线30个百分点，且每次正确的融合决策都能得到位置正确、无冲突的调度；在Unitree G1人形机器人上，CIRRA每次试验均能在正确时机中断正在执行的技能，并在所有指标上显著优于全部基线。
AI.conclusion: 保持结构的过程可维持与正在执行任务的对齐，缓解歧义与不一致，并通过复用共享子任务减少冗余执行，验证了持续指令协调框架的有效性。

title: Kurate: Scalable Scientific Quality Analysis
summary: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.

AI.tldr: Kurate系统利用大语言模型，结合论文及其注册、协议等相关文档，在8个研究设计与报告维度上自动评估已发表研究的证据质量，并将每项判断链接到具体文本证据。
AI.motivation: 科学检索系统能找到相关论文，但一般无法评估这些论文所提供证据的质量。缺乏大规模、自动化的研究质量评估手段，限制了对元科学问题的研究。
AI.method: Kurate同时使用论文本身及其相关文档（如试验注册与protocol），由LLM在8个维度上评分：统计功效、因果识别、预注册、选择性报告、测量有效性、分析预设、报告透明度、利益冲突与资金；并将每项判断链接到其依据的文本段落。应用于4,347篇论文（其中3,913篇报告随机试验）的语料。
AI.result: 语料中论文最常在统计功效、选择性报告和分析预设方面存在问题，但临床领域间的平均质量存在差异。与60份留出临床试验文档的专家标注相比，Kurate提取的信息在protocol评分点中匹配221/242，在结果发表评分点中匹配294/370，AC1分别为0.94和0.81。以一项高质量临床试验为示例，展示了单篇论文的总体评分如何分解为各单独判断并链接到具体证据。
AI.conclusion: 此类大规模质量评估是可行的，可用于回答元科学研究问题。

title: ATLAS-AL: Adaptive Trust-Region for Latent Adversarial Searches via Active Learning
comment: 9 pages main body, plus 10 additional pages for references and appendix
summary: Security evaluation of learning-based systems requires more than just testing the system against a fixed collection of attacks. It requires adaptive mechanisms that can efficiently discover \textit{sets} of inputs that induce model failure. We introduce ATLAS (Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches), which is a query-based framework that discovers adversarial input sets for black-box learning systems. ATLAS casts attack generation as an active learning level set estimation problem then combines calibrated approximations with a local-global sampling architecture to find regions of the input space that contain adversarial examples. Once discovered, ATLAS is designed to sample points within these adversarial regions to build adversarial sets that accurately represent the state of robustness of the target model. When applied on toy experiments, we find that ATLAS is able to recover more of the adversarial region under a limited query budget than does previous work. When applied to standard and adversarially trained MNIST, CIFAR, and ImageNet model targets, ATLAS produces better representative attacks than other query-based black-box attacks (NES, SignHunter, BayesOpt). ATLAS represents an automated red-teaming framework that can be used for both analyzing the robustness of learning-based systems under development and continuous auditing to see how the robustness of a system changes over time.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一种基于查询的黑盒对抗攻击框架，将攻击生成建模为主动学习的水平集估计问题，结合校准近似与局部-全局采样架构发现对抗区域并采样生成对抗集，在有限查询预算下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统安全评估仅用固定攻击集合测试学习系统，无法充分反映鲁棒性。需要自适应机制，在有限查询预算下高效发现能诱使模型失败的输入集合，从而准确刻画模型鲁棒性状态。
AI.method: ATLAS将攻击生成转化为主动学习中的水平集估计任务，采用校准近似（calibrated approximations）配合局部-全局采样架构定位输入空间中包含对抗样本的区域，再在已发现的对抗区域内采样，构建具有代表性的对抗集。
AI.result: 在玩具实验中，ATLAS在有限查询预算下比先前工作恢复更多对抗区域；在标准训练与对抗训练的MNIST、CIFAR、ImageNet模型上，其生成的攻击代表性优于其他基于查询的黑盒攻击方法（NES、SignHunter、BayesOpt）。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS构成一个自动化红队框架，既可用于开发阶段分析学习系统鲁棒性，也可用于持续审计以监测系统鲁棒性随时间的变化。

title: Localize Any Object in X-Ray Security Scans without Human Annotation
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026; Project page: https://yaqicai.github.io/lao-x/
summary: Universal object localization in X-ray security inspection is critical for automated threat detection in safety-critical venues. However, unlike everyday RGB images that dominate web-scale visual data, X-ray scans exhibit distinct color patterns, ambiguous boundaries, and compositional structures caused by volumetric superposition. These gaps hinder the direct zero-shot transfer of dense perception foundation models trained on web-scale RGB data. Moreover, annotated X-ray data is scarce and requires expert labeling, limiting both the training of generalizable X-ray native models and the adaptation of RGB foundation models for X-ray data via fine-tuning. Given these challenges, the bright promise of highly generalizable perception models, enabled by data scaling laws in the RGB domain, remains largely out of reach for X-ray inspection. To this end, we introduce LAO-X, a self-supervised adaptation framework that Locates Any Object in X-ray scans using diverse synthesized image--annotation pairs with granularity-aware supervision. LAO-X first designs a saliency-guided X-ray object mining module to separate diverse object instances, which are then used for physics-guided synthesis in the absorbance domain. LAO-X further incorporates an occlusion-controlled curriculum strategy to fine-tune a Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) localizer, progressively adapting it to X-ray scans with increasing object counts and overlap levels. Experiments on six X-ray benchmarks show that LAO-X substantially improves category-agnostic localization, achieving 2\% to 23\% mAP gains over SAM2 and X-ray specific baselines in heavily cluttered scenarios, entirely without human-annotated labels.

AI.tldr: LAO-X：面向X射线安检的通用目标定位自监督适配框架，无需人工标注即显著提升杂乱场景下的定位性能。
AI.motivation: X射线扫描图像在颜色模式、边界模糊性和体叠加导致的组成结构上与RGB图像差异显著，限制了在RGB数据上预训练的密集感知基础模型的零样本迁移能力；同时X射线标注数据稀缺且需专家标注，难以训练原生模型或微调RGB基础模型，导致RGB领域数据规模化带来的高泛化感知模型难以在X射线安检中实现。
AI.method: 提出LAO-X自监督适配框架：首先设计显著度引导的X射线目标挖掘模块分离多样目标实例，并在吸光度域进行物理引导合成，生成多样化的图像-标注对；随后引入遮挡控制的课程策略，对Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2）定位器进行微调，随目标数量与重叠程度逐步提升，实现向X射线扫描的渐进适配；整体采用粒度感知监督。
AI.result: 在六个X射线基准上，LAO-X显著提升类别无关定位性能，在高度杂乱场景下相较SAM2和X射线专用基线取得2%至23%的mAP提升，且完全无需人工标注标签。
AI.conclusion: LAO-X通过自监督合成与课程式微调，有效弥合RGB基础模型与X射线域之间的鸿沟，验证了无需人工标注即可实现X射线通用目标定位的可行性。

title: SharedKV-BT: Node-Local Typed Decisions for Behavior-Tree Agents
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Last updated on October 5th, 2026
summary: Agent tasks require sequences of interdependent decisions. Autoregressive models support more flexible decision interfaces than conventional classifiers but incur the latency of token-by-token generation. Recent shared-prefix methods reduce this cost by reusing encoded context and scoring multiple decisions in parallel, but do not model decision dependencies or verify execution. We propose SharedKV-BT, where each active node of a behavior tree (BT) exposes stage-local fields and candidates, and Shared-KV scores the candidates in parallel and passes the selected decision to a separate execution system. We tested SharedKV-BT on robot manipulation, mobile navigation, and computer-use tasks. Across three tasks, SharedKV-BT made typed decisions 2.36-4.15 times faster than prompt-matched autoregressive decoding. On the manipulation task, node-local Shared-KV improved joint decision accuracy from 75% to 94% and closed-loop success from 0% to 60%. Fixed-score policy replay showed that stage gating prevented out-of-order actions and external postconditions prevented premature completion.

AI.tldr: 提出SharedKV-BT，用行为树节点局部字段与候选配合Shared-KV并行打分，加速智能体序贯决策。
AI.motivation: 智能体任务需要相互依赖的决策序列。自回归模型决策接口灵活，但逐token生成延迟高；近期共享前缀方法虽通过复用编码上下文并行打分多个决策来降本，却不建模决策依赖、也不验证执行。
AI.method: 将行为树（BT）与共享KV缓存结合：每个活跃BT节点暴露阶段局部的字段与候选，Shared-KV并行对候选打分，并将选中的决策传给独立的执行系统，从而在决策层面引入依赖结构并支持执行校验。
AI.result: 在机器人操作、移动导航和计算机使用三类任务上，类型化决策比提示匹配的自回归解码快2.36–4.15倍；操作任务中节点局部Shared-KV将联合决策准确率由75%提升至94%，闭环成功率由0%提升至60%；固定分数策略回放显示阶段门控避免了乱序动作，外部后置条件避免了过早完成。
AI.conclusion: 通过BT节点局部化决策空间并用Shared-KV并行打分，可在显著降低生成延迟的同时提升决策准确率与闭环成功率；阶段门控与外部后置条件是保证执行正确性的关键机制。

title: Structuring MoE Expert Selection for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents are frequently implemented using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, yet the co-design of agentic behavior and MoE structures remains underexplored. In this work, we comprehensively study the connections between agentic post-training and MoE expert selection. In off-the-shelf MoE models, we observe expert selection exhibits a specialized structure that naturally aligns with agentic trajectories. Specifically, expert routing overlaps more between turns where the agent performs semantically similar operations (e.g., READ, UPDATE) than between turns with differing operations. However, standard RL algorithms ignore this specialization, allowing the MoE routing to go uncontrolled during training, which empirically limit task performance and inference efficiency. To address this, we introduce a hierarchical routing control framework for agentic tasks. We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究长程LLM智能体（基于稀疏MoE模型）中智能体后训练与专家选择的关系，发现MoE路由与智能体操作类型存在天然对应结构，并提出分层路由控制框架及熵门控机制来显式优化这一结构，在所有评测基准上成功率提升超过10个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM智能体常采用稀疏MoE模型实现，但智能体行为与MoE结构的协同设计（co-design）尚未被充分探索。标准RL算法在训练中忽略MoE专家选择与智能体操作之间的对应关系，导致路由不受控制，实证上限制了任务性能与推理效率。
AI.method: 首先分析现成MoE模型中专家选择的结构：语义相似操作（如READ、UPDATE）的轮次之间路由重叠度高于不同操作轮次。基于此提出分层路由控制框架：在轮次（turn）层级鼓励专家选择与智能体操作对齐，在token层级对专家选择进行正则化以保持局部一致性；并引入熵门控控制机制以解决后训练中的稳定性问题。
AI.result: 在所有评测基准上，该路由控制框架使成功率提升超过10个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，智能体轨迹结构为RL后训练中优化MoE容量提供了有效信号，实现了智能体行为与MoE结构的协同设计。

title: Compositional Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery
summary: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model is now a practical requirement. Weight-editing methods can suppress fixed targets, but they require per-target retraining and modify the model checkpoint. Training-free methods, on the other hand, are deployment-friendly, but they suffer from text-side routing failures on compositional prompts. In such prompts, the erase target may be invoked through a related class rather than its lexical name, and its modifiers may migrate onto preserved objects. This paper proposes Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery (HGSS), a training-free framework for compositional concept erasure. The framework lifts both the routing signal and the edit operator used by text-side erasure. First, hierarchical span grounding resolves erase-target spans through lexical, taxonomic, and semantic evidence, while guarding against broad-hypernym and compound-head false positives. Second, dynamic attribute binding refines the text conditioning during early denoising via a counterfactual reference and a preserve-aware cross-attention objective, keeping surviving attribute-noun bindings intact. HGSS selectively removes the erase target without updating model weights or adding learned parameters. On SEE, HGSS cuts hierarchical evasion from 29.54 to 10.02 and roughly halves pairwise attribute leakage, achieving the best Neighbor E and AttrP scores among the reported erasure methods. On UnlearnCanvas, HGSS slightly improves the six-metric average over the matched Semantic Surgery baseline, reaching state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 HGSS 框架，通过分层实体定位与动态属性绑定，解决组合提示下的概念擦除路由失败与属性迁移问题。
AI.motivation: 已部署的文本到图像扩散模型需要移除受版权保护、不安全或用户指定的概念。权重编辑法需逐目标重训练且改动模型权重；免训练法虽便于部署，但在组合提示中存在文本侧路由失败：擦除目标可能经由相关类别而非其字面名称被调用，且其修饰词会迁移到保留对象上。
AI.method: HGSS 在文本侧同时提升路由信号与编辑算子：（1）分层跨度定位，利用词汇、分类学与语义证据识别擦除目标跨度，并防御宽泛上位词与复合中心词误报；（2）动态属性绑定，在去噪早期通过反事实参考与保留感知的交叉注意力目标细化文本条件，维持存活的属性-名词绑定。该方法不更新权重、不引入可学习参数。
AI.result: 在 SEE 上，HGSS 将分层规避从 29.54 降至 10.02，属性泄漏约减半，在报告方法中取得最佳 Neighbor E 与 AttrP 分数；在 UnlearnCanvas 上，六指标均值较匹配的 Semantic Surgery 基线略有提升，达到当前最优。
AI.conclusion: HGSS 是一种免训练的组合概念擦除框架，通过分层语义定位与动态属性绑定，在不改动模型权重的前提下有选择地擦除目标，并在多个基准上优于现有方法。

title: Logbook: Extremely Long-form Audio Event Understanding
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Source code available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/logbook
summary: Audio benchmarks are built around short, pre-segmented clips, limiting model design to brief inputs or fixed vocabularies. To close this gap, we introduce Logbook, a benchmark for hour-scale audio understanding, with recordings ranging from ten minutes to six days. Given a continuous audio recording and an event label vocabulary, a system must predict a gap-free segmentation with an event label and a description per segment. We compare 52 systems, end-to-end and cascaded, and ablate fine-tuning, context length, and reasoning budget. We find the task tractable, though the best systems remain below the human reference. Also, over-segmentation is pervasive, and fine-tuning partially mitigates it. Finally, end-to-end are often better than cascaded systems, but degrades with longer context.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Logbook——一个面向小时级音频理解的基准，音频时长从 10 分钟到 6 天不等；任务是对连续录音做无间隙分段并标注事件标签与描述。作者比较了 52 个端到端与级联系统，并消融了微调、上下文长度与推理预算。结果显示任务可解但最优系统仍低于人类水平，过分割普遍存在，微调可部分缓解；端到端通常优于级联，但随上下文变长而退化。
AI.motivation: 现有音频基准多基于短的、预先切分的片段，使模型设计被限制在短输入或固定词表上，无法评估长时程连续音频的理解能力。因此需要一个覆盖小时级、连续音频的评测基准来推动相关模型研究。
AI.method: 构建 Logbook 基准：录音时长跨 10 分钟至 6 天。任务定义为：给定一段连续音频和一个事件标签词表，系统需输出无间隙的分段，并为每段给出事件标签和描述。实验上对比 52 个系统，涵盖端到端与级联两类架构，并对微调、上下文长度、推理预算进行消融。
AI.result: 该任务被认为是可解的，但最佳系统仍低于人类参考水平。过分割现象普遍存在，微调可以部分缓解。端到端系统通常优于级联系统，但在更长上下文下性能下降。
AI.conclusion: Logbook 揭示了小时级音频理解这一新方向：任务可行但尚未达到人类水平，过分割与长上下文退化是主要挑战；端到端架构整体占优，微调有一定帮助。该基准为长时程音频建模提供了评测基础与改进方向。

title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23170287; code: https://github.com/Kamaleswaran-Lab/TC3-VQA
summary: Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TC3-VQA，一个面向战术战伤救治（TC3）的视觉问答数据集，将可见伤情证据与可溯源的权威教义相连接，包含 581 个条目、11 个概念、1,860 个问题，覆盖干预识别、教义、临床推理、程序指导与视觉信息不足时的拒答等任务，并提供教义出处原文与字符偏移、视觉标注与元数据，以及自动化审计和医师/医学生评分以刻画标注质量。
AI.motivation: TC3 要求响应者将伤情与干预的视觉观察同既定临床指南相联系；而构建支持该过程的视觉语言模型需要能把可见证据与可追溯教义关联起来的监督信号，现有资源缺乏此类连接，因此需要专门的数据集。
AI.method: 从公开 TC3 教学与实战视频及权威 TC3 文档构建数据集；共 581 个条目、11 个概念、1,860 个问题；题型涵盖干预识别、教义、临床推理、程序指导及视觉信息不足时的拒答；基于教义的答案保留逐字源文段与字符偏移；构建流程融合视觉标注、文段检索、蕴含检验与跨模型族验证；问答对附有器械框、解剖标签、时间片段与来源元数据；通过自动化审计及两名医师与两名医学生的评分刻画标注质量，其中 88 个保留条目具有人工评分。
AI.result: 经自动化审计与人工评分后保留 88 个条目的质量特征；数据集覆盖 11 个概念、1,860 个问题，并提供逐字教义文段与字符偏移、视觉框、解剖标签、时间片段与来源元数据，形成可用于 TC3 视觉语言模型适配与评估的资源。
AI.conclusion: TC3-VQA 为适配 TC3 的视觉语言模型提供资源，可用于研究视觉证据与临床知识之间的联系，并评估识别、教义召回与拒答能力。

title: Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity
comment: Apple Foundation Models, 15 Pages, Edge LLMs
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个将弹性结构与稀疏门控架构统一的框架，使单一模型能同时适应部署约束与任务需求，在1–4B参数间灵活切换。
AI.motivation: LLM训练资源密集，且需适配不同计算约束的部署场景。弹性架构支持灵活部署，稀疏激活模型支持输入自适应计算，但现有方法将二者独立处理；此外面向端侧推理的模型需满足设备内存与算力限制。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，将弹性结构与稀疏门控架构结合。模型骨干同时以上下文和目标效率规格为条件，从而在推理时细粒度控制精度-效率权衡；模型在弹性嵌套子网络内学习激活任务相关参数，使单一模型覆盖多个容量点，并保持输入自适应路由。
AI.result: 实验表明，单一模型可在1、2、3、4B参数间灵活使用，在知识密集型基准上比稠密对应模型更精确（提升2–5%），与静态版本相当，同时延迟指标与稠密模型相近。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享模型参数节省设备磁盘空间，支持依据可用DRAM与算力灵活服务，并给出更精确的结果。

title: Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object
summary: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究视频世界模型（以冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器为主）对"看不见的物体"是否保持表征（物体永久性）。结果表明：预测器侧普遍缺失永久性——静止物体部分保留、被容器携带的物体几乎完全丢失、运动物体约0.3–0.5秒内消失；而编码器本身能读出物体存在并保留封闭容器内容达3.5秒。作者证明这种信念可通过少量预测器专用训练廉价安装为先验，并提升IntPhys-2019至93.3%，但基准所"奖励"的训练习惯依赖评分规则。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能追踪其可见的物体，但对其不可见（被遮挡/隐藏）的物体是否保留信息尚不清楚。论文旨在区分"信息是否存在"（编码器侧）与"预测器是否使用该信息"，从而检验视频世界模型是否具备物体永久性（object permanence）这一核心认知能力。
AI.method: 从冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器中隐藏某区域内的物体，并将其对该隐藏区域的预测与编码器对两个"仅在该区域不同"的世界的表征进行比较；测量决策保留时间、投影中的残留痕迹（相对"复制上一视图"基线的比例），并用编码器自身的探针读取预测器输出。进一步通过3000步仅预测器训练（合成容器）安装永久性先验，并设置两个匹配对照；在IntPhys-2019上评测，同时比较不同评分规则下所奖励的训练习惯；继续用tube mask训练以测试操控和互联网风格视频上的运动物体携带时间；并对比VideoMAE与Cosmos。
AI.result: 预测器保留静止物体仅部分、对被容器携带的物体完全不保留、运动物体在0.3秒内丢失（V-JEPA自身tube mask下0.5秒；ViT-H在90%掩码率下保留至1.1秒）；投影中残留低于中点，为"复制上一视图"基线的14–60%。编码器能1.00读出物体存在，并让封闭容器内容可解码3.5秒；而用编码器探针读取预测器输出时，盒子关闭半秒后仅2%的场景含球。在渲染场景上预测器侧缺失永久性。3000步仅预测器训练可将该信念从0.05提升至1.00（对照两匹配组）；IntPhys-2019从84.2%提升至93.3%，但无容器的课程也能达到相同效果，且基准所奖励的训练习惯随评分规则而变。用tube mask继续训练，在操控与互联网风格视频上产生1.1–1.6秒的运动物体携带。VideoMAE几乎不保留；Cosmos的下一token预测保留静止隐藏物体，但不保留被移动容器携带的物体。
AI.conclusion: 该缺陷并非潜在预测本身固有的：编码器侧信息存在，预测器侧却未加以利用。永久性对预测器而言缺失，但可通过少量预测器专用训练廉价安装为先验，并在部分基准上带来提升——然而提升的来源与所奖励的"训练习惯"取决于评分规则。不同架构（ViT-H、VideoMAE、Cosmos）在隐藏物体保持上表现出显著差异。

title: Who Wrote It Is Not Enough: Detecting Who Contributed the Insight
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出新任务"洞见溯源"（Insight Provenance），构建InsightProv-v0数据集，通过两阶段对抗框架抑制捷径信号，识别评审洞见源自人类、LLM还是混合贡献。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM日益参与科学写作与同行评审，仅判断"文本由谁撰写"已不足够，真正需要判定的是"底层洞见由谁贡献"。现有文本作者归属检测存在语言与文本作者身份捷径，导致原始数据上的高性能具有误导性。
AI.method: 基于4,057篇科学论文与12,660条人类评审构建InsightProv-v0，用GPT-4o、Gemini、DeepSeek模拟不同LLM参与程度，并在句子级标注来源；提出两阶段对抗框架，在抑制捷径信号的同时保留与溯源相关的信息。
AI.result: 模型在原始数据上表现强劲，但在逐步去偏的评估下性能显著下降，说明其依赖捷径；分析显示论文依据与邻近评审上下文提供互补的溯源信号，人类、混合与AI洞见在信息来源和失败模式上存在系统性差异——AI洞见多贴近通用或论文已有信息，人类洞见更常引入外部知识与独立判断。
AI.conclusion: 措辞可被LLM改写，但洞见的来源留下更深层、更持久的信号；溯源判定需在去偏评估下进行，为识别智能作者身份提供了新任务与框架。

title: Identity-Conditioned Score Fusion for Open-Set Person Re-Identification
summary: Robust person re-identification often combines complementary cues such as face, gait, and body shape. While adaptive fusion typically targets query quality, model strength also varies across identities. We introduce identity-conditioned score fusion, a framework that tailors weights to each gallery identity without training. By contrasting intra-identity consistency against cross-identity impostors, it extracts identity-specific profiles that couple with query-conditioned adaptation via a parameter-free rule. This widens the separation between true and false matches while preserving score calibration. Evaluations on three clothes-changing person re-identification benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms statistical, rank-based, and learned baselines, achieving up to an 8.8% absolute reduction in the false non-identification rate and demonstrating the value of identity-conditioned fusion in open-set person re-identification.

AI.tldr: 提出身份条件化分数融合框架，无需训练即可为每个底库身份定制权重，结合查询条件化自适应，在三个换衣行人重识别基准上显著降低误拒识率。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒行人重识别常融合人脸、步态、体型等互补线索。现有自适应融合多针对查询质量进行调整，但模型强度在不同身份间也存在差异，身份维度的差异未被利用。
AI.method: 提出身份条件化分数融合：通过对比同一身份内部一致性与跨身份冒充者，提取身份特异性权重画像；再以无参数规则与查询条件化自适应相结合，为每个底库身份定制融合权重，无需训练，并保持分数校准。
AI.result: 在三个换衣行人重识别基准上持续优于统计类、排序类与学习类基线，误拒识率最多实现8.8%的绝对下降。
AI.conclusion: 身份条件化融合能扩大真实匹配与虚假匹配的分离度，在开放集行人重识别中具有重要价值。

title: SimCortex v2: Joint Cortical Surface Reconstruction with Near-Zero Collisions and Self-Intersections
summary: Reconstructing cortical WM and pial surfaces from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a prerequisite for surface-based neuroanatomical analysis, yet remains challenging because the cortex is thin and tightly folded. Reconstruction methods can produce geometric artifacts such as mesh self-intersections and collisions between cortical surfaces, and although recent deep learning methods have reduced reconstruction time from hours to minutes, these artifacts persist. We propose SimCortex v2, a deep learning framework for simultaneous reconstruction of the left and right WM and pial surfaces from T1-weighted MRI. SimCortex v2 estimates topologically correct initial surfaces from a volumetric segmentation and refines all four jointly using multi-scale stationary velocity fields predicted by a ribbon-conditioned, U-Net-like network. We evaluated SimCortex v2 on 560 cases from 14 cohorts, thirteen of them unseen during training, spanning ages 6-89, healthy and clinical populations, and scanners from three vendors. SimCortex v2 matched the surface-distance accuracy of the strongest baseline (average symmetric surface distance 0.253 mm) while showing no detected inter-surface collision in 92.14% of cases and the lowest self-intersection fraction (0.044%) among learning-based methods, whereas every baseline produced at least one collision in every case. Source code, configuration files, pretrained weights, preprocessed data, and the exact evaluation splits are publicly released.

AI.tldr: SimCortex v2 是一个深度学习框架，可从 T1 加权 MRI 同时重建左右半球的白质与软膜表面，在 560 例多队列数据上获得与最强基线相当的表面距离精度，同时显著减少网格自交与表面间碰撞。
AI.motivation: 从结构 MRI 重建皮层 WM 与 pial 表面是表面神经解剖分析的前提，但皮层薄且褶皱紧密，重建易产生自交与表面间碰撞等几何伪影。深度学习虽将重建时间从数小时缩短到数分钟，但伪影仍未被解决，因此需要一种能同时保证拓扑正确与几何一致性的重建方法。
AI.method: 提出 SimCortex v2，从 T1 加权 MRI 同时重建左右两侧 WM 与 pial 四个表面。方法先从体积分割估计拓扑正确的初始表面，再由 ribbon 条件化的类 U-Net 网络预测多尺度平稳速度场，对四个表面进行联合精修。
AI.result: 在来自 14 个队列的 560 例数据上评估，其中 13 个队列训练时未见，覆盖 6–89 岁、健康与临床人群以及三家厂商扫描仪。SimCortex v2 达到与最强基线相当的表面距离精度（平均对称表面距离 0.253 mm），92.14% 病例未检测到表面间碰撞，自交比例最低（0.044%），而所有基线在每个病例中均至少产生一次碰撞。
AI.conclusion: SimCortex v2 在保持高表面距离精度的同时，有效抑制了自交和表面间碰撞等几何伪影，并在多队列、跨年龄与跨厂商数据上展现良好泛化性；作者公开了源代码、配置、预训练权重、预处理数据与评估划分。

title: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
summary: Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is essential for autonomous driving and robotics. A common paradigm is to use world models to predict future images or latent representations of the environment and subsequently recover geometry from these predictions. However, this paradigm does not explicitly model geometric structure and typically relies on recursive rollouts to reach longer prediction horizons, leading to error accumulation and increasing computational cost. To address these limitations, we present GeoWM, a geometry world model that directly forecasts future scene geometry at specified future horizons without recursive rollout. The key idea is to leverage a geometry foundation model to transform observed RGB frames into a geometric history, which conditions a flow-matching transformer to predict the scene geometry at a specified future horizon. We further show that a lightweight camera-motion predictor can accurately estimate the future viewpoint, and that projecting the observed geometry into the predicted viewpoint provides an effective geometric prior for future geometry forecasting. Extensive experiments on four datasets spanning urban driving, aerial flight, and dynamic manipulation demonstrate that GeoWM outperforms the evaluated world models in forecasting depth, camera pose, and 3D scene geometry, while substantially reducing inference time at longer horizons.

AI.tldr: GeoWM是一种几何世界模型，可直接预测指定未来时刻的场景几何，无需递归展开，在深度、相机位姿和3D场景几何预测上优于现有世界模型，并显著降低长时域推理时间。
AI.motivation: 3D场景几何及其随时间演化的建模对自动驾驶和机器人至关重要。现有世界模型范式通过预测未来图像或潜表示再恢复几何，未显式建模几何结构，且依赖递归展开以到达更长预测时域，导致误差累积和计算成本增加。
AI.method: 利用几何基础模型将观测RGB帧转化为几何历史，作为条件输入流匹配Transformer，直接预测指定未来时域的场景几何；同时引入轻量级相机运动预测器估计未来视点，将观测几何投影到预测视点，作为未来几何预测的有效几何先验。
AI.result: 在涵盖城市驾驶、空中飞行和动态操作的四个数据集上，GeoWM在深度、相机位姿和3D场景几何预测方面均优于所评估的世界模型，同时在更长时域下大幅降低推理时间。
AI.conclusion: GeoWM通过显式几何建模和直接指定时域预测，克服了传统世界模型递归展开带来的误差累积与计算开销问题，验证了几何基础模型与流匹配Transformer及相机运动先验结合的有效性。

title: WildMatch: Weakly Supervised Image Matcher Adaptation for Wildlife Re-Identification
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://wildmatch.gmum.net
summary: Individual animal re-identification from camera-trap imagery is an instance retrieval problem central to non-invasive wildlife monitoring: a query image must retrieve the correct individual from a reference set of known animals. This requires computer vision models to recognize distinctive local patterns in fur, skin, or other visual markings. Current approaches either learn global embeddings as a classification problem, requiring many labeled images per individual while largely ignoring local evidence, or apply off-the-shelf, domain-agnostic image matchers. Although such matchers are pretrained on large and diverse image collections, adapting them to wildlife imagery is challenging because available datasets are small and lack correspondence-level annotations. We study weakly supervised adaptation of a pretrained keypoint matcher using only identity labels, without keypoint-level or geometric correspondence ground truth. We mine informative image pairs with the pretrained matcher, derive weak positive and negative supervision from identity agreement, and contrastively fine-tune the matching network to strengthen correspondences for same-identity pairs and suppress them for different identities. Across open-source wildlife re-identification datasets, our approach improves accuracy over off-the-shelf matchers and a state-of-the-art local--global fusion method. Under an open-world protocol with held-out individuals, it learns a transferable correspondence prior rather than memorizing training identities. To our knowledge, this is the first study of matcher-level, identity-supervised adaptation for animal re-identification. Our method enables data-efficient specialization of image matching models to wildlife domains using identity annotations already available in typical monitoring datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种仅依赖身份标签的弱监督适配方法，将预训练关键点匹配器迁移到野生动物个体重识别任务，通过挖掘图像对并进行对比微调，提升匹配精度。
AI.motivation: 野生动物个体重识别是图像检索问题，需模型识别皮毛、皮肤等局部独特纹理。现有方法要么以分类方式学习全局嵌入、依赖大量标注且忽略局部证据，要么使用领域无关的现成匹配器；但野生动物数据规模小、缺乏对应级标注，难以直接适配。
AI.method: 在仅有身份标签、无关键点或几何对应真值的条件下，用预训练匹配器挖掘信息量高的图像对；依据身份一致性构造弱正、负监督信号；对匹配网络进行对比微调，增强同身份图像对的对应关系、抑制不同身份的对应关系。
AI.result: 在多个开源野生动物重识别数据集上，该方法精度优于现成匹配器和一种局部-全局融合的SOTA方法；在留出个体的开放世界协议下，模型学到可迁移的对应先验，而非记忆训练身份。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对动物重识别的匹配器级身份监督适配研究。方法利用监测数据集中已有的身份标注，实现图像匹配模型面向野生动物领域的数据高效特化。

title: Semantic Capability Acquisition and Specialization During Vision-Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary: Fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) is typically evaluated at a single downstream checkpoint, obscuring whether a semantic capability was never acquired or emerged earlier and later declined during specialization. We ask how semantic capabilities are acquired, when they peak, how well they transfer, and what remains at deployment. We study these dynamics as a semantic capability trajectory, tracking identity- and attribute-based capabilities over training. We formulate a trajectory-based framework that separates capability acquisition, capability-specific optima, and later specialization, and introduce Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) to study how the representation of supervision shapes what is acquired. Across six pretrained backbones spanning DFN, MetaCLIP, and OpenAI CLIP, we show that fine-tuning can acquire semantic capability beyond the pretrained state, including gains observed on held-out evaluations.
