Unstructured name-and-attribute supervision produces strong name-and-attribute retrieval with comparatively weak name-free attribute-profile retrieval, whereas SSR yields substantially stronger name-free attribute-profile retrieval and is further strengthened by stochastic name-branch dropout. Different capabilities can peak at different stages, so a checkpoint selected by target class-name retrieval need not coincide with a transferable semantic optimum. Continued optimization can therefore preserve strong target class-name retrieval while reducing previously acquired transferable semantic capability. In a representative diagnostic study, this late specialization is consistent with reduced cross-modal semantic accessibility while substantial image-only class structure remains available.

AI.tldr: 本文将VLM微调中的语义能力建模为随训练演化的"语义能力轨迹",区分能力获取、能力特定最优与后期专业化,并提出结构化语义路由(SSR)方法,揭示监督表示形式如何决定所学能力的性质。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM微调评估通常只在单一最终检查点进行,无法判断语义能力是"从未获得"还是"早期出现后在专业化过程中衰退",从而掩盖了能力获取时机、峰值与迁移性等关键问题。
AI.method: 提出轨迹式分析框架,在训练过程中持续追踪基于身份与基于属性的语义能力,将能力获取、能力特定最优与后期专业化三者分离;并引入结构化语义路由(SSR)以研究监督信号的表示结构如何塑造所学内容,同时考察随机名称分支dropout的影响。
AI.result: 在DFN、MetaCLIP和OpenAI CLIP六种预训练骨干上验证:(1)微调可获得超越预训练状态的语义能力,在留出评测上亦有增益;(2)非结构化"名称-属性"监督带来较强名称-属性检索,但无名称属性画像检索较弱,而SSR显著提升无名称属性画像检索,随机名称分支dropout进一步增强;(3)不同能力在不同阶段达到峰值,按目标类名检索选出的检查点未必对应可迁移语义最优;(4)继续优化可在保持目标类名检索的同时削弱先前获得的可迁移语义能力。诊断研究表明,这种后期专业化伴随跨模态语义可及性下降,而图像单模态类别结构仍大量保留。
AI.conclusion: 单一检查点评估会掩盖语义能力的获取与衰退轨迹;能力特定最优未必与目标类名检索最优一致,部署时可能已损失可迁移语义能力;监督信号的表示结构(如SSR)决定能力类型,故应以轨迹视角进行微调评估与检查点选择。

title: Learnable Spectral Activations
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are shaped by the spectral structure induced by their input encodings and activation functions. Existing methods improve fitting primarily by modifying which frequencies are available to the network, through coordinate encodings or periodic nonlinearities. However, frequency access is not the only bottleneck: signals with localized or spatially varying structure require the network to efficiently compose frequencies into multi-harmonic internal responses. We introduce learnable spectral activations (LSA), which replace fixed neuron-level nonlinearities with a residual truncated Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are learned during training. LSA does not expand the asymptotic function class. Instead, it changes the factorization of the representation: linear weights select features while activation coefficients control spectral shaping, and the two are updated by separate gradients. Because the activation output is affine in the coefficients given fixed pre-activations, spectral tuning becomes a more direct subproblem compared to architectures where it is entangled with feature selection. Empirically, this factorization concentrates more target-signal energy in the leading eigenmodes of the neural tangent kernel, consistent with improved optimization behavior. Across audio, image, neural radiance field, and neural acoustic field tasks, LSA also improves reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可学习谱激活（LSA），用残差截断傅里叶级数替换固定的神经元级非线性，通过学习谐波幅值改变表示的分解方式，在音频、图像、NeRF、声场等任务上提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经表示（INR）主要靠修改可获取的频率（坐标编码或周期非线性）来提升拟合能力，但频率可获取性并非唯一瓶颈：具有局部或空间变化结构的信号要求网络高效地把频率组合成多谐波的内部响应。
AI.method: 提出LSA，将固定的神经元级非线性替换为残差截断傅里叶级数，其谐波幅值在训练中学习。LSA不扩大渐近函数类，而是改变表示的分解：线性权重负责选择特征，激活系数负责谱整形，两者由独立梯度更新。由于固定预激活下激活输出对系数是仿射的，谱调优成为更直接的子问题，不再与特征选择纠缠。
AI.result: 该分解使更多目标信号能量集中在神经正切核（NTK）的前导特征模中，与优化行为的改善一致；在音频、图像、神经辐射场（NeRF）和神经声场任务上，LSA均提升了重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将谱整形与特征选择分离，LSA以不扩大函数类的方式改善了INR优化，并在多类任务上验证了有效性。

title: AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion
comment: Published in Proceedings of IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT) 2026
summary: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 AccentCL——一个面向英语口音分类的类增量学习框架，通过不平衡感知损失、域均值对齐损失与回放式持续学习，在类不平衡与跨语料域偏移下实现稳健分类，并支持新口音类别增量加入而无需全量重训练。
AI.motivation: 传统口音分类器使用固定标签集训练，无法在新数据出现时接纳新口音类别；同时口音语音语料普遍存在类别不平衡，且因录音条件差异导致跨语料库的域偏移问题。
AI.method: 采用冻结的 Whisper-Large-v3 编码器提取多层表示；使用不平衡感知交叉熵损失抑制对多数口音类的偏置，使用域均值对齐损失最小化训练语料间的分布均值偏移；通过基于回放的持续学习扩展标签空间，以冻结基模型保持知识，并用旧-新边界损失（old-to-new margin loss）抑制对新类别的过度预测。
AI.result: 在五类口音分类任务上取得 77.1% 平衡准确率与 76.9% 宏平均 F1；增量加入西班牙口音英语时新类达 83.3% F1，基类保持 77.3% 平衡准确率；再增量加入中国口音英语时新类达 61.8% F1，已学类别保持 77.6% 平衡准确率。
AI.conclusion: AccentCL 在类不平衡与跨语料域偏移条件下实现了稳健的口音分类，并能在不进行全量重训练的情况下增量添加新口音类别。

title: Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-example logs are available at https://github.com/aadcha/action-conditioned-gui-agent
summary: A GUI agent decides which action to take and where to take it; we ask how a small grounding model should receive the action type. Fine-tuning Qwen2-VL-2B with LoRA on Android in the Wild, we compare a flat baseline with five ways of supplying the type under matched data, compute, and decoding: an auxiliary loss, a hard-routed action word, an additive learned embedding, a prepended learned token, and the type written into the prompt. With five seeds, an episode-clustered bootstrap, and seed-level paired tests, the ranking on a mixed stream is clear: the auxiliary loss, the additive embedding, and the prompt word each gain five to seven hit@0.10 points over the baseline, while hard routing and the prepended token are not distinguishable from it. Much of that gain is protection from a preprocessing choice of ours rather than a spatial prior. Our serializer clamps the off-screen touch point AITW records for type events to the origin; that class degrades the baseline's click grounding, and removing it lifts the baseline by nearly seven points, after which no mechanism's hit rate beats it and the intervals exclude a two-point effect, though the auxiliary loss still shortens the average miss; on a stream of taps and swipes none helps. Whether this generalizes beyond one serialization is open. For deployment, the pipeline's margin over the baseline with predicted rather than gold types is not established (+0.016, 95% interval [-0.017, +0.052]), and a wrong type collapses every model conditioned at inference. The prepended token does not help at the shared learning rate, where its rows barely move from initialization; trained ten times faster it reaches the level of the other three, with a margin three seeds do not establish. We also document a silent failure: injecting conditioning through inputs_embeds makes Qwen2-VL fall back to 1-D positions for image tokens, costing nine points.

AI.tldr: 该论文在 AITW 上微调 Qwen2-VL-2B，系统比较了五种向小规模 grounding 模型注入动作类型信息的方式。结果表明，辅助损失、加性嵌入和提示词三种方式在混合流上稳定优于基线（+5~7 点 hit@0.10），但增益很大程度源于对预处理中 off-screen 类型样本的处理，而非真正的空间先验；在仅含 tap 与 swipe 的流上无任何机制有效，部署时用预测类型替代 gold 类型也未见显著优势。
AI.motivation: GUI agent 需同时决定动作类型与执行位置，而小规模 grounding 模型如何接收动作类型这一关键设计问题此前缺乏受控比较。作者希望在匹配数据、算力和解码条件下，厘清不同类型条件化机制的相对优劣及其增益来源。
AI.method: 在 Android in the Wild 上以 LoRA 微调 Qwen2-VL-2B，对比基线（flat）与五种类型注入方式：辅助损失、硬路由动作词、加性学习嵌入、前置学习 token、将类型写入 prompt。控制数据、算力与解码一致，采用 5 个随机种子、按 episode 聚类的 bootstrap 及种子级配对检验。另外单独考察序列化器对 off-screen touch point 钳制到原点这一预处理选择的影响，并在推理时用预测类型替代 gold 类型进行评估。
AI.result: 在混合流上，辅助损失、加性嵌入与 prompt 词各比基线提升约 5~7 点 hit@0.10；硬路由与前置 token 与基线不可区分。增益很大程度来自对预处理中 off-screen 类型（钳制到原点）的保护：移除该类型后基线提升近 7 点，此后无机制能显著超越基线，置信区间可排除 2 点效应，仅辅助损失仍缩短平均 miss。在仅含 tap 和 swipe 的流上无机制有效。部署时以预测类型替代 gold 类型，相对基线优势未确立（+0.016，95% 区间 [-0.017, +0.052]），且错误类型会使所有推理条件化模型崩溃。前置 token 在共享学习率下几乎不更新、无帮助，以 10 倍学习率训练可达到其他三种水平，但该差距 3 个种子无法确立。此外记录了通过 inputs_embeds 注入条件化会使 Qwen2-VL 图像 token 回退到 1-D 位置编码、损失 9 点的静默失效。
AI.conclusion: 在受控条件下，动作类型条件化的多数表面增益是对特定序列化预处理伪影的保护，而非稳健的空间先验；其是否能泛化到其他序列化方式仍待验证。部署层面，依赖预测类型并不稳健，错误类型会破坏所有条件化模型；前置 token 的初始化与学习率敏感性也提示训练细节的重要性。作者同时提醒了 inputs_embeds 注入导致的 1-D 位置编码回退这一静默失效，值得社区注意。

title: AlignQuant: Tile-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Fine-grained mixed-precision quantization promises efficient large language model inference, but local precision choices can conflict with regular GPU storage and computation units. This precision-boundary mismatch limits the translation of compression into practical acceleration. We introduce AlignQuant, a post-training quantization method that uses GPU-compatible two-dimensional weight tiles as the common unit of precision allocation, compact storage, and execution. This shared partition lets precision follow sensitivity within output channels. Joint prefill/decode calibration scores precision reductions using projection-output perturbations weighted by language-model loss gradients under quantized activations. Phase-normalized scores prioritize higher precision for tiles important to either phase under a model-wide weight-storage budget. Each tile stores one selected representation, while phase-specialized kernels reuse the packed model and expand lower-bit weights for INT8 computation with 8-bit activations. Across four LLMs spanning 3B to 14B parameters, AlignQuant achieves up to $2.50\times$ generation speedup over BF16 while preserving model quality. Evaluations further cover three GPUs and contexts up to 64K tokens. These results show that local precision flexibility and regular GPU execution can coexist through a shared tile unit. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/AlignQuant.

AI.tldr: AlignQuant是一种训练后量化方法，以GPU兼容的二维权重tile为统一单元，实现精度分配、紧凑存储与执行，在3B-14B大模型上取得最高2.50×生成加速并保持质量。
AI.motivation: 细粒度混合精度量化虽有利于大语言模型推理效率，但局部精度选择会与GPU规则的存储与计算单元产生冲突，即“精度边界错配”问题，导致压缩难以转化为实际加速。因此需要一种兼顾局部精度灵活性与GPU规则执行的方法。
AI.method: AlignQuant采用训练后量化，以GPU兼容的二维权重tile作为精度分配、紧凑存储和执行的共同单元，使精度可在输出通道内跟随敏感度。联合prefill/decode校准在量化激活下，用语言模型损失梯度加权的投影输出扰动来评估精度降低；相位归一化分数在模型级权重存储预算下，为对任一相位重要的tile优先分配更高精度。每个tile存储单一选定表示，相位专用kernel复用打包模型，将低位权重大扩展到INT8计算，并配8-bit激活。
AI.result: 在涵盖3B至14B参数的四个大语言模型上，AlignQuant相较BF16最高实现2.50×生成加速，同时保持模型质量。评估还覆盖三种GPU和最长64K token的上下文。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过共享tile单元，局部精度灵活性与规则GPU执行可以共存，从而将细粒度混合精度压缩有效转化为实际推理加速。

title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
summary: Organizations make claims about their AI agents: a person approves every external email, every action is logged, an evaluation shows the agent is safe to deploy. Article 12 of the EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to allow the automatic recording of events but does not say which records settle a given claim. The position is one sentence: to be checked, a claim about an agent must first name its policy, its scope, the records that would settle it, and who writes them. Adapting the preconditions of an assurance engagement, we call a claim auditable when these elements and a decision rule are fixed before any verdict and the records are obtainable. This extends the Policy Checkability dimension of our Auditable Agents framework from single actions to claims. Agents add three conditions: coverage by an independent record, authorization bound to each action's arguments, and completeness beyond integrity. Under an explicit model, we prove that support is impossible without each wherever its hypotheses hold. A claim-check table applies the method to six common claims, anchored in current NIST, IETF, and OWASP drafts. A worked case follows one claim through five evidence states. We close with a practice box and steps for operators, buyers, auditors, and standard setters.

AI.tldr: 要核查一项关于AI代理的声明，必须事先固定其策略、范围、判定记录及记录者，并确立决策规则且记录可获取，方为"可审计"；代理场景另需记录独立性、授权与动作参数绑定、完整性之外的完备性三条件。
AI.motivation: 组织常对AI代理作出各类声明（如每次外发邮件均经人工批准、每个动作都有日志、评测证明代理可安全部署），但欧盟《人工智能法案》第12条仅要求高风险系统支持自动记录事件，未规定哪些记录能证实特定声明。声明与记录之间缺乏可判定性的桥接标准，导致核查无从落地。
AI.method: 借鉴保证业务（assurance engagement）的前置条件，提出"可审计"定义：声明须指明策略、范围、可判定记录及记录撰写者，并在任何结论之前固定决策规则且记录可获取。将作者既有"可审计代理"框架中的Policy Checkability维度从单一动作扩展到声明层面。针对代理追加三个条件：独立记录覆盖、授权绑定到每个动作的参数、超越完整性的完备性。在显式模型下证明：在假设成立之处，缺少任一条件则支持不可成立。以"声明-核查表"方法应用于六类常见声明，锚定NIST、IETF与OWASP现有草案；并以一个案例贯穿五种证据状态。
AI.result: 在一明确模型下证明：若缺少独立记录覆盖、参数级授权绑定或完备性中的任一条件，则无法对声明构成支持（在相应假设成立时）。声明-核查表将方法落实于六类常见声明，并与NIST、IETF、OWASP现行草案对齐；案例展示单一声明在五种证据状态间的演进。
AI.conclusion: 提出可审计性的判定标准及代理特有的三项条件，为合规核查提供可操作的判定框架。面向运营方、采购方、审计方与标准制定者给出实践要点与操作步骤，将声明核查从笼统承诺转化为可验证的工程与治理流程。

title: ElasticFit: Fit-Aware 3D Object Insertion via VLM Reasoning and Generative Adaptation
summary: Inserting objects into existing 3D scenes requires more than selecting a plausible location: the inserted object must also fit local geometry while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and generative models enable semantic reasoning and visual content creation, they offer limited 3D grounding and geometric control when an inserted object must fit into constrained local spaces. We introduce ElasticFit, a VLM-guided framework for fit-aware object insertion centered on a novel scene-grounded representation. Given a language instruction and rendered scene observations, ElasticFit infers structured fitting cues that specify where the object should be grounded, what volume it should occupy, how it should be oriented, and its adaptation mode (rigid placement, uniform scaling, or elastic fitting). These cues convert high-level VLM reasoning into explicit 3D constraints that condition object generation and guide downstream geometric fitting. ElasticFit then generates a scene-conditioned object prior, reconstructs it in 3D, and refines the mesh through mode-specific fitting while enforcing collision avoidance, contact consistency, and physical grounding. In fixed-asset baseline comparisons, ElasticFit improves spatial relation success from 50.8% to 69.7% and support success from 48.3% to 91.7% over the strongest baseline, while providing novel support for generative "make-it-fit" insertions in complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: ElasticFit：一个由VLM引导、基于场景锚定表示的"适配感知"物体插入框架，通过结构化拟合线索驱动生成与几何拟合，显著提升空间关系与支撑成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM与生成模型虽具备语义推理与视觉生成能力，但在3D场景中插入物体时缺乏3D定位能力与几何控制，难以在受限局部空间内实现几何适配、语义意图与物理合理性的统一。
AI.method: 提出以场景锚定表示为核心的VLM引导框架：依据语言指令与渲染场景观测，推断结构化拟合线索，明确物体的落地位置、占据体积、朝向及适配模式（刚性放置、等比缩放、弹性拟合）；由此将高层VLM推理转化为显式3D约束，条件化物体生成并引导后续几何拟合。流程为：生成场景条件物体先验→3D重建→按模式进行网格精修，并施加避碰、接触一致性与物理落地约束。
AI.result: 在固定资产基线对比中，ElasticFit将空间关系成功率由50.8%提升至69.7%，支撑成功率由48.3%提升至91.7%；并在复杂场景中实现对生成式"使其适配"插入的新支持。
AI.conclusion: 通过将VLM语义推理显式转译为3D几何约束并结合模式化拟合，ElasticFit在受限空间中兼顾语义意图、几何贴合与物理合理性，优于固定资产基线，并拓展了生成式插入的适用场景。

title: Protective Perturbations Must Survive the Resize: Scale-Robust Image Immunization against Malicious Editing
summary: While instruction-guided editors built on diffusion transformers can turn a personal photo into a convincing forgery with a single sentence, protective perturbations aim to make such edits fail before the photo is ever shared. The threat is most acute for the photos people actually share, which have 10 megapixels or more and which current editors first downscale by a factor that the owner does not know. Existing protections are computed at one resolution or averaged over random scales, and they lose most of their effect once the photo is downscaled. They implicitly assume that the editor sees the scale for which they were optimized, or that protecting the average scale protects every scale. We propose SRIM, a protection that remains effective at every scale an editor may use, without knowing its preprocessing and at the same computational cost as standard expectation over transformation. SRIM covers the range of scales implied by the photo size with anchor scales and spends each optimization step on the scale where the protection is currently weakest. A spectral analysis shows that this worst-case protection degrades only logarithmically with the width of the range, a value that averaging over scales cannot reach. Extensive experiments on full-resolution photos and popular instruction-guided editors validate that SRIM gives the strongest protection, outperforming existing methods even with a quarter of their $\ell_\infty$ budget, remaining the strongest under input purification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRIM，一种面向扩散变换器指令引导编辑的防护扰动方法，可在未知下采样尺度下保持有效，计算成本与标准EOT相当。
AI.motivation: 用户实际分享的照片通常达10兆像素以上，编辑器会先在未知尺度下采样。现有防护方法在单一分辨率上优化或对随机尺度取平均，一旦下采样便损失大部分效果，隐含假设编辑器使用其优化尺度或保护平均尺度即可保护所有尺度。
AI.method: SRIM用锚点尺度覆盖照片尺寸所隐含的尺度范围，每一步优化选择当前防护最弱的尺度进行攻击；并通过谱分析刻画该最坏情况防护随尺度范围宽度的退化。
AI.result: 谱分析表明该最坏情况防护仅随尺度范围宽度对数退化，这是尺度平均方法无法达到的；在全分辨率照片与主流指令引导编辑器上的实验显示SRIM防护最强，即使仅用现有方法四分之一的ℓ∞预算也优于它们，且在输入净化下仍保持最强。
AI.conclusion: SRIM在未知预处理与全尺度范围内提供持续有效的防护，且不增加计算开销，优于现有方法。

title: In With the Old: Enhancing 'Classical' Document Automation with Generative AI
comment: 10 pages. AI for Access to Justice Workshop at ICAIL 2025
summary: Software-based legal assistance systems have leveraged many different forms of knowledge representation and reasoning. This article explores how document automation services rooted in expert system style and other symbolic approaches can usefully enhance and be enhanced by current generative AI approaches. We discuss the possible benefits and challenges, and report on preliminary experiments in using large language models to identify and fix issues in texts written by laypeople.

AI.tldr: 探讨基于专家系统与符号方法的文档自动化服务与生成式AI的互补关系，并报告利用大语言模型识别和修正非专业人士法律文本问题的初步实验。
AI.motivation: 软件法律辅助系统已采用多种知识表示与推理形式，但符号化专家系统方法与当前生成式AI之间如何相互增强尚缺乏系统探讨，故研究二者的结合潜力、收益与挑战。
AI.method: 以扎根于专家系统风格及其他符号方法的文档自动化服务为切入点，分析其与生成式AI结合的可能收益与挑战；并开展初步实验，使用大语言模型识别与修正由非专业人士撰写的文本中的问题。
AI.result: 报告了使用大语言模型识别并修正非专业人士撰写文本中问题的初步实验结果（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 文档自动化等符号化方法既能有效增强生成式AI，也能被其增强，二者具有互补性；未来需在收益与挑战之间权衡并进一步验证。

title: Closing Ambient Clinical Documentation Gaps with Automated Provider Queries
summary: Provider queries are clarifying requests sent by clinical documentation specialists to physicians to close gaps in the clinical note and ensure accurate billing. Prior work automates note drafting, ICD-10 coding, and order extraction assuming a complete transcript, leaving these gaps unaddressed. We study whether an LLM can automate the query loop, termed DAU (Draft, Ask, Update), across those three tasks. An audit of 3,000 real visits identifies the sources of missing documentation, from which we build five transcript-degradation benchmarks on public data. Analyzing 21k clarification turns on real conversations, we find useful-question predictors are task-specific: oracle confidence dominates, but note completeness needs only simple recall questions while ICD-10 coding needs harder, multi-option ones. About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite. Deployment depends on learning "when not" as much as "what to" ask.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出DAU（Draft, Ask, Update）框架，探讨LLM能否在临床笔记起草、ICD-10编码与医嘱提取三类任务中自动化"澄清查询循环"，并构建基准与实证分析揭示提问时机与类型的任务特异性。
AI.motivation: 临床文档专家需向医生发送澄清性查询（provider queries）以补齐病历缺口并保证计费准确；已有工作默认转录完整，忽视了这一缺口，因此需要研究LLM能否自动化该澄清循环。
AI.method: 审计3,000次真实就诊以识别文档缺失来源，据此在公开数据上构建五个转录退化基准；分析真实对话中21,000个澄清轮次，考察有用问题的预测因素。
AI.result: 有用问题的预测因素具有任务特异性：oracle置信度占主导；笔记完整性只需简单的召回型问题，而ICD-10编码需要更难的多选项问题；约9%的轮次反而损害性能，原因是冗余提问与非回答仍触发重写。
AI.conclusion: 部署此类系统取决于同时学会"不该问什么"与"该问什么"，即提问时机的判别与提问内容的生成同等重要。

title: On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents
summary: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.

AI.tldr: 研究不同LLM对信息价值的判断差异如何塑造智能体信息引导中的序贯信息寻求行为。
AI.motivation: 信息引导是开放式的信息寻求问题，交互可能朝多个有价值方向发展，需持续判断应追求哪些信息。智能体引导中该决策可委托给基础模型，但模型选择如何影响信息寻求行为尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 首先在跨多个模型家族和参数规模的11个LLM上，使用共享的信息集与引导目标，考察信息价值判断差异；随后构建受控引导模拟，使不同模型面对相同信息空间并使用相同选择规则，将上述判断与问题生成及回答者行为隔离，刻画模型特定偏好所产生的广度—深度行为，并考察交互历史如何改变对候选信息的评估与后续选择；最后通过敏感性分析与消融实验检验稳健性，涉及引导者可获得的机会、用于操作化信息寻求偏好的响应标签、交互历史的存在与否，以及冗余是否与评估显式相关。
AI.result: 不同LLM对信息价值的判断存在差异，这些差异在序贯引导过程中表现为不同的广度—深度行为；交互历史会改变对候选信息的评估及后续选择；上述发现在多项敏感性分析与消融下得到检验。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择通过其信息价值判断系统性地塑造智能体信息引导的行为轨迹，为理解与设计基于基础模型的引导系统提供依据；代码、数据与轨迹文件已公开。

title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
summary: Mobile manipulators such as humanoid robots are increasingly deployed in dynamic, unstructured environments to perform dexterous manipulation tasks. However, end-to-end manipulation policies trained to imitate demonstration data collected from a single robot pose are brittle: even centimeter-scale deviations in robot pose at deployment can drive ego-centric observations and end-effector trajectories out of the training distribution, leading to sharp drops in performance. We introduce MobileVISTA, a data generation framework that transforms demonstrations captured at canonical poses into diverse, pose-perturbed training data by jointly (1) augmenting egocentric visual observations and (2) retargeting actions to compensate for base pose changes. Unlike prior methods, which assume a camera rigidly mounted off the actuated chain or non-trivial articulated robot geometry largely out of frame, MobileVISTA targets compatibility with egocentric platforms (e.g., humanoids) where the camera is both influenced by and must observe the robot's kinematic chain as it moves. We study MobileVISTA in simulated tasks spanning humanoid and bimanual embodiments, and on a real Galaxea R1 Pro. We find policies trained on MobileVISTA-augmented data demonstrate improved robustness to previously out-of-distribution poses encountered at test time, without additional demonstration collection or a trained generative model. Additionally, we find MobileVISTA's benefit is largest on tested humanoids, where the camera rides the actuated chain and the robot fills much of the frame. Additional videos and appendix can be found on our website: https://mobilevista.github.io

AI.tldr: MobileVISTA 是一个数据生成框架，通过联合增强自我中心视觉观测与重定向动作，将单一标准位姿下的示教数据扩展为位姿扰动训练数据，从而提升移动操作器（如人形机器人）对测试时分布外位姿的鲁棒性，无需额外采集示教或训练生成模型。
AI.motivation: 移动操作器在动态非结构化环境中执行灵巧操作，但端到端模仿学习策略若仅在单一机器人位姿下的示教数据上训练，会非常脆弱：部署时即使厘米级的位姿偏差，也会使自我中心观测与末端执行器轨迹偏离训练分布，导致性能急剧下降。
AI.method: MobileVISTA 将标准位姿采集的示教数据转换为多样化、位姿扰动的训练数据，包含两个联合步骤：(1) 增强自我中心视觉观测；(2) 重定向动作以补偿基座位姿变化。与假设相机刚性固定在驱动链之外或机器人几何结构大多不在画面中的先前方法不同，MobileVISTA 面向自我中心平台（如人形机器人），此时相机既受机器人运动学链影响，又必须观测该运动学链的运动。
AI.result: 在涵盖人形与双臂形态的仿真任务以及真实 Galaxea R1 Pro 机器人上进行了研究。结果显示，使用 MobileVISTA 增强数据训练的策略对测试时遇到的此前分布外位姿具有更好鲁棒性，且无需额外采集示教或使用训练好的生成模型。MobileVISTA 的增益在测试的人形机器人上最大，因为其相机随驱动链运动且机器人占据画面大部分区域。
AI.conclusion: MobileVISTA 通过位姿扰动数据增强，有效提升了自我中心移动操作策略对基座位姿偏差的鲁棒性，尤其适用于相机随驱动链运动、机器人占据画面主体的人形平台，为动态非结构化环境中的灵巧操作提供了实用方案。

title: Not What a Child Expressed: Auditing the Sign-to-Text Safety Interface in Child-Facing AI
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI (non-archival)
summary: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有自动手语翻译（SLT）与面向儿童的安全审核系统从未被联合评估，且主流部署的SLT模型未在18岁以下手语者上训练或正式评测；翻译中涉及否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧迫性或求助意图的错误可能在不影响流畅度的情况下改变安全决策。作者提出一种由聋人群体参与的前部署审核方案，包含失败分类法、脱敏场景模式、四种对照条件与四项结果指标，并计划以澳大利亚手语（Auslan）为首个案例研究。
AI.motivation: 自动手语翻译已进入消费产品（如将美国手语转为英文文本用于听写、消息与对话助手查询），同时面向儿童的人工智能与平台信任安全工具依赖文本过滤器和聊天消息评分分类器作出决策。使用SLT的手语儿童因而只能"经翻译"抵达这些保护机制。然而作者未发现任何公开记录的系统对二者进行联合评估，且主流部署的SLT模型既未在18岁以下手语者数据上训练，也未在其上做正式评测。这种评估缺口意味着翻译偏差可能悄无声息地改变安全判定，威胁手语儿童的保护效果与公平性。
AI.method: 论文提出一项由聋人群体参与（Deaf-informed）的部署前审核框架，针对SLT与儿童安全审核的接口，包含四个组成部分：一是失败分类法（failure taxonomy），刻画可能改变安全决策的翻译错误类型；二是脱敏场景模式（sanitised scenario schema），用于构造测试用例；三是四种对照条件（four comparison conditions），用于隔离SLT各环节的影响；四是四项结果指标（four outcome measures），用于量化安全决策偏差。首个案例研究计划以澳大利亚手语（Auslan）为对象。
AI.result: 该文为立场/方案类论文（proposal），主要结果为三项发现性论断：其一，尚无公开记录的联合评估系统；其二，领先的已部署SLT模型未针对18岁以下手语者进行训练或正式评测；其三，涉及否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧迫性或求助意图的翻译错误可在译文流畅的前提下改变安全决策。论文未报告实证实验数据，其产出为审核框架设计与Auslan案例研究计划。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论为：SLT与儿童在线安全审核之间的接口存在未被检验的高风险区，翻译层面的语义偏差可能导致安全判定失误且难以被流畅度指标察觉；因此有必要开展聋人群体参与的前部署审核。计划以澳大利亚手语（Auslan）作为首个案例研究，验证失败分类法与审核流程的可行性。
